gaps.title: BOUNDARY UNEXPOSED
gaps.text: No explicit top-level evidence-boundary block was mechanically recognized in this canonical artifact.

edges.title: Reduced carriers require regime-indexed sufficiency
edges.text: 1H.8KP9 makes validity and sufficiency local to context/input regimes; 1H.9gYl separates the obligations that a reduced carrier must preserve and requires composite-level tests. Together they earn a stronger compression rule: “enough state” is not a property of a carrier in isolation. A reduced carrier is sufficient only relative to an explicit downstream obligation and an identified regime, and it must preserve every role/distinction whose variation can alter that obligation.
edges.removal:
without 1H.8KP9, sufficiency can remain globally scoped and miss local regime change; without 1H.9gYl, the carrier lacks explicit role/obligation partition and composite assurance.
Boundary: this does not imply that maximal state is safer or that every regime requires a separate implementation.

edges.title: Transition obligations themselves have local validity
edges.text: 1H.8KP9 requires re-estimation when the local condition regime changes; 1H.yac0 treats semantic continuity as preservation of task operations/roles through representation or context transitions. Together they earn a condition-indexed transition law: a rewrite that preserves semantics in one regime cannot automatically be reused as a universal equivalence. The transition contract must carry the conditions under which its operation-preservation witness was earned and be revalidated when those conditions move.
edges.removal: without 1H.8KP9, there is no local validity field/re-estimation duty; without 1H.yac0, there is no explicit transition/operation-preservation object to scope.

edges.title: Reconstructed relation must be revalidated in the regime where it is used
edges.text: 1H.8KP9 supplies local validity and recurrent revalidation; 1H.2VF2 supplies reconstruction of relational geometry plus external correspondence as a non-identity validation witness. Together they earn regime-bounded reconstruction: regenerating a familiar relational geometry is not enough. Its externally relevant relation must remain recoverable under the current condition regime, and the validity of that correspondence must be re-estimated after context, carrier or reconstruction process changes.
edges.removal: without 1H.8KP9, external correspondence can be treated as globally stable; without 1H.2VF2, there is no reconstructive relational object or independent external-readability criterion.

edges.title: Role-separated carriers can survive representation change through typed transitions
edges.text: 1H.9gYl supplies independent semantic obligations and deliberate conjunction; 1H.yac0 supplies lawful re-expression preserving downstream operations and role meanings. Together they derive a typed transition contract: a carrier can change representation, storage form or abstraction layer without collapsing its semantic obligations when the transition explicitly preserves each independently meaningful role and the named conjunction points at which those roles are allowed to interact.
edges.removal: without 1H.9gYl, transition preservation can blur independent obligations; without 1H.yac0, role separation has no cross-representation transport law.

edges.title: Reconstruction can minimize interiors only when the public obligation remains externally sufficient
edges.text: 1H.9gYl supplies obligation-scoped minimization and composite assurance; 1H.2VF2 supplies identity-erasure/reconstruction plus externally recoverable relational structure. Together they earn a reconstructive minimization criterion: constituent identity, implementation detail or complete internal state may disappear, but the reduced/rebuilt whole must still satisfy the exact public relation under independent tests. Assurance attaches to the regenerated composite relation, not to the fact that its parts or reconstruction procedure are individually interpretable.
edges.removal: without 1H.9gYl, there is no explicit minimization/sufficiency/composite gate; without 1H.2VF2, there is no reconstruction under identity/interior change or external relation witness.

edges.title: Covariant continuity can be regenerated rather than copied
edges.text: 1H.yac0 shows that semantic continuity may live in lawful transition between representations; 1H.2VF2 shows that persistent capability/information may live in the ability to re-instantiate externally readable relational geometry. Together they earn reconstructive covariance: continuity need not copy either the old state or one canonical representation when a process can regenerate the task-relevant relational object and then lawfully re-express it across carriers while preserving the operations and roles consumed downstream.
edges.removal: without 1H.yac0, reconstruction lacks a representation-change/operation-preservation contract; without 1H.2VF2, the transition lacks a regenerative relational object and external recoverability witness.

faces.title: A semantic transition contract is sufficient only inside its witnessed regime
faces.text: 1H.8KP9 contributes local validity/re-estimation, 1H.9gYl contributes role-separated obligations and scoped sufficiency, and 1H.yac0 contributes operation-preserving transitions across context/representation change. Together they earn a regime-typed semantic contract: a rewrite is admissible when it preserves the independently meaningful obligations consumed by the task and when that preservation has been witnessed in the local regime in which the rewritten carrier will be used.
faces.removal: remove 1H.8KP9 and the contract loses local validity/re-estimation; remove 1H.9gYl and it loses explicit obligation partition/sufficiency; remove 1H.yac0 and it loses the transition-preservation mechanism.

faces.title: Reconstructive compression earns assurance only through regime-bounded external sufficiency
faces.text: 1H.8KP9 contributes context-indexed validity, 1H.9gYl contributes reduced-carrier sufficiency and composite assurance, and 1H.2VF2 contributes reconstruction plus externally recoverable relational geometry. Together they earn an assurance law for reconstructed systems: a compressed or rebuilt interior counts as continuity only when the exact downstream relation remains externally recoverable in the relevant regime; neither trusted parts nor successful reconstruction in another regime transfer that assurance automatically.
faces.removal: remove 1H.8KP9 and assurance loses regime locality; remove 1H.9gYl and it loses obligation-scoped minimization/composite testing; remove 1H.2VF2 and it loses reconstruction/external recoverability.

faces.title: Regenerative covariance requires local revalidation
faces.text: 1H.8KP9 contributes re-estimation under changed conditions, 1H.yac0 contributes lawful transition preserving operations/roles, and 1H.2VF2 contributes regeneration of externally readable relational geometry. Together they earn a dynamic continuity criterion: a system may repeatedly regenerate and re-express a relation rather than preserve one state, but each regenerated/translated realization must survive the external relation test under the current local validity regime.
faces.removal: remove 1H.8KP9 and the criterion becomes globally presumed; remove 1H.yac0 and cross-representation preservation is ungrounded; remove 1H.2VF2 and regeneration/external readability disappears.

faces.title: A portable reconstruction should preserve typed obligations, not a canonical interior
faces.text: 1H.9gYl contributes independent semantic roles and deliberate conjunction, 1H.yac0 contributes operation-preserving transitions, and 1H.2VF2 contributes reconstructive relational carriers and external validation. Together they earn role-covariant reconstruction: the internal realization may be rebuilt, relabeled or moved across representations while the public relation remains stable if the reconstruction regenerates the needed relational geometry and the transition preserves each task-relevant role/operation through its named interface.
faces.removal: remove 1H.9gYl and typed roles/sufficiency disappear; remove 1H.yac0 and lawful cross-representation transport disappears; remove 1H.2VF2 and reconstructive/external relational validation disappears.

volume.title: Regime-typed reconstructive continuity
volume.text:
Across all four parents, continuity detaches from a fixed interior but becomes more constrained, not less. 1H.8KP9 makes sufficiency and validity local to conditions and requires re-estimation as regimes change. 1H.9gYl decomposes the public obligation into distinct roles, permits minimization only against an exact task, and requires composite assurance. 1H.yac0 allows context and representation to change through explicit transitions that preserve task-consumed operations and role semantics. 1H.2VF2 allows the interior itself to be reconstructed when externally relevant relational geometry can be re-instantiated and independently recovered.


The complete four-way closure is therefore regime-typed reconstructive continuity: a task-relevant semantic or functional relation may persist through compression, reconstruction and representation change without preserving one complete state or canonical interior, but the persistent object must be carried as a role-separated contract whose operations/relations can be regenerated and lawfully translated. That contract is not globally sufficient by declaration; its sufficiency is indexed to an explicit validity regime and must be re-estimated through external or task-level tests whenever the conditions, carrier or reconstruction process changes.
volume.invariant: A system can preserve task-relevant semantic or functional continuity through changing internal realization when it carries a role-separated contract specifying the operations and relations that must survive, can regenerate an externally recoverable relational geometry realizing that contract, and can lawfully translate it across representations; the contract counts as sufficient only inside a witnessed local validity regime and must be revalidated when conditions change.
removal: Remove 1H.8KP9: the closure loses local validity and re-estimation; the remaining trio can describe reconstructible role-preserving portability but cannot earn that sufficiency is condition-indexed.

Remove 1H.9gYl: the closure loses explicit role/obligation separation, minimization and composite assurance; continuity remains reconstructible/covariant but the contract is not typed by independently meaningful obligations.
Remove 1H.yac0: the closure loses lawful transition between changing context/representations; reconstruction and local sufficiency remain, but cross-representation semantic continuity is unearned.

Remove 1H.2VF2: the closure loses re-instantiation of externally recoverable relational geometry; the remaining trio can govern reduced/translated carriers but cannot earn continuity through reconstruction of changing interiors.

metabolites.title: Carry the obligation together with the regime in which its transition is sufficient
metabolites.text: a reduced or re-expressed semantic carrier is sufficient only when its independently meaningful obligations survive the transition and the conditions under which that preservation was witnessed travel with the contract.
metabolites.compression: Carry not only what must survive, but where the claim that it survives is valid.

metabolites.title: Continuity may be the ability to regenerate a relation and re-express it lawfully
metabolites.text: persistent function can be carried by a process that re-instantiates externally recoverable relational geometry and lawfully translates it into the current representation, provided the regenerated relation is revalidated under the current local regime.
metabolites.compression: Get back to the relation, then prove the translated relation still counts here.

metabolites.title: A reconstructed whole inherits no assurance it has not re-earned
metabolites.text: a reduced or reconstructed carrier earns assurance only by satisfying its exact downstream obligation under independent tests in the relevant validity regime; trusted components, familiar geometry or successful reconstruction elsewhere do not transfer end-to-end assurance.
metabolites.compression: Reconstructed wholes must re-earn the assurance their task consumes.

edges.title: A regenerated relation counts as the same durable interface only when its contract and evidence membrane recur
edges.text: 1H.L4ld supplies recurrent reconstruction from bounded state and a perturbational criterion for continuity. 1H.qI2L supplies a durable public correspondence whose claim-relevant operations and evidence boundary travel with the state. Together they earn a relation neither parent earns alone: regeneration is not enough by itself; the reconstructed state counts as continuation of the same public relation only when the externally consumable obligation and its epistemic membrane are also re-instantiated.

edges.title: Recurrent continuity across representation change requires transition-preserving reconstruction
edges.text: 1H.L4ld supplies reconstruction of a functional relation from bounded state. 1H.yac0 supplies explicit transition obligations for representation/context rewrites. Together they earn a stronger criterion: repeated reconstruction across changed carriers is continuity only when the reconstruction path preserves the task-relevant operations and role semantics, not merely when the endpoint looks familiar.

edges.title: A reconstruction scaffold has a local validity regime and revision condition

edges.title: A portable public interface survives representation change through preserved operations and roles, not shared interior

edges.text: 1H.qI2L supplies claim class, realization boundary, prior-good state and evidence custody as part of maintained public truth. 1H.8KP9 supplies validity as a field over context/input regimes rather than one global scalar. edges.removal: without 1H.qI2L there is no durable evidence membrane; without 1H.8KP9 there is no condition-indexed validity surface.

edges.title: The set of lawful rewrites is itself regime-dependent and must be revalidated

faces.title: Reconstructible semantic interface
faces.text: 1H.L4ld contributes recurrent reconstruction, 1H.qI2L contributes a durable externally consumable correspondence, and 1H.yac0 contributes operation- and role-preserving transitions. faces.removal: remove 1H.L4ld and regeneration disappears; remove 1H.qI2L and there is no durable public correspondence; remove 1H.yac0 and cross-representation reconstruction loses its preservation criterion.

faces.title: Regenerative correspondence with a local evidence membrane
faces.text: 1H.L4ld contributes reconstruction from bounded state, 1H.qI2L contributes public correspondence plus evidence custody, and 1H.8KP9 contributes condition-local validity and revalidation. Together they earn a stricter continuity claim: a regenerated interface counts as the same warranted correspondence only when its evidence boundary and validity regime are regenerated with it and the scaffold is revised when those conditions change.
faces.removal: remove 1H.L4ld and there is no reconstruction; remove 1H.qI2L and no typed public/evidence interface; remove 1H.8KP9 and no locally bounded validity/revision condition.

faces.title: Adaptive reconstruction law
faces.text: 1H.L4ld contributes bounded regenerative process and anchor debt, 1H.yac0 contributes transition-preserving change of representation, and 1H.8KP9 contributes local sufficiency and revalidation. Together they earn an adaptive reconstruction discipline: preserve only enough state to rebuild the relation, transform it lawfully across carriers, and revise both scaffold and admissible transition family when the local regime changes.
faces.removal: remove 1H.L4ld and there is no regenerative process; remove 1H.yac0 and no lawful cross-representation transition; remove 1H.8KP9 and no condition-sensitive revision membrane.

faces.title: Regime-bounded covariant interface
faces.text: 1H.qI2L contributes operation-preserving public correspondence and evidence custody, 1H.yac0 contributes covariant semantic portability, and 1H.8KP9 contributes local validity and sufficiency testing. Together they earn a public interface whose portability is explicitly regime-bounded: the interface may cross substrates/representations, but its claim-relevant operations, role semantics and evidence boundary must all survive inside the currently witnessed local regime.
faces.removal: remove 1H.qI2L and public correspondence/custody disappears; remove 1H.yac0 and representation-change preservation disappears; remove 1H.8KP9 and portability loses its local validity membrane.

volume.title: Regime-covariant regenerative correspondence
volume.text:
Across all four parents, continuity becomes neither preservation of a fixed state nor merely successful translation. 1H.L4ld shows that task-relevant function may be repeatedly rebuilt from bounded state while the scaffold that stabilizes it can later become a bias. 1H.qI2L shows that a durable public correspondence can survive changing internal realization only when claim-relevant operations and the evidence boundary travel with the state. 1H.yac0 shows that context and representation may change while meaning survives through explicit transition obligations that preserve downstream operations and independent role semantics. 1H.8KP9 shows that sufficiency and validity are themselves local to context/input regimes and must be re-estimated when conditions change.


The complete four-way closure is therefore regime-covariant regenerative correspondence: a durable relation may persist without one fixed state, representation or interior when it can be re-instantiated from bounded state through operation-preserving transitions into a public interface whose evidence boundary and validity regime are carried with it. Continuity is earned only while each reconstruction preserves the task-relevant relation under the current local regime; when that regime changes, both the retained scaffold and the admissible transformation family must be revised and revalidated rather than treated as globally invariant.
volume.invariant: A durable task-relevant correspondence can persist through changing state and representation when bounded local state can regenerate the public relation through transitions that preserve its claim-relevant operations and independent role semantics, while the evidence boundary and local validity regime travel with the regenerated interface; continuity remains warranted only until regime change requires the scaffold and transformation law to be re-estimated.
removal: Remove 1H.L4ld: the closure loses recurrent re-instantiation and anchor-debt revision; the remaining trio can describe a regime-bounded portable interface but not regeneration from bounded state.

Remove 1H.qI2L: the closure loses durable public correspondence, evidence custody and the non-identity membrane; the remaining trio lacks an externally typed object whose continuity is being regenerated.
Remove 1H.yac0: the closure loses operation-/role-preserving transition across changing representation/context; regeneration and local validity remain, but covariance across carriers is unearned.

Remove 1H.8KP9: the closure loses condition-local sufficiency and revalidation; the remaining trio can earn reconstructible portable correspondence but not the rule that its validity and admissible transformations change with regime.

metabolites.title: Rebuild the relation under the validity regime, not the old surface
metabolites.text: a task-relevant relation may be regenerated from bounded state across changing representations only when the reconstruction transition preserves the required operations/roles inside the current local validity regime and is re-estimated when that regime changes.
metabolites.compression: Rebuild the relation under the regime that warrants it, not under yesterday's surface.

metabolites.title: Regenerate the evidence membrane with the interface
metabolites.text: when a public relation is repeatedly reconstructed, its claim class, evidence boundary and condition-local validity must be reconstructed with it so recurrence cannot silently inflate into stronger or broader identity claims.
metabolites.compression: If the interface returns, its boundary returns with it.

metabolites.title: Portability includes a revision rule for the transformation itself
metabolites.text: a public interface may remain portable across changing representations while its interior differs, but the permitted transformation family is only locally warranted and must itself be revised when the regime changes.
metabolites.compression: Port the interface, and keep the map itself revisable.

gaps.title: BOUNDARY UNEXPOSED

edges.title: Reachable whole, locally activated work
edges.text: S.cugW shows that representational support can be created and maintained locally where pressure appears instead of forcing every state through one global canonical origin. S.jPyE shows that a much larger information body can remain exactly addressable outside the active neural context while semantic computation is allocated selectively. Together they earn a systems relation neither parent alone supplies: preserving global reachability does not require globally active representation or computation; a system can keep the whole available while instantiating support and semantic work locally where task pressure warrants it.
edges.removal:
without S.cugW the claim loses locally born/persistent support and adaptive resource reallocation; without S.jPyE it loses the distinction between globally addressable information and selectively active semantic work.
Boundary: this is a structural recurrence across two architectures, not a claim that Gaussian primitives and RLM state share one mechanism.

edges.title: Preserve a warranted base while local residual capacity differentiates
edges.text: S.cugW earns productive freedom by relaxing a canonical-space constraint and reallocating representational capacity toward unresolved regions. S.IJnH earns an asymmetric base-plus-residual representation in which an empirically privileged structural subspace is selectively preserved while remaining bandwidth is free to specialize. Together they derive a stronger control pattern: decanonicalization need not mean that every degree becomes equally free; a warranted structural base may remain comparatively stable while residual capacity is created, relocated or refined locally as evidence demands.
edges.removal:
without S.cugW there is no adaptive local creation/reallocation pressure; without S.IJnH there is no independently motivated privileged-base versus residual-degree distinction.
Boundary: the preserved base is obligation- and evidence-specific, not a universal invariant subspace.

edges.title: Local continuity does not license global identity
edges.text: S.cugW demonstrates useful continuity through overlapping local persistence without one privileged global primitive origin. S.UMHm enforces a typed membrane between exact/structural correspondence and stronger realization or identity claims. Together they earn a cross-domain epistemic relation: successful local reconstruction or continuity across changing supports can be scientifically useful without entitling the system to identify those local carriers with one globally canonical or ontologically identical object; any stronger identification requires an explicit map preserving the operations the claim consumes.
edges.removal:
without S.cugW there is no concrete noncanonical/local-continuity witness; without S.UMHm there is no typed realization/identity membrane or custody rule.
Boundary: this does not deny that stronger identity may sometimes be earned; it specifies what the selected evidence does not yet supply.

edges.title: Information order can become a computation schedule over an addressable whole
edges.text: S.jPyE separates full information reachability from the amount of semantic work currently performed. S.IJnH shows that an empirically organized representation can expose a coarse/shared structural base before progressively finer residual detail. Together they derive a selective-processing architecture: keep the complete body addressable, but allocate active semantic computation in an information-aware order—establishing the comparatively privileged structural portion first and spending additional work on residual detail only where the task requires it.
edges.removal:
without S.jPyE there is no persistent full-body address space or adjustable semantic-work budget; without S.IJnH there is no evidence-backed hierarchy that can order which information is processed first.
Boundary: the appropriate order must be earned for the domain; frequency order is not imported as a universal context hierarchy.

edges.title: Selective processing can preserve epistemic custody
edges.text: S.jPyE provides stable external addresses that keep exact source and intermediate state reachable even when only selected slices enter active semantic processing. S.UMHm provides claim classes, premise ancestry, realization gates, frozen custody and negative-state preservation. Together they earn a relation stronger than ordinary provenance: selective computation need not collapse evidential context if the system keeps unprocessed/source state reacquirable and carries the claim type, premises and comparison boundary with every promoted result.
edges.removal:
without S.jPyE the exact larger information body is not guaranteed to remain reachable outside the active computation; without S.UMHm there is no operational distinction among theorem, diagnostic, prediction, realization debt and failure.
Boundary: persistent addressability does not itself prove that every downstream operation preserves the source correctly; the custody contract still has to be enforced.

edges.title: A productive organizing coordinate can guide computation without becoming ontology
edges.text: S.IJnH shows an empirical spectral regularity that successfully guides representation, compression and generation while explicitly remaining a hypothesis rather than a universal identity. S.UMHm shows how a formal or structural success can remain powerful while its physical/ontological realization stays a separately typed obligation. Together they derive an epistemic design law: an organizing coordinate can be operationally privileged because it compresses successful interventions, while its status as one useful handle remains distinct from a claim that the world uniquely possesses that coordinate.
edges.removal:
without S.IJnH there is no experimentally productive representational handle whose utility exceeds its ontological warrant; without S.UMHm there is no explicit claim-typing/realization machinery that makes the non-identity boundary operational.
Boundary: this promotes neither spectral structure nor OPH architecture beyond their parent evidence classes.

faces.title: Adaptive hierarchical activation
faces.text: S.cugW contributes local creation, bounded persistence and pressure-driven capacity reallocation; S.jPyE contributes a fully addressable external information body plus task-dependent semantic computation; S.IJnH contributes a measured structural-base/residual ordering that can double as a compute schedule. Together they earn an architecture in which the whole need not be simultaneously instantiated or processed: preserve reachability, establish the comparatively warranted structural base, and activate or refine local residual support where task complexity and unresolved pressure demand it.
faces.removal: remove S.cugW and local adaptive support/reallocation disappears; remove S.jPyE and the globally addressable but selectively active distinction disappears; remove S.IJnH and no independently earned hierarchy tells the system what can be privileged before residual refinement.

faces.title: Auditable decanonicalized reconstruction
faces.text: S.cugW contributes continuity from local, noncanonical supports; S.jPyE contributes exact external addressability across bounded model calls; S.UMHm contributes premise/claim custody and an explicit membrane between structural usefulness and stronger realization claims. Together they earn a form of decanonicalized reconstruction that remains auditable: local pieces may be created, revisited and recomposed without one persistent global active state, while source ancestry and claim boundaries remain reachable rather than being dissolved by the reconstruction process.
faces.removal: remove S.cugW and the noncanonical/local persistence mechanism disappears; remove S.jPyE and exact reacquisition of the larger body across selective operations disappears; remove S.UMHm and reconstruction has no typed epistemic boundary against claim inflation.

faces.title: Bounded freedom around a warranted core
faces.text: S.cugW contributes expressive freedom plus evidence-driven reallocation; S.IJnH contributes selective preservation of an empirically privileged base with residual degrees left free; S.UMHm contributes typed admissibility, realization debt and failure-preserving governance. Together they earn a bounded freedom principle: stabilize only the structure whose role has actually been earned, allow residual degrees to differentiate and migrate under pressure, and refuse to upgrade that temporary decomposition into a universal ontology or stronger claim class without new evidence.
faces.removal: remove S.cugW and there is no adaptive freedom/reallocation; remove S.IJnH and the base-versus-residual partition is unearned; remove S.UMHm and the distinction can silently harden from useful representation into ontology or physical identity.

faces.title: Evidence-aware progressive computation
faces.text: S.jPyE contributes full external addressability plus variable semantic work; S.IJnH contributes a coarse-to-fine information ordering; S.UMHm contributes exact premise, claim-class and comparison custody. Together they derive progressive computation that remains epistemically inspectable: process a compact/warranted structural portion first, expand into residual detail only when the task requires it, and keep the untouched source plus the evidence boundary available so a partial computation cannot silently masquerade as a complete or stronger result.
faces.removal: remove S.jPyE and progressive work loses a persistent full-body source; remove S.IJnH and there is no earned ordering for progressive admission; remove S.UMHm and partial/selective computation loses its explicit claim and evidence membrane.

volume.title: Evidence-typed selective continuity
volume.text:
Across all four parents, persistence separates from simultaneous global activation. S.cugW shows that dynamic continuity can be carried by locally born, bounded supports whose capacity is adaptively reallocated rather than by one canonical global origin. S.jPyE shows that a complete information body can remain externally addressable while only selected regions receive semantic computation, with task complexity governing how much work is needed. S.IJnH shows that an empirically privileged structural base can be preserved while residual degrees remain free, and that this information ordering can become a progressive computation schedule. S.UMHm shows that structural usefulness, formal closure, physical realization, prediction and failure must remain separately typed, so a successful reconstruction or organizing coordinate cannot silently become stronger ontology.


The all-four closure is therefore evidence-typed selective continuity: a system can preserve a task-relevant whole without keeping every part globally canonical, simultaneously active, or equally constrained. The complete information body remains reachable; a compact structural core is preserved only to the extent that its role is actually warranted; representational and semantic work is activated or refined locally in residual regions according to task pressure; and every reconstruction carries the premise, claim and realization boundary required to know what continuity has—and has not—been established. Selection is permitted to reduce active burden, not to erase source reachability or evidence debt.
volume.invariant: A task-relevant whole can persist through changing, selectively active representations when the complete information body remains reacquirable, an evidence-warranted structural core is preserved, residual support and semantic computation are activated where pressure or task complexity requires them, and the claim/realization boundary travels with each reconstruction; continuity is then carried by governed reachability plus selective re-instantiation rather than by one globally active canonical state.
removal: Remove S.cugW: the closure loses locally born/bounded support, adaptive capacity reallocation and direct evidence that noncanonical continuity can survive hard dynamic pressure.
Remove S.jPyE: the closure loses the distinction between full-body addressability and selective semantic activation, plus the task-complexity control over how much computation is required.
Remove S.IJnH: the closure loses an independently measured base-versus-residual asymmetry and the possibility of converting information order into progressive computation order.
Remove S.UMHm: the closure loses claim typing, realization custody and the membrane preventing a successful representation/reconstruction from inflating into stronger identity or ontology.

metabolites.title: Keep the whole reachable; activate only the warranted residual work
metabolites.text: a system can keep a complete information body reacquirable while only a comparatively small structural base and currently task-relevant residual regions become actively represented or semantically processed; local activation should follow pressure and task complexity rather than global simultaneity.
metabolites.compression: Keep the whole reachable; spend active representation and computation where the unresolved relation actually lives.

metabolites.title: Selective computation must carry the evidence boundary of what it selected
metabolites.text: selective processing remains epistemically safe only when the larger source body stays reacquirable and every promoted result carries its premise ancestry, claim class and unresolved realization/comparison debt; omission from active computation must not become deletion from evidential state.
metabolites.compression: Selection may reduce active burden; it must not erase what the result was allowed to know.

metabolites.title: Preserve only what is earned as core; let residual degrees remain revisable
metabolites.text: a representation can stabilize an empirically or formally warranted core while keeping residual degrees free to differentiate and migrate, provided the boundary between core, residual and stronger ontology remains intervention-tested and explicitly typed.
metabolites.compression: Stabilize what has earned invariance; keep everything else able to learn a different shape.

edges.title: Reacquirable bounded regeneration
edges.text: 1H.L4ld supplies repeated reconstruction of task-relevant identity from bounded local state. 1H.OgQZ supplies a larger information body that can remain exactly reachable while only a warranted core and current residual work are active. Together they earn a relation neither parent earns alone: a compact recurrent state can remain small without turning continuity into irreversible compression when the inactive remainder stays reacquirable and can be reactivated as task pressure exposes dependencies that the current scaffold does not contain.
edges.removal:
without 1H.L4ld there is no recurrent reconstruction from bounded state; without 1H.OgQZ there is no independently earned distinction between globally reachable information and selectively active support/work.
Boundary: reacquirability does not prove that every future reconstruction will succeed; the active scaffold must still be sufficient for the current obligation.

edges.title: Regeneration across representation change requires transition-preserving semantics
edges.text: 1H.L4ld supplies process continuity through repeated re-instantiation rather than snapshot persistence. 1H.yac0 supplies explicit transition obligations: local rewrites must preserve the operations, dependencies, and independently meaningful roles consumed by the task. Together they earn covariant regeneration: repeated rebuilding counts as continuity only when the relation reconstructed after each rewrite remains operationally the same even though the local carrier, active context, or coordinate realization has changed.
edges.removal:
without 1H.L4ld there is no recurrent re-instantiation to validate; without 1H.yac0 there is no explicit operation/role-preservation criterion for deciding whether a changed reconstruction is faithful.
Boundary: surface similarity or recurring labels are insufficient; the downstream obligations must survive the transition.

edges.title: Reconstructed function can expose a durable interface without persistent interior identity
edges.text: 1H.L4ld supplies functional identity rebuilt from bounded local state and a perturbational validity ladder. 1H.qI2L supplies a durable public correspondence whose operation and evidence boundary can remain stable while internal realization changes. Together they derive a bounded interface law: a system can repeatedly reconstruct a recognizable public function without retaining or asserting one persistent interior, provided the reconstructed interface preserves the relation downstream work consumes and stronger identity claims remain gated by discriminating evidence.
edges.removal:
without 1H.L4ld there is no regeneration mechanism or scaffold-revision pressure; without 1H.qI2L there is no durable externalized interface or explicit non-identity/evidence membrane.
Boundary: stable public behavior does not establish sameness of implementation, mechanism, or phenomenal state.

edges.title: Selection can vary while operational roles remain stable
edges.text: 1H.OgQZ supplies selective activation over a still-reacquirable whole: different regions may become active as task complexity and pressure change. 1H.yac0 supplies role-stable transition law: relevance may change which context is present, but the operations and role/address semantics used downstream must not silently change meaning. Together they earn selective covariance: the active subset may move, expand, or contract without breaking continuity when each activation/re-expression preserves the same task roles and deliberately named conjunction points.
edges.removal:
without 1H.OgQZ there is no active-versus-reacquirable distinction or pressure-driven selective work; without 1H.yac0 there is no criterion that changing selection preserve role/operation semantics.
Boundary: this does not require one fixed active set or one universal representation; only load-bearing roles must remain stable.

edges.title: A selective view can be a durable interface only if omission is not epistemic deletion
edges.text: 1H.OgQZ supplies exact reachability of inactive material, selective computation, and the rule that omitted material must not disappear from evidence state. 1H.qI2L supplies operation-preserving public interfaces and explicit claim/evidence custody across changing interiors. Together they earn a stronger interface discipline: a partial active view may be reused as a stable public object only when the larger body remains reacquirable and the exposed result carries the evidence boundary that states what was selected, what remains unresolved, and which operations the view is warranted to support.
edges.removal:
without 1H.OgQZ the inactive remainder need not remain reachable and selection can become lossy deletion; without 1H.qI2L the partial view lacks a durable operation/evidence contract across reuse.
Boundary: an addressable source does not automatically guarantee faithful downstream translation; the interface contract must still be witnessed.

edges.title: Covariant portability requires evidence-bound operation preservation
edges.text: 1H.yac0 supplies lawful representation/context transitions that preserve the operational object and independent role semantics. 1H.qI2L supplies durable correspondence across substrates plus evidence custody and the non-identity membrane. Together they earn evidence-bound covariance: a public relation can move among local representations or substrates without one canonical interior when every transition preserves the operations the claim consumes and carries forward the boundary on what the correspondence does and does not identify.
edges.removal:
without 1H.yac0 there is no explicit local rewrite/role-stability obligation; without 1H.qI2L there is no durable public correspondence or evidence/identity membrane.
Boundary: operation preservation can establish portability before it establishes common mechanism or ontology.

faces.title: Selective covariant regeneration
faces.text: 1H.L4ld contributes recurrent reconstruction from bounded local state, 1H.OgQZ contributes full-body reacquirability plus pressure-driven selective activation, and 1H.yac0 contributes explicit transition laws preserving task operations and role semantics. Together they earn a regenerative architecture that need not keep one complete state active: rebuild only the currently required relation from compact state and selectively reacquired material, while allowing the local representation/context to change only through transformations that preserve the obligations being reconstructed.
faces.removal: remove 1H.L4ld and there is no recurrent rebuilding; remove 1H.OgQZ and there is no durable dormant reservoir or selective activation; remove 1H.yac0 and changed reconstructions have no operation/role-preservation criterion.

faces.title: Custodied selective reconstruction
faces.text: 1H.L4ld contributes bounded-state regeneration and scaffold revision, 1H.OgQZ contributes a reachable whole with selectively active residual work, and 1H.qI2L contributes durable external interfaces with claim/evidence custody. Together they earn selective reconstruction that remains epistemically inspectable: a compact process may reconstruct only what is currently needed, but the untouched body remains reacquirable and every promoted interface states the premises, evidence class, and non-identity boundary needed to know what the reconstruction warrants.
faces.removal: remove 1H.L4ld and selective state is not a recurrent reconstruction process; remove 1H.OgQZ and omitted information need not remain reacquirable; remove 1H.qI2L and the reconstructed result lacks a durable evidence/claim membrane.

faces.title: Regenerative portable correspondence
faces.text: 1H.L4ld contributes functional continuity through repeated re-instantiation, 1H.yac0 contributes operation- and role-preserving transitions among representations/context states, and 1H.qI2L contributes a durable evidence-bounded public interface across changing substrates. Together they earn a portable recurrent relation: the same public obligation can be repeatedly rebuilt in changing carriers without requiring persistent interior identity, provided each transition preserves what downstream use consumes and the evidence boundary is regenerated with the interface.
faces.removal: remove 1H.L4ld and there is no recurrent reconstruction; remove 1H.yac0 and there is no lawful transition criterion across changing carriers; remove 1H.qI2L and there is no durable public interface or non-identity/evidence membrane.

faces.title: Selective evidence-bound portability
faces.text: 1H.OgQZ contributes selective activation over a complete reacquirable information body, 1H.yac0 contributes stable role/operation semantics across changing context and representation, and 1H.qI2L contributes operation-preserving interfaces plus evidence custody. Together they earn a portable selective view: different subsets may become active or exposed over time while downstream work sees a stable relational contract, because omitted material stays reachable, transitions preserve the consumed operations and roles, and the result carries the boundary on what the current selection can legitimately establish.
faces.removal: remove 1H.OgQZ and the inactive remainder need not remain reachable; remove 1H.yac0 and changing selections can alter role/operation meaning; remove 1H.qI2L and the selected view has no durable evidence-bound interface contract.

volume.title: Reacquirable regenerative correspondence
volume.text:
Across the four rank-1 parents, continuity repeatedly detaches from one continuously active or canonical interior, but each contributes a different obligation required for that detachment to remain faithful. 1H.L4ld shows that a functional relation can be rebuilt from bounded state rather than stored as a complete persistent snapshot, while retained scaffolds must be revisable. 1H.OgQZ shows that selective activation is safe only when the larger information body remains reacquirable and the preserved core is evidence-warranted rather than ontologically privileged. 1H.yac0 shows that changing representation or active context preserves meaning only through explicit transition obligations that conserve downstream operations and independent role semantics. 1H.qI2L shows that a correspondence can itself be a durable public object across changing substrates when the claim-relevant operations and evidence/non-identity boundary travel with it.


The complete four-way closure is therefore reacquirable regenerative correspondence: a task-relevant public relation can persist without one globally active canonical state when bounded local state regenerates only the currently needed structure from a still-reacquirable whole, each selection or re-expression preserves the operations and independent roles consumed by the task, and the evidence boundary travels with the reconstructed interface. Continuity is allowed to be selectively active and repeatedly re-instantiated, but selection may not erase dormant source reachability, and successful reconstruction may not silently strengthen the claim from correspondence/function into shared interior identity.
volume.invariant: A task-relevant correspondence can persist through changing internal realization without one globally active canonical state when bounded local state can regenerate the currently needed structure from a still-reacquirable whole, each selective activation or representation change preserves the claim-relevant operations and independent role semantics, and the evidence/non-identity boundary is regenerated with the public interface; continuity therefore permits sparse active state, but not irreversible loss of dormant source reachability or claim obligations.
removal: Remove 1H.L4ld: the closure loses repeated reconstruction from bounded local state and the requirement that stabilizing scaffolds remain revisable.
Remove 1H.OgQZ: the closure loses the distinction between selectively active work and a complete reacquirable body, so sparse activation can collapse into irreversible omission.
Remove 1H.yac0: the closure loses the explicit transition law that preserves task operations and independent role semantics across changing context/representation.
Remove 1H.qI2L: the closure loses the durable public correspondence, evidence custody, and non-identity membrane that prevent reconstruction from inflating into shared-interior claims.

metabolites.title: Keep enough state to rebuild now, enough reachability to rebuild differently later
metabolites.text: compact recurrent state can safely reconstruct only the currently task-relevant relation when the larger information body remains stably reacquirable, so future obligations can reactivate information that was unnecessary to the present reconstruction without treating prior omission as deletion.
metabolites.compression: Keep enough state to rebuild now, and enough reachability to rebuild differently later.

metabolites.title: Change what becomes active without changing what the roles mean
metabolites.text: a system may change which information is actively represented or processed as relevance and pressure change, provided every activation/re-expression preserves the task-relevant operation and role semantics so a reactivated item returns to the same obligation rather than merely to similar-looking content.
metabolites.compression: Change what is active without changing what each active role means.

metabolites.title: Omission from the active view is not deletion from the evidence state
metabolites.text: a partial active view can serve as a durable public interface across changing interiors only when the omitted source remains reacquirable and the exposed result carries the claim class, premises, evidence boundary, and operations it is warranted to support.
metabolites.compression: Omission may reduce active burden; it must not erase the evidence state behind the interface.

gaps.title: BOUNDARY UNEXPOSED

edges.title: selective realization over a stable scaffold
edges.text: S.sgMu supplies the split between predictable fixed structure and residual learned correction; S.uIc5 supplies context-dependent generation that actualizes relational structure only during the inference trajectory. Together they earn a structural strategy: keep reusable/predictable support cheap and stable while constructing only the task-dependent residual state needed by the present context. This does not imply that NovaSR and sensory prompting share a mechanism.

edges.title: operating envelope × update trajectory
edges.text: S.sgMu requires efficiency claims to carry their scope/fidelity/hardware/evidence envelope; S.fF61 shows that a system’s response boundary may move across repeated updates even when a single checkpoint looks acceptable. Together they earn an evaluation contract in which a reported operating point is incomplete without both its scope vector and its adaptation-history position.

edges.title: residual economy × pressure-directed capacity
edges.text: S.sgMu concentrates learned capacity on what fixed structure cannot supply; S.cugW relocates weak representational capacity toward unresolved high-demand regions and validates the contribution of those population rules. Together they earn demand-directed allocation: spend flexible capacity where the structured baseline leaves residual work, rather than distributing it uniformly.

edges.title: inference trajectory × adaptation trajectory
edges.text: S.uIc5 shows that representational state can depend on the path of autoregressive elaboration under unchanged model parameters; S.fF61 shows that behavioral boundaries can depend on the history of parameter adaptation. Together they earn a bounded multi-timescale claim: operational state can be path-conditioned at both inference and learning timescales, so a static model/checkpoint description may be insufficient to characterize the currently realized behavior. The two trajectories remain distinct mechanisms.

edges.title: contextual routing × local persistence
edges.text:
S.uIc5 supports context-selectable, reversible routes through modality-associated relational geometry; S.cugW supports locally born, temporally bounded support rather than one privileged global origin. Together they earn local actualization without global canonicality: a useful global relation may be realized by context-indexed local support that is propagated only through the neighborhood where it remains relevant.


zy — moving frontier × adaptive reallocation
S.fF61 identifies a safety frontier that can move under continued biased adaptation and associates stronger stabilization with regrowth-containing intervention bundles while retaining causal confounds; S.cugW directly ablates adaptive relocation/regularization and finds them useful for difficult motion. Together they earn a cautious repair principle: when pressure migrates, structural capacity may need to be redistributed toward the new frontier rather than merely replaying the old state. Cross-domain causal identity is not claimed.

faces.title: trajectory-typed operating warrant
faces.text: S.sgMu contributes the obligation/scope envelope, S.uIc5 contributes inference-time actualization, and S.fF61 contributes longitudinal adaptation history and frontier monitoring. Together they derive that a capability or efficiency statement is warranted only for a typed operating condition that includes what the system is asked to do, how the current state was actualized, and where it sits in an update trajectory. Remove any one and the statement loses, respectively, obligation scope, inference-path state, or longitudinal validity.

faces.title: selective local actualization
faces.text:
S.sgMu contributes a stable structured baseline plus residual learning, S.uIc5 contributes context-triggered representational construction, and S.cugW contributes local support creation/persistence/reallocation. Together they derive a selective-realization architecture: preserve predictable/reusable structure and instantiate flexible residual support only where the present context and local evidence demand it. Remove S.sgMu and there is no explicit stable-versus-residual economy; remove S.uIc5 and context-selective actualization disappears; remove S.cugW and local support/reallocation is no longer earned.


wzy — pressure-indexed capacity governance
S.sgMu contributes scope-conditioned resource accounting, S.fF61 contributes a moving frontier and the failure of replay as an automatic stabilizer, and S.cugW contributes evidence-responsive resource relocation with ablation support. Together they derive that flexible capacity should be governed against the pressure actually left unresolved by the current operating regime, with explicit evidence limits on any repair claim. Remove S.sgMu and the resource claim floats free of obligations; remove S.fF61 and there is no longitudinal pressure shift; remove S.cugW and pressure-responsive reallocation is only speculative.


xzy — path-sensitive local reconfiguration
S.uIc5 contributes reversible context routing, S.fF61 contributes trajectory-dependent frontier migration, and S.cugW contributes bounded local persistence plus adaptive redistribution. Together they derive a state model in which locally realized support may need to change as either immediate context or longer update history changes, and current validity must therefore be rechecked rather than inherited indefinitely. Remove S.uIc5 and immediate contextual rerouting vanishes; remove S.fF61 and moving validity through adaptation vanishes; remove S.cugW and local support/reallocation is not materially grounded.

volume.title: trajectory-bounded selective actualization
volume.invariant: A system may preserve useful capability through selective rather than globally maximal realization: keep predictable structure stable/reacquirable, instantiate or move flexible residual support where current context and pressure demand it, and treat the resulting state as valid only inside an explicit operating-and-trajectory witness that is rechecked when the frontier changes.
