edges.title: Portable continuity must carry its revocation scope
edges.text: 2H.dxL5 supplies an obligation-minimal portable kernel, evidence boundary, and pressure surface. 2H.SruR supplies the explicit operation-level obligation, locally warranted nuisance quotient, and revocable continuity/equivalence warrant. Together they earn a stricter portable object: what crosses a carrier or representation boundary cannot be only the regenerated relation; it must also carry the current quotient, evidence regime, and conditions under which the relation stops counting as the same warranted continuity.
edges.removal:
without 2H.dxL5 there is no pressure-qualified portable kernel to transport; without 2H.SruR there is no explicit local quotient or revocation state telling the transported relation when its equivalence scope has expired.
Boundary: portability does not make a locally warranted quotient global.

edges.title: A portable kernel is also a revisable scaffold contract
edges.text: 2H.dxL5 supplies a compact obligation-specific relational kernel plus pressure-aligned tests. 2H.AvDK supplies a bounded regenerative scaffold whose sufficiency and warrant must be revised when regime or stabilizing bias changes. Together they earn adaptive portability: a compact kernel is a lawful carrier only while its scaffold remains sufficient for the named obligation, and pressure that exposes insufficiency must be able to force reconstruction rather than merely flag a failed copy.
edges.removal:
without 2H.dxL5 there is no earned noncanonical portability/pressure surface; without 2H.AvDK the portable kernel has no living scaffold lifecycle or regime-triggered revision path.
Boundary: compactness is not an intrinsic virtue and does not override current sufficiency.

edges.title: Minimal portability requires a dormant-source return path
edges.text: 2H.dxL5 permits an obligation-specific kernel to omit unrelated interior detail while demanding evidence custody and pressure tests. 2H._phq permits sparse active state only while the larger source/evidence body remains exactly reacquirable by stable role. Together they earn reversible minimization: a portable interface may stay small, but every omission that could later become load-bearing must remain addressable so a failed pressure test can reopen the support that compact realization left dormant.
edges.removal:
without 2H.dxL5 there is no obligation-minimal portable kernel or failure pressure; without 2H._phq omission need not preserve a role-stable route back to dormant evidence.
Boundary: addressability does not guarantee the reopened material will repair the relation.

edges.title: Revocation must trigger both quotient and scaffold re-estimation
edges.text: 2H.SruR makes the continuity warrant conditional on operation, local nuisance quotient, evidence boundary, and carrier sufficiency. 2H.AvDK makes the regenerative scaffold and its warrant explicitly revisable under task, regime, or stabilizing-bias change. Together they earn actionable revocation: when continuity expires, the system must re-estimate both what differences are still allowed to be ignored and what scaffold is sufficient to reconstruct the obligation in the new regime.
edges.removal:
without 2H.SruR scaffold revision lacks an explicit equivalence/quotient membrane; without 2H.AvDK quotient revocation lacks a scaffold/regime revision lifecycle capable of producing a successor realization.
Boundary: revocation diagnoses loss of warrant, not the unique repair.

edges.title: A failed quotient can address reacquisition
edges.text: 2H.SruR supplies a local quotient whose nuisance status can expire and whose warrant can be revoked. 2H._phq supplies exact dormant-source reachability and role-stable reactivation. Together they earn targeted reopening: when a previously ignored difference becomes consequential, the failed quotient can act as an address into dormant evidence, identifying which roles or distinctions must be reactivated rather than treating all omitted state as equally relevant.
edges.removal:
without 2H.SruR there is no explicit ignored-difference class whose failure can localize the repair target; without 2H._phq the revoked quotient has no stable route to reopen the implicated dormant evidence.
Boundary: a failed quotient may identify what must be reconsidered without proving how it should be represented next.

edges.title: Reacquisition must rebuild the current scaffold, not restore the old one
edges.text: 2H.AvDK supplies regime/scaffold revision and the rule that a formerly successful stabilizer can become bias. 2H._phq supplies a reacquirable whole and role-stable return from dormant support. Together they earn current-regime reconstitution: reopened evidence is not used merely to restore an earlier arrangement; it must be allowed to reshape the active scaffold and be retested against the present obligation and regime.
edges.removal:
without 2H.AvDK reacquisition can devolve into restoration of a stale scaffold; without 2H._phq revision lacks a reliable route back to omitted evidence and role structure.
Boundary: reopened evidence expands the candidate repair space but does not automatically validate any one revision.

faces.title: Revocable portable reconstruction contract
faces.text: 2H.dxL5 contributes the pressure-tested portable kernel; 2H.SruR contributes the local quotient and revocable continuity/equivalence state; 2H.AvDK contributes scaffold and regime revision. Together they earn a portable continuity contract whose authority is versioned by current pressure: a noncanonical carrier may transport the relation only while the obligation, quotient, evidence boundary, and scaffold jointly remain sufficient. Failure retires the current contract and requires both quotient and scaffold to be re-estimated before a successor can be warranted.
faces.removal:
remove 2H.dxL5 and the face loses portability-specific pressure; remove 2H.SruR and it loses the explicit local quotient/revocation membrane; remove 2H.AvDK and it loses the scaffold/regime revision lifecycle.
Boundary: without 2H._phq this face does not yet require a role-addressable path back to omitted support.

faces.title: Quotient-addressable portable repair
faces.text: 2H.dxL5 contributes a minimal portable kernel and pressure witness; 2H.SruR contributes a revocable local quotient; 2H._phq contributes exact dormant evidence reacquisition by stable role. Together they earn diagnosable repair: a pressure failure can be represented as failure of a particular obligation/equivalence scope, and the failed quotient can reopen the omitted distinctions required to test whether the portable relation can be reconstructed rather than merely copied again.
faces.removal:
remove 2H.dxL5 and there is no independent portability pressure; remove 2H.SruR and failure cannot be localized to an explicit quotient/equivalence scope; remove 2H._phq and no exact return path to omitted support is required.
Boundary: without 2H.AvDK the face does not independently require that the reopened material reshape a stale scaffold under the new regime.

faces.title: Evidence-custodied adaptive portability
faces.text: 2H.dxL5 contributes obligation-minimal portability and evidence boundary; 2H.AvDK contributes a revisable regenerative scaffold and warrant-as-state; 2H._phq contributes a still-reacquirable whole and custody of omitted material. Together they earn portable adaptation without evidential amnesia: the active carrier may remain compact and change, while dormant material stays reachable and old versus revised warrants remain distinguishable as the scaffold adapts.
faces.removal:
remove 2H.dxL5 and there is no portable-kernel pressure discipline; remove 2H.AvDK and adaptation lacks explicit scaffold/warrant revision; remove 2H._phq and omitted evidence need not survive as a reopenable body.
Boundary: without 2H.SruR the face does not explicitly state which ignored differences constituted the old equivalence scope.

faces.title: Revocation-driven reacquisition and reconstruction
faces.text: 2H.SruR contributes the local quotient and revocation trigger; 2H.AvDK contributes regime/scaffold revision and living warrant state; 2H._phq contributes role-stable dormant evidence reacquisition. Together they earn a bounded repair loop: revoke the current warrant, identify which formerly ignored or omitted distinctions have become load-bearing, reopen the implicated evidence, revise both scaffold and equivalence scope, regenerate the candidate relation, and retest it in the current regime.
faces.removal:
remove 2H.SruR and repair loses the explicit failed quotient/operation scope; remove 2H.AvDK and it loses scaffold/regime revision; remove 2H._phq and it loses role-addressable reacquisition.
Boundary: without 2H.dxL5 this face does not independently earn portability under pressure across noncanonical carriers.

volume.title: Quotient-addressable continuity reconstitution
volume.text:
Across all four parents, continuity can already survive changing realization without requiring one canonical interior. The all-four closure adds an addressable repair law to the validity machinery. 2H.dxL5 makes the portable object an obligation-specific relational kernel whose sufficiency is exposed to relevant carrier/representation pressure. 2H.SruR makes equivalence explicit as a locally warranted quotient carried by a revocable continuity warrant. 2H.AvDK makes the regenerative scaffold and its warrant revisable when regime or stabilizing bias changes. 2H._phq makes sparse realization reversible by preserving exact, role-stable reacquisition of dormant source/evidence.


The complete closure is therefore quotient-addressable continuity reconstitution: a selectively realized relation may count as continuous across changing carrier, representation, and regime only while its obligation-specific portable kernel, current local quotient, load-bearing context/evidence boundary, and regenerative scaffold remain jointly witnessed. When pressure, task change, regime drift, or carrier insufficiency revokes that warrant, lawful repair must treat the failed quotient as an address rather than merely a verdict: distinctions previously licensed as nuisance must become candidates for reactivation, the implicated dormant evidence must be reopened by stable role, both quotient and scaffold must be revised under the present obligation, and the regenerated relation must survive current portability and adequacy pressure before a newly scoped warrant is issued. Reconstitution may restore continuity, but it may not inherit the expired equivalence scope or erase the evidential history that caused revocation.
volume.invariant: A continuity/equivalence claim over a selectively realized portable relation is warranted only while the relation’s current operation, local nuisance quotient, evidence boundary, and regenerative scaffold remain sufficient under relevant pressure. If that warrant fails, the failed quotient must preserve enough addressability to reopen previously ignored or dormant distinctions, revise the quotient and scaffold together, regenerate and retest the relation in the current regime, and issue any successor warrant as a new scoped state rather than silently carrying forward the expired one.
removal: Remove 2H.dxL5: the closure loses the obligation-minimal portable kernel and the dedicated pressure surface that distinguishes genuine portability from familiar-carrier success.
Remove 2H.SruR: the closure loses the explicit local nuisance quotient and revocable equivalence membrane, so failure cannot say which previously ignored differences must become reconsiderable.
Remove 2H.AvDK: the closure loses the scaffold/regime revision lifecycle and warrant-as-state needed to transform revocation into a successor realization rather than a dead stop.
Remove 2H._phq: the closure loses exact dormant-source reacquisition and role-stable reactivation, so a failed quotient cannot require a concrete return path to the support it had omitted.

metabolites.text: when a local continuity/equivalence quotient is revoked, the class of previously ignored distinctions should remain addressable enough to reopen the dormant evidence and roles implicated by the failure instead of triggering an undirected reset.
metabolites.compression: a failed quotient should know what it had permission to ignore.

metabolites.text: a revised carrier/scaffold receives a new continuity/equivalence warrant only after the revised quotient and exact portable obligation survive the current regime and pressure surface; resemblance to the prior relation cannot reissue authority by itself.
metabolites.compression: repair can propose equivalence; pressure must reissue it.

metabolites.text: repairing a portable relation from reacquired evidence must preserve the old quotient, revoked state, reopened evidence scope, and newly tested quotient as distinct historical states so revision cannot retroactively turn earlier omission into stronger assurance.
metabolites.compression: revision may change what can be ignored; it must not rewrite what was ignored before.

edges.title: Selective activation must be locally valid
edges.text: 1H.OgQZ separates a fully reacquirable information body from the subset currently activated or semantically processed. 1H.8KP9 establishes that sufficiency itself may be condition-local and that compression is unsafe when it erases distinctions capable of changing the downstream obligation. Together they earn a selection criterion: keeping most of a body inactive is admissible only when the inactive whole remains reacquirable and the active carrier preserves every distinction required by the current local validity regime. A regime change invalidates the old selection until sufficiency is re-estimated.
edges.removal: without 1H.OgQZ there is no whole-versus-active distinction or custodial reachability; without 1H.8KP9 there is no condition-indexed sufficiency test or regime-change trigger.

edges.title: Reacquirable reconstruction can be witnessed relationally
edges.text: 1H.OgQZ preserves exact reachability and evidence boundaries across selective re-instantiation. 1H.2VF2 shows that reconstruction may be judged by an externally readable relational invariant rather than sameness of parts or implementation. Together they earn a reconstructive criterion: selected state may be regenerated from a reacquirable body when the obligation-defining external relation is recovered and its evidence boundary remains attached.
edges.removal: without 1H.OgQZ the untouched/source body and claim custody can disappear; without 1H.2VF2 there is no earned relational reconstruction witness independent of element identity.

edges.title: Selection becomes a trajectory-typed operating claim
edges.text: 1H.OgQZ permits selective activation while requiring source reachability and claim custody. 1H.ujF6 shows that the realized operating state depends on the current inference/adaptation trajectory and that frontiers may move. Together they earn a stronger rule: every selective representation is a situated operating claim, not a timeless compression. Its warrant must carry the operating envelope and trajectory position, and it must be rechecked when the frontier changes.
edges.removal: without 1H.OgQZ there is no selective/custodial state to type; without 1H.ujF6 there is no path/frontier coordinate that can make yesterday’s valid selection stale.

edges.title: Reconstructed relations are valid only inside earned regimes
edges.text: 1H.8KP9 provides local validity and recurrent revalidation. 1H.2VF2 provides reconstruction through externally recoverable relational geometry. Together they earn a locally typed equivalence criterion: a regenerated relational carrier counts as continuity only in the condition regime where the obligation-defining external relation survives appropriate tests; correspondence in one regime does not license global equivalence.
edges.removal: without 1H.8KP9 the external relation lacks a local validity field; without 1H.2VF2 there is no relational reconstruction/external correspondence object to test.

edges.title: Validity is path-local as well as condition-local
edges.text: 1H.8KP9 makes validity dependent on context/input regime and requires re-estimation when conditions change. 1H.ujF6 makes realized capability dependent on inference and adaptation history and requires frontier-sensitive rechecking. Together they earn a two-coordinate validity field: the current warrant is indexed both by local operating conditions and by the trajectory that produced the realized state. Change in either coordinate can revoke inherited sufficiency.
edges.removal: without 1H.8KP9 condition-local validity disappears; without 1H.ujF6 trajectory/frontier dependence disappears.

edges.title: Dynamic relational state can be re-instantiated where pressure moves
edges.text: 1H.2VF2 establishes that relevant relational geometry may be latent and reproducibly actualized rather than permanently explicit. 1H.ujF6 establishes that flexible residual support can be selectively instantiated or moved toward current pressure. Together they earn pressure-indexed relational re-instantiation: a system may regenerate the externally testable relation only where and when the present obligation requires it, while rechecking fidelity as context or longer-term trajectory moves.
edges.removal: without 1H.2VF2 there is no earned relation-generating reconstruction; without 1H.ujF6 there is no pressure-sensitive allocation or trajectory-bounded realization.

faces.title: Condition-indexed selective reconstruction contract
faces.text: 1H.OgQZ contributes reacquirable whole-body custody and selective activation; 1H.8KP9 contributes local sufficiency/validity; 1H.2VF2 contributes relational reconstruction plus external validation. Together they earn a contract in which the system may leave most source state inactive and reconstruct only the relation required now, but continuity is admitted only if obligation-changing distinctions survive the current local regime and the regenerated relation passes its independent external witness.
faces.removal: remove 1H.OgQZ and source reachability/custody is lost; remove 1H.8KP9 and the current regime cannot bound sufficiency; remove 1H.2VF2 and the reconstructed carrier lacks an earned external relational criterion.

faces.title: Revocable selective operating warrant
faces.text: 1H.OgQZ contributes selection with retained evidence debt; 1H.8KP9 contributes a locally varying sufficiency membrane; 1H.ujF6 contributes trajectory/frontier dependence. Together they earn a revocable operating warrant: a selected active state is authorized only for the current obligation, local regime, and realized trajectory. If context or frontier moves, old authorization expires and the active subset must be re-estimated and retested rather than merely replayed.
faces.removal: remove 1H.OgQZ and there is no source-grounded selection; remove 1H.8KP9 and no regime-local revocation condition; remove 1H.ujF6 and no trajectory/frontier revocation condition.

faces.title: Re-instantiated active relation with provenance
faces.text: 1H.OgQZ contributes reacquirable source/evidence custody, 1H.2VF2 contributes relation-level reconstruction, and 1H.ujF6 contributes selective actualization along a situated trajectory. Together they earn a mobile active representation whose concrete support may change while the source ancestry, claim boundary, and obligation-defining external relation remain available for reacquisition and retest.
faces.removal: remove 1H.OgQZ and provenance/source reachability can be erased; remove 1H.2VF2 and there is no relational identity to regenerate; remove 1H.ujF6 and no path-sensitive selective actualization is earned.

faces.title: Trajectory-local relational validity
faces.text: 1H.8KP9 contributes local validity and regenerative revalidation, 1H.2VF2 contributes externally testable relational geometry, and 1H.ujF6 contributes path-conditioned actualization and moving-frontier checks. Together they earn an operational identity test indexed to both regime and trajectory: the same relational obligation must remain externally recoverable in the currently realized state, and any relevant change in local conditions or path reopens validation.
faces.removal: remove 1H.8KP9 and locality of validity disappears; remove 1H.2VF2 and the relation to be recovered/tested disappears; remove 1H.ujF6 and path/frontier dependence disappears.

volume.title: Trajectory-local reconstructive continuity
volume.text:
Across all four parents, continuity separates from the persistence of one globally active form. 1H.OgQZ keeps the complete source/evidence body reacquirable while permitting selective activation. 1H.8KP9 makes carrier sufficiency local to the conditions that can alter the obligation. 1H.2VF2 allows the active state to be regenerated as an externally testable relational geometry rather than copied as an element inventory. 1H.ujF6 makes the realized state and its warrant dependent on the inference/adaptation trajectory and on pressure at a moving frontier.


The all-four closure is therefore trajectory-local reconstructive continuity: task-relevant continuation may survive selective and reconstructed realization when the complete source body and evidence boundary remain reacquirable; the active state is a regenerated relational carrier whose externally relevant obligation can be retested; every distinction capable of changing that obligation remains represented relative to the current local validity regime; and the continuity warrant is indexed to the current inference/adaptation trajectory. When either regime or frontier changes, the inherited warrant expires and must be re-earned through reacquisition, selective relational reconstruction, and renewed local/trajectory testing.
volume.invariant: Continuity can be carried by a revocable contract over reacquisition → selective relational reconstruction → local-and-trajectory retest rather than by one permanently active or materially identical state, provided source/evidence custody remains intact and every obligation-changing distinction remains recoverable.
removal: Remove 1H.OgQZ: the closure loses the reacquirable whole versus selectively active distinction and the custody membrane preserving inactive evidence.
Remove 1H.8KP9: the closure loses condition-local sufficiency and the requirement to re-estimate validity when the operating regime changes.
Remove 1H.2VF2: the closure loses relational reconstruction and an external witness that can validate continuation without element/implementation identity.
Remove 1H.ujF6: the closure loses inference/adaptation trajectory, moving-frontier pressure, and the requirement to revalidate a realized state when its path changes.

4H.3W-6.title: self-reconstituting continuity lineage
4H.3W-6.boundary: This child is a cross-holon relational synthesis over four already-metabolized 3H organisms. Every parent carries heterogeneous source evidence and explicit scope/failure boundaries. Nothing here converts structural recurrence into a universal mechanism, makes continuity into interior identity, guarantees successful repair, or treats a successor warrant as evidence that one substrate or mechanism persisted. The child promotes only relations requiring these complete parent bodies together and preserves predecessor evidence scopes as historical rather than retroactively strengthened support.

edges.title: repair becomes versioned succession
edges.text: 3H.DfDL supplies targeted post-revocation reacquisition/reconstruction; 3H.UoYa supplies explicit current/predecessor/successor warrant versions and a classifier for scope-changing events. Together they earn a succession rule in which a repair after warrant failure produces a separately evidenced successor version rather than silently modifying the predecessor.
edges.removal: without DfDL, version expiry lacks a targeted route through implicated dormant evidence to repair; without UoYa, successful repair lacks explicit predecessor/successor authority and change classification.

edges.title: revocation conditions can route repair
edges.text: 3H.DfDL supplies the reacquire→reconstruct→retest path; 3H.k0uZ supplies a contract that carries the conditions capable of falsifying itself plus independent revision channels for map and retained scaffold. Together they earn failure-directed reconstitution: the reason continuity failed can select which evidential/scaffold tissue is reopened and which revision channel is exercised.
edges.removal: without DfDL, self-revocation has no earned exact reconstitution path; without k0uZ, reacquisition lacks a reflexive classifier distinguishing transition-map mismatch from obsolete stabilizing memory.

edges.title: a replayable passport can be a recovery program
edges.text: 3H.DfDL supplies exact post-failure reacquisition and reconstitution; 3H.x3Cd supplies the portable executable contract, evidence pointers and replay tests. Together they earn a recovery-bearing passport whose portable state can reopen the evidence needed to rebuild itself after revocation instead of only proving that the old warrant failed.
edges.removal: without DfDL, the passport can revoke/replay tests but not require targeted reopening of omitted evidence; without x3Cd, reconstitution is not packaged as portable executable continuity state.

edges.title: continuity authority can version itself from witnessed failure
edges.text: 3H.UoYa supplies lifecycle/version succession and boundary classification; 3H.k0uZ supplies self-invalidating conditions and dual revision of map and memory. Together they earn reflexive versioning: the contract can distinguish an admissible within-version change from a failure that requires a successor version, and can identify which internal validity machinery must change.
edges.removal: without UoYa, reflexive failure lacks explicit authority-version succession; without k0uZ, version transitions depend on externally supplied failure interpretation rather than conditions carried by the contract.

edges.title: the executable passport can carry lineage, not only a current warrant
edges.text: 3H.UoYa supplies immutable predecessor provenance and successor versions; 3H.x3Cd supplies portable replay state and tests. Together they earn a versioned executable passport in which the current warrant travels together with the evidence/test path that produced it and the predecessor it superseded.
edges.removal: without UoYa, passport replay does not by itself establish version lineage; without x3Cd, version history lacks a portable executable procedure for re-earning current authority.

edges.title: portability can include its own audit and revision membrane
edges.text: 3H.k0uZ supplies self-falsification, pressure witnesses and dual revision; 3H.x3Cd supplies an executable portable continuity passport. Together they earn a self-auditing portable contract: the reason continuity presently counts travels with the contract together with conditions that can revoke it and revise its reconstruction map/scaffold.
edges.removal: without k0uZ, the portable passport has tests but lacks the full reflexive map/memory revision membrane; without x3Cd, reflexive continuity lacks a portable executable carrier for those tests and conditions.

faces.title: failure-classified successor reconstitution
faces.text: DfDL + UoYa + k0uZ jointly earn a cycle that detects a continuity failure, classifies whether scope/regime or scaffold invalidated the current warrant, reopens the implicated dormant evidence, revises the appropriate map/memory channel, retests the rebuilt relation, and—only after success—issues a successor version while preserving the predecessor.
faces.removal: remove DfDL and the cycle loses exact evidence reacquisition/reconstruction; remove UoYa and it loses predecessor/successor authority plus change classification; remove k0uZ and it loses self-carried invalidation conditions and dual revision.

faces.title: replayable repair lineage
faces.text: DfDL + UoYa + x3Cd jointly earn a portable audit chain from expired warrant through targeted reacquisition and reconstruction to a tested successor passport. Each transition can preserve what evidence justified the predecessor, what failure revoked it, what tissue was reopened, and which replay tests earned the successor.
faces.removal: remove DfDL and the lineage has no exact post-failure reconstitution path; remove UoYa and it has no explicit version succession; remove x3Cd and the lineage is not executable/portable as replay state.

faces.title: self-repairing replay kernel
faces.text: DfDL + k0uZ + x3Cd jointly earn a portable kernel that carries both the conditions for detecting its own invalidity and the evidence hooks needed to attempt repair. Failure can open targeted evidence, revise map or scaffold, rebuild, and replay tests without assuming a fixed interior.
faces.removal: remove DfDL and the kernel cannot require targeted reopening of dormant evidence; remove k0uZ and failure lacks reflexive diagnosis/revision channels; remove x3Cd and the repair law is not carried as executable portable state.

faces.title: self-versioning portable warrant
faces.text: UoYa + k0uZ + x3Cd jointly earn a portable continuity object that knows which warrant version is current, preserves predecessor provenance, carries the tests and invalidation conditions that can revoke current authority, and can fork a successor after a classified boundary/regime/scaffold change.
faces.removal: remove UoYa and explicit version lineage disappears; remove k0uZ and the object loses reflexive map/memory invalidation; remove x3Cd and the warrant lifecycle loses its executable portable replay carrier.

volume.title: self-reconstituting continuity lineage
volume.text:
All four parents together turn continuity authority from a single reflexive/versioned/replayable warrant into a regenerable lineage. 3H.k0uZ contributes a contract that carries conditions capable of falsifying its own validity and distinguishes revision of transition map from revision of retained scaffold. 3H.UoYa contributes classification of change plus explicit predecessor/current/successor authority. 3H.x3Cd contributes a portable executable passport carrying obligation, evidence pointers, transition law and replay tests. 3H.DfDL contributes the missing post-failure regenerative motion: reopen the exact implicated dormant evidence, reconstruct, retest under current pressure/regime, and issue a newly scoped warrant without rewriting the predecessor.


The complete closure is therefore a self-reconstituting continuity lineage: a continuity warrant may remain reusable across carrier, representation, regime, scaffold and support-boundary change only when the current executable contract carries the conditions that can invalidate it, preserves a versioned predecessor history, and retains enough addressable evidence/scaffold state to attempt a lawful successor reconstruction. On failure, the lineage classifies the rupture, preserves the expired warrant as bounded provenance, reopens only the implicated evidence/roles, revises map/scaffold as warranted, rebuilds and replays the current tests, and admits a successor only after fresh witness. Continuity here is neither unbroken sameness nor guaranteed recovery; it is the preserved capacity to explain, revoke, reconstruct and re-earn its own authority across generations of warrants.
volume.invariant: A changing realization may be treated as one continuing public relation across successive failures and repairs only when every current warrant is (1) executable and replayable, (2) reflexively falsifiable under declared regime/scaffold/support conditions, (3) explicitly versioned against preserved predecessors, and (4) backed by addressable evidence/scaffold tissue sufficient to attempt targeted reconstitution after revocation. A successor gains authority only from fresh replayed evidence; predecessor authority remains historically bounded. The lineage is continuous insofar as the procedure and evidence boundaries for revoking and re-earning continuity remain re-enterable—not because one interior, mechanism or warrant survives unchanged.
removal: Remove 3H.DfDL: the closure retains a reflexive, versioned, executable continuity lifecycle but loses the requirement and route for targeted reacquisition/reconstitution from implicated dormant evidence after failure.

Remove 3H.UoYa: the closure can detect, replay and repair continuity but loses explicit predecessor/current/successor authority and the classifier separating within-version change from version-changing rupture.

Remove 3H.k0uZ: the closure can version, replay and reconstitute warrants but loses the reflexive validity machinery that distinguishes map revision from memory/scaffold revision and carries its own falsification conditions.

Remove 3H.x3Cd: the closure can classify, revoke and reconstitute versioned continuity but loses the portable executable passport that carries obligation/evidence/transition/tests as replayable state.

metabolites.title: REVOCATION-ROUTED-SUCCESSION
metabolites.text: when a current continuity warrant fails, the failure classification should determine both which evidential/scaffold tissue is reopened and whether the result is a repaired within-scope realization or a separately authorized successor version; the predecessor remains immutable provenance.
metabolites.compression: let the reason for revocation route the next lawful warrant.

metabolites.title: EXECUTABLE-SUCCESSOR-PASSPORT
metabolites.text: a successor continuity warrant is portable only when it carries not merely the new obligation but also predecessor provenance, the reacquisition/reconstruction path used after failure, and the replay tests whose fresh success earned current authority.
metabolites.compression: a successor passport carries how it became authorized.

metabolites.title: SELF-RECONSTITUTING-CONTINUITY-LINEAGE
metabolites.text: durable continuity across repeated carrier/regime/scaffold changes is a re-enterable lineage process when each warrant can expose the conditions that revoke it, classify the rupture, reopen the implicated evidence, revise the appropriate reconstruction machinery, replay its tests, and append a newly authorized successor while preserving all prior scopes.
metabolites.compression: continuity survives by keeping the path to re-earn continuity alive.

edges.title: Evidence-backed reconstructible contract
edges.text: 2H._phq supplies exact reacquirability of dormant evidence and the rule that omission from active state is not deletion from the evidence state. 2H.Dzmx supplies a role-separated minimal contract specifying the public obligation, operations, evidence membrane, and scaffold needed to rebuild the relation. Together they earn a stronger contract law: a compact reconstructible contract can remain small only if the evidence and dormant distinctions it omits from current active state stay addressable enough to reopen when the contract fails or its obligations change.
edges.removal:
without 2H._phq the reduced contract can become irreversibly lossy; without 2H.Dzmx reacquirable material lacks a typed minimal public obligation defining what must be reconstructed.
Boundary: addressability of evidence does not by itself certify the contract; the rebuilt relation still requires current testing.

edges.title: Reacquisition is not expansion
edges.text: 2H._phq permits dormant material to be reactivated and a public relation to be reconstructed from a larger reachable body. 2H.MKvK separates improved access/reallocation from genuine expansion of the possibility frontier. Together they require a strict classification: reopening previously reachable evidence or support may change realized performance without enlarging the supported field; a growth claim still needs a boundary-crossing witness beyond the prior reachable body.
edges.removal:
without 2H._phq there is no explicit dormant/reacquirable body whose reopening can improve realization; without 2H.MKvK there is no independent support-boundary test separating reacquisition from expansion.
Boundary: reacquisition can enable new outcomes relative to the active slice while remaining inside an older global support boundary.

edges.title: Custodied regime-revalidatable reconstruction
edges.text: 2H._phq supplies evidence custody and reacquisition behind selective reconstruction. 2H.AvDK supplies a living continuity warrant composed of operational obligation, evidence/reacquisition boundary, scaffold assumptions, and validity regime. Together they earn a reconstruction rule in which the evidence required to challenge or repair the current continuity claim remains reachable and the conditions under which reconstruction stops counting as the same function travel with the state.
edges.removal:
without 2H._phq dormant evidence can disappear from the repair path; without 2H.AvDK there is no explicit validity/warrant state able to revoke an apparently successful reconstruction.
Boundary: a reachable source body is not sufficient unless current obligation and validity conditions are retested.

edges.title: Contract-scoped frontier audit
edges.text: 2H.Dzmx supplies a typed reconstructible public contract and pressure-aligned sufficiency tests. 2H.MKvK supplies the distinction between elastic realization within a frontier and genuine frontier expansion. Together they make before/after claims commensurable: the same named obligation, role semantics, and evidence membrane define what is being compared, while a separate boundary witness determines whether the changed realization remains an instance of the old support or has enlarged it.
edges.removal:
without 2H.Dzmx there is no stable typed object against which before/after realization can be compared; without 2H.MKvK there is no criterion separating ordinary carrier elasticity from support expansion.
Boundary: a contract may remain satisfied while capability changes elsewhere; contract sufficiency is not a complete capability measure.

edges.title: Warrant-bearing reconstructible contract
edges.text: 2H.Dzmx supplies the minimal obligation set that lets a public relation be reconstructed across changing interiors. 2H.AvDK supplies the right-to-count-as-continuity as explicit living state carrying validity regime, scaffold assumptions, and revalidation conditions. Together they earn a warrant-bearing contract: every reconstructible public relation can carry not only what must be rebuilt but why the rebuilt relation currently counts, which evidence supports that judgment, and what conditions revoke it.
edges.removal:
without 2H.Dzmx the warrant lacks a sharply typed reconstruction target; without 2H.AvDK the contract lacks explicit validity state and revocation conditions.
Boundary: the existence of a warrant does not make it true outside its tested regime; it makes its scope and failure conditions inspectable.

edges.title: Boundary-classified warrant transition
edges.text: 2H.MKvK supplies a classification between ordinary access/reallocation and genuine support-boundary crossing, including the rule that true boundary change expires inherited continuity authority. 2H.AvDK supplies regime/scaffold-sensitive warrant state and a revision-triggered reconstruction path. Together they earn a transition discipline: ordinary carrier/access change can retain the current warrant after matched revalidation, whereas verified frontier crossing, regime departure, or scaffold failure retires the old warrant and requires a successor rather than silent extension.
edges.removal:
without 2H.MKvK changed performance cannot be classified against the old support frontier; without 2H.AvDK there is no explicit warrant lifecycle that can be revoked and reissued after classification.
Boundary: not every change forces a new warrant; the trigger must be a materially relevant boundary, regime, or scaffold event.

faces.title: Reacquirable frontier-audited contract
faces.text: 2H._phq contributes a dormant but exactly reacquirable body behind selective reconstruction, 2H.Dzmx contributes a role-separated public reconstruction contract, and 2H.MKvK contributes explicit frontier accounting. Together they earn an adaptive contract that can reopen omitted evidence as task pressure rises while distinguishing an expanded active realization from an actually enlarged support frontier.
faces.removal: remove 2H._phq and omitted evidence may be irrecoverable; remove 2H.Dzmx and there is no typed public obligation to reconstruct; remove 2H.MKvK and changed realization cannot be classified as access/reallocation versus expansion.

faces.title: Reacquirable warrant-bearing reconstruction
faces.text: 2H._phq contributes evidence custody and selective reacquisition, 2H.Dzmx contributes the typed minimal contract, and 2H.AvDK contributes explicit living validity/warrant state. Together they earn a reconstructible relation whose compact active carrier is backed by reopenable evidence and whose authority can be revoked when scaffold or regime assumptions fail.
faces.removal: remove 2H._phq and repair loses guaranteed evidence reachability; remove 2H.Dzmx and repair loses a precise reconstruction target; remove 2H.AvDK and repair loses explicit scope/revocation state.

faces.title: Reacquisition-mediated warrant renewal
faces.text: 2H._phq contributes the ability to reopen dormant source/evidence tissue; 2H.MKvK contributes the event that separates ordinary re-realization from genuine frontier change; 2H.AvDK contributes revision-triggered reconstruction and warrant-as-state. Together they earn a renewal path: when a boundary/regime/scaffold event invalidates current continuity authority, relevant dormant evidence can be reacquired and used to retest a revised reconstruction before a successor warrant is admitted.
faces.removal: remove 2H._phq and renewal may have no path back to omitted evidence; remove 2H.MKvK and there is no explicit distinction between ordinary access change and warrant-breaking frontier change; remove 2H.AvDK and no living warrant exists to revoke, revise, and renew.

faces.title: Versioned contract succession under boundary change
faces.text: 2H.Dzmx contributes a role-separated reconstructible contract, 2H.MKvK contributes boundary-triggered rewarranting, and 2H.AvDK contributes regime/scaffold-sensitive validity state. Together they earn predecessor/successor contract semantics: an old contract remains provenance when its validity envelope is left, while a revised typed contract must be independently tested before inheriting the continuity role.
faces.removal:
remove 2H.Dzmx and succession lacks a typed obligation object; remove 2H.MKvK and no support-boundary trigger distinguishes ordinary change from expansion; remove 2H.AvDK and there is no explicit living warrant state to retire or reissue.
Boundary: without 2H._phq this face alone does not guarantee that all evidence needed for repair remains reacquirable.

volume.title: Frontier-conditioned reconstructive continuity
volume.text:
Across all four parents, continuity is neither raw snapshot persistence nor mere output similarity. 2H._phq contributes exact reacquirability and evidence custody behind selective reconstruction. 2H.Dzmx contributes a role-separated minimal contract defining the relation that must be rebuilt. 2H.MKvK contributes the audit that distinguishes carrier/access change inside a known support from actual boundary expansion and forces fresh authority when that boundary is crossed. 2H.AvDK contributes the continuity warrant itself as living, regime/scaffold-sensitive state that can be revoked and revised.


The complete closure is frontier-conditioned reconstructive continuity: a public task relation can persist through selective, noncanonical, or reconstructed realization while its current typed contract, reacquirable backing evidence, role semantics, and validity warrant remain jointly addressable and testable. Ordinary carrier, routing, or access changes may retain the current warrant when matched tests close inside the witnessed frontier. Verified support-boundary crossing, departure from the witnessed validity regime, or scaffold failure retires the previous warrant into provenance. Lawful continuation then requires reacquiring the relevant evidence, reconstructing or revising the typed contract, pressure-testing it under the changed frontier/regime, and issuing a newly scoped successor warrant rather than silently inheriting authority.
volume.invariant: Continuity through changing realization is warranted only while the reconstructible public contract, its dormant evidential backing, the known support frontier, and the current validity warrant remain jointly addressable; ordinary access/carrier changes may preserve the current warrant after matched revalidation, but boundary crossing, regime departure, or scaffold failure must retire inherited authority and trigger evidence-backed reconstruction plus a freshly witnessed successor warrant.
removal: Remove 2H._phq: the closure loses exact reacquirability and evidence custody; a contract can be revised and rewarranted, but repair may silently proceed after omitted evidence has become inaccessible.

Remove 2H.Dzmx: the closure loses the role-separated reconstructible public obligation; evidence and warrants remain, but there is no minimal typed relational object that says precisely what must be rebuilt.
Remove 2H.MKvK: the closure loses the distinction between access/reallocation and actual support expansion plus the frontier-triggered expiry of inherited authority.

Remove 2H.AvDK: the closure loses warrant-as-state, local validity/scaffold revocation, and explicit revision-triggered reconstruction; frontier change can be detected but there is no living continuity authority to retire and renew.
All four are necessary for the complete volume.

metabolites.title: EVIDENCE-BACKED-RECONSTRUCTIBLE-CONTRACT
metabolites.text: a compact role-separated reconstruction contract remains lawful only while the evidence and dormant distinctions excluded from current active state remain exactly reacquirable enough to challenge, repair, or enlarge the contract when its named obligation changes or fails.
metabolites.compression: keep the contract small; keep the evidence path large enough to repair it.

metabolites.title: FRONTIER-CLASSIFIED-WARRANT
metabolites.text: before continuity authority is inherited across change, classify the change against the current support frontier and validity regime: ordinary access/reallocation may retain the warrant after matched revalidation, whereas verified frontier crossing, regime departure, or scaffold failure retires it.
metabolites.compression: classify the change before deciding whether continuity authority survives it.

metabolites.compression: revoke, reacquire, rebuild, retest, reissue; never silently inherit expired authority.

4H.Bbw6.title: quotient-indexed self-reconstituting continuity lineage
4H.Bbw6.boundary: This child is a structural synthesis over four already-metabolized rank-3 organisms. Their inherited lineages contain heterogeneous formal, empirical, architectural, software, conceptual, and source-level evidence. Nothing at rank 4 upgrades those classes into one causal mechanism, substrate-independent ontology, or universal theorem. “Continuity,” “warrant,” “quotient,” “reconstitution,” “version,” “repair,” and “successor” are bounded operational-relational terms already earned by the selected parent bodies. Correspondence does not imply interior identity; revocation does not guarantee repair; successful repair does not establish one persisting mechanism; and a successor warrant cannot retroactively strengthen the evidence scope of its predecessor. Feeling phenotype is not used in this derivation.

volume.title: quotient-indexed self-reconstituting continuity lineage
volume.text:
All four parents together turn the negative space of continuity—the distinctions a current warrant is explicitly permitted to ignore—into living lineage state. 3H.UoYa already makes continuity authority versioned and preserves predecessor/current/successor scope. 3H.DfDL already supplies targeted evidence reacquisition and reconstitution after revocation. 3H.k0uZ already makes each contract reflexively falsifiable with distinct transition-map and scaffold/memory revision paths. 3H.DWia contributes the missing addressable equivalence history: every current warrant may carry a local quotient that says which differences are licensed as nuisance, and failure of that quotient can point back to the exact distinctions and evidence that omission had suppressed.


The complete closure is therefore a quotient-indexed self-reconstituting continuity lineage. A current continuity warrant carries an operational obligation, evidence/reacquisition body, validity regime, support scope, reconstruction/transition machinery, falsifiers, and an explicit local quotient recording which distinctions are presently licensed to disappear from active consideration. On rupture, the lineage first classifies whether the event is an admissible within-version change or a loss of current authority. If authority fails, the expired warrant and its quotient remain immutable provenance. The failed obligation and quotient jointly route reacquisition toward implicated evidence and roles; quotient, transition map, and scaffold/memory are revised according to the witnessed failure; the public relation and its future invalidation machinery are reconstructed and retested; and a successor gains authority only after fresh witness. Crucially, a successor may not silently inherit its predecessor’s omissions: every distinction that remains classified as nuisance must be warranted again under the successor’s regime, scope, and reconstruction machinery.
volume.invariant: A continuity lineage is lawfully self-reconstituting across successive failures only when every current warrant carries (1) its operational obligation, evidence/scaffold body and falsifiers, (2) an explicit local quotient recording which distinctions are currently licensed as nuisance, (3) stable addresses from revoked warrant/quotient back to reacquirable evidence and roles, and (4) explicit version succession. After failure, any successor must re-earn not only the public relation but also the scope of what it is allowed to ignore; predecessor warrant and quotient remain immutable provenance.
removal: Remove 3H.DWia: the closure retains a self-reconstituting, versioned, reflexive continuity lineage but loses the exact quotient/ignored-difference ledger, quotient-addressed repair, and explicit gate against silent inheritance of nuisance status.

Remove 3H.UoYa: the closure can repair a reflexive quotiented contract but loses explicit predecessor/current/successor authorization and the classifier separating within-version change from version-changing rupture.
Remove 3H.DfDL: the closure can preserve and retire reflexive quotiented versions but loses the exact post-failure evidence reacquisition/reconstitution path required to earn a repaired state.

Remove 3H.k0uZ: the closure can version and targeted-repair quotiented warrants but loses the requirement that the repaired successor reconstruct its own self-falsification and distinct map-versus-memory revision machinery.

metabolites.title: NON-SILENT-QUOTIENT-INHERITANCE

edges.title: Adaptive growth changes the assurance surface
edges.text: w makes competence and even its carrier expand through reconstruction; x makes assurance relative to a declared condition class and its finite-sample/complexity debt. Together they earn that growth of capability or operating horizon cannot by itself extend an existing guarantee. A new reachable regime may require a richer condition class, new assumptions, or a weaker/error-controlled assurance statement. Remove w and there is no endogenous expansion pressure; remove x and there is no explicit assurance boundary to be crossed.

edges.title: Reconstructive continuity needs an explicit quotient of ignorable change
edges.text: w permits identity/function to persist while material or representational realization changes; y shows one concrete way representation differences can be lawfully ignored only under a declared equivalence/canonicalization procedure. Together they earn that reconstruction requires a witness of which differences are immaterial to identity at that layer. Remove w and canonicalization has no adaptive turnover problem to solve; remove y and reconstructive persistence lacks a reproducible account of which representational differences may be quotiented away.

edges.title: Rebuilding across representations requires transformed obligations, not copied claims
edges.text: w makes changing carriers and multiscale organization normal; z shows that when source and target observations differ, assurance must cross through an explicit relation and may change strength or meaning. Together they earn relation-mediated reconstruction: a rebuilt carrier can count as continued function only after the obligations relevant to the new representation have been transported and checked. Remove w and there is no self-reconstructive carrier transition; remove z and the claim crossing that transition has no formal transport discipline.

edges.title: Canonical sameness and validity scope are independent contracts
edges.text: x indexes predictive assurance by a condition/shift family; y indexes representational sameness by a data-model/canonicalization quotient. Together they earn that eliminating syntactic variance does not strengthen statistical validity, and refining assurance resolution does not alter what counts as the canonical object. Remove x and there is no guarantee-scope axis; remove y and there is no representation-equivalence axis.

edges.title: Cross-representation assurance must carry both transport relation and guarantee class
edges.text: x shows that assurance strength depends on the declared condition family and error/complexity budget; z shows that properties crossing representation boundaries are transformed by a relation and typed by observation/property class. Together they earn a two-coordinate evidence boundary: what is transported and over which conditions it is guaranteed must travel together. Remove x and the condition-resolution debt disappears; remove z and representation/observation mismatch is silently normalized away.

edges.title: Quotient equivalence is not the same operation as relational translation
edges.text: y shows a within-model canonical quotient that removes incidental representation differences while preserving one canonical RDF dataset object; z shows cross-language translation where source and target observations may genuinely differ and properties must therefore be mapped rather than identified. Together they earn a sharp distinction: canonicalization may justify sameness inside one declared quotient, whereas translation across nonidentical observational domains requires a relation and can alter obligations. Remove y and there is no witnessed quotient-sameness case; remove z and there is no witnessed nonidentity transport case.

faces.title: Adaptive reconstruction separates identity continuity from assurance continuity
faces.text: w supplies continual rebuilding and horizon expansion, x supplies condition-indexed validity, and y supplies quotient-scoped canonical identity. Together they earn that a reconstructed system can remain the same object under an accepted representation quotient while its previous assurance becomes stale because the operating/conditioning frontier changed. Remove w and no evolving carrier pressures the two contracts; remove x and assurance cannot go stale independently; remove y and identity persistence has no explicit quotient witness.

faces.title: Expansion requires relation-mediated revalidation
faces.text: w supplies adaptive capability growth, x supplies bounded assurance resolution, and z supplies relation-mediated property transport. Together they earn that when an adaptive system enters a new representation or problem regime, inherited guarantees must be transported through the actual source-target relation and re-evaluated over the new condition/property class. Remove w and there is no boundary-crossing growth; remove x and revalidation has no scope index; remove z and the representation crossing has no transport law.

faces.title: Reconstructive continuity can use different witnesses within and between regimes
faces.text: w supplies continued function through changing realization, y supplies canonical sameness within a declared quotient, and z supplies relational correspondence when source and target representations are not identical. Together they earn a layered continuity witness: quotient/canonicalization can justify sameness inside a regime, while explicit relation transport is required between regimes whose observations differ. Remove w and there is no continuity claim to witness; remove y and within-regime representational equivalence is missing; remove z and cross-regime correspondence is missing.

faces.title: A portable claim has three separable coordinates
faces.text: x supplies assurance scope and error debt, y supplies identity/equivalence quotient, and z supplies source-target transport relation plus property/context typing. Together they earn that a portable claim is not one undifferentiated certificate: it must separately state what object is treated as equivalent, how the claim crosses representation boundaries, and the class/regime over which the resulting claim is warranted. Remove any parent and one coordinate becomes implicit.

volume.title: Scope-bearing adaptive transformation contract
volume.text:
A system that continually rebuilds or expands its own competence can preserve warranted continuity across representational change only by carrying three separable contracts with the transformation: (1) an identity/equivalence quotient specifying which representation differences may be ignored, (2) an explicit source-target relation specifying how obligations and guarantees are transported when observations differ, and (3) an assurance scope specifying the condition/property class, assumptions, approximation/error debt and contextual regime over which the transported claim is warranted. Adaptive growth supplies the pressure that makes these contracts dynamic rather than archival: when the reachable problem/representation frontier changes, an old identity witness may remain valid while its assurance scope or transport relation no longer does. Continuity of the organism therefore does not entail continuity of every warrant. Boundary-crossing transformations require the affected contracts to be revalidated or reissued rather than inherited silently.


Bounded volume invariant:
Reconstructive adaptation is lawfully portable when identity quotient, representation-transport relation, and assurance scope remain explicit and independently revalidated at the current boundary; persistence of one coordinate never automatically upgrades or preserves the others.


Evidence boundary:
This is a cross-source structural synthesis. It combines one conceptual biological design argument, one formal statistical framework, one normative RDF canonicalization standard, and one formal compiler/secure-compilation theory. Their recurrence earns an architectural distinction between identity, transport and assurance contracts under adaptive change; it does not prove that every adaptive system, statistical guarantee, graph canonicalization, or compiler instantiates one universal mechanism.

INV-1H.FXzc-01 — SEPARATED TRANSFORMATION CONTRACT
Minimal earning body: xyz.
Bounded invariant: A claim carried through representation change has at least three logically separable coordinates when these source families are jointly respected: the equivalence/identity quotient, the source-target transport relation, and the assurance/property scope. Success of one coordinate does not certify the others.
CREATE: declare the three coordinates before treating a transformed artifact or claim as warranted continuation.
COPY: transport each coordinate explicitly rather than collapsing all three into a generic notion of “same”.
CONTROL: reject inferences that use canonical sameness as proof of stronger validity, or a lawful transport relation as proof that an unchanged guarantee class still applies.
CULTIVATE: refine the quotient, relation, or assurance class independently as new regimes expose different failure modes.
Compression: sameness, transport, and warrant are distinct parts of one transformation contract.


INV-1H.FXzc-02 — BOUNDARY-EXPANSION REVALIDATION
Minimal earning body: wxyz.
Bounded invariant: When reconstructive growth changes the reachable problem, representation, observation, or conditioning frontier, every affected part of the transformation contract must be retested at the new boundary; organism continuity does not authorize silent inheritance of stale assurance.
CREATE: mark a witnessed frontier crossing as a new validation event rather than as ordinary in-regime continuation.
COPY: preserve predecessor contracts as provenance while issuing the current boundary-specific witness.
CONTROL: classify whether the change affected identity quotient, transport relation, assurance scope, or more than one; require fresh evidence only where the boundary actually moved.
CULTIVATE: let repeated revalidation produce a lineage of explicit transformation contracts rather than accumulating hidden assumptions.
Compression: growth may preserve the organism while forcing its warrants to be earned again.


COLLAPSE WITNESS
Two metabolites survive. INV-01 captures the triadic separation already earned by x+y+z. INV-02 requires the full four-parent volume because only w turns the static three-coordinate contract into a boundary-crossing adaptive lifecycle. Pairwise and face-level restatements were retained in the tetrahedron but not duplicated as metabolites.

volume.title: Quotient-addressable continuity reconstitution
volume.text:
Across all four parents, continuity already detaches from one fixed interior. The full closure adds an addressable repair-and-reissue law. 2H.dxL5 identifies what must remain portable: the obligation-specific relational kernel, evidence boundary and pressure surface. 2H.SruR identifies what may currently be ignored and when that permission expires through a local quotient carried by a revocable warrant. 2H._phq makes sparse realization reversible by preserving stable, role-specific routes back into dormant source/evidence. 2H.AvDK makes the regenerative scaffold and the warrant itself revisable when the regime, task or stabilizing assumptions change.


The complete four-way closure is quotient-addressable continuity reconstitution: a selectively realized relation may count as continuous across changing carrier, representation and regime only while its public obligation, local nuisance quotient, evidence boundary and regenerative scaffold remain jointly witnessed. When pressure or context revokes that warrant, the failed quotient becomes an address rather than merely a verdict: distinctions previously permitted to disappear as nuisance become candidates for targeted reactivation; implicated dormant evidence is reopened by stable role; quotient and scaffold are revised together; the regenerated relation is tested again against the current portability/adequacy pressure; and any renewed continuity/equivalence authority is issued as a newly scoped successor state rather than silently inheriting the expired warrant.
volume.invariant: A continuity/equivalence claim over a selectively realized portable relation remains warranted only while its operation, nuisance quotient, evidence boundary and regenerative scaffold remain sufficient under relevant pressure. If that warrant fails, the expired quotient must preserve enough addressability to reopen implicated dormant distinctions, revise quotient and scaffold together, regenerate and retest the relation in the current regime, and issue any successor warrant as newly scoped state while preserving the prior warrant and evidence scope as provenance.
removal: Remove 2H.dxL5: the closure loses the obligation-minimal portable kernel and pressure surface distinguishing genuine portability from familiar-carrier success.
Remove 2H.SruR: the closure loses the explicit local nuisance quotient and revocable equivalence membrane, so failure cannot identify what prior permission to ignore has expired.
Remove 2H._phq: the closure loses exact dormant-source reacquisition and role-stable reactivation, so revocation cannot route to concrete support that had been omitted.
Remove 2H.AvDK: the closure loses the scaffold/regime revision lifecycle and warrant-as-state required to transform revocation into a successor candidate and fresh authority.

edges.text: 1H.qI2L makes the public relation and its evidence boundary durable; 1H.DUwl makes adequacy a renewable warrant tied to current task/regime rather than a permanent property of a carrier. Together they earn a relation whose continuity is conditional on renewed evidence: the bridge may persist while implementation changes, but its authority expires when the validation regime no longer covers the current use.
edges.removal: remove qI2L and there is no explicit durable cross-substrate correspondence to warrant; remove DUwl and no rule states when continued usability must be retested or revoked.

edges.title: role-explicit non-identity interface
edges.text: 1H.qI2L distinguishes useful correspondence from mechanism/code identity. 1H.9gYl distinguishes semantic obligations that should remain in separate carriers or channels until deliberate conjunction. Together they earn an interface discipline: a cross-system relation should expose which role is being preserved—address, operation, evidence, authority, identity-bearing particulars—rather than letting success in one role imply sameness or assurance in another.
edges.removal: remove qI2L and the non-identity membrane disappears; remove 9gYl and the correspondence lacks explicit obligation/role separation.

edges.title: revalidatable covariant transition
edges.text: 1H.yac0 supplies explicit transition obligations for semantic continuity; 1H.DUwl supplies renewed testing and revocation when task/regime changes. Together they earn a transition warrant rather than a transition assumption: a rewrite is continuous only while its operation-preserving obligations survive current tests, and prior validation may be retired when the regime leaves scope.
edges.removal: remove yac0 and there is no explicit preservation law through the rewrite; remove DUwl and there is no renewable validation/revocation boundary.

edges.title: role-preserving sufficient transformation
edges.text: 1H.yac0 says independent role semantics must survive representation change; 1H.9gYl says those roles should be independently addressable and their reduced carriers tested against exact obligations. Together they earn selective transformation: representation may be compressed, reframed or rebuilt without preserving all particulars, provided each load-bearing role remains addressable and sufficient for the operation that consumes it.
edges.removal: remove yac0 and role continuity through transformation is ungrounded; remove 9gYl and the criterion for separating and testing role-specific sufficiency disappears.

edges.title: selectively revocable composite assurance
edges.text: 1H.DUwl requires adequacy to be revalidated as goals/tasks drift; 1H.9gYl refuses assurance-smearing from trusted parts to a composite. Together they earn selective revocation: evidence may remain valid for some roles while failing for another, but the composed interface must also be retested at its conjunction boundary before authority is renewed.
edges.removal: remove DUwl and no regime-sensitive revalidation/revocation remains; remove 9gYl and local component validity can silently substitute for end-to-end assurance.

faces.title: revalidatable covariant correspondence
faces.text: qI2L + yac0 + DUwl jointly earn a bridge that may survive changing carriers without shared interior identity when each rewrite preserves claim-relevant operations and the resulting relation is revalidated under the current task/evidence regime.
faces.removal: remove qI2L and the non-identity correspondence/evidence contract disappears; remove yac0 and lawful transformation disappears; remove DUwl and the warrant cannot expire or be renewed.

faces.title: role-indexed correspondence through change
faces.text: qI2L + yac0 + 9gYl jointly earn a cross-representation interface whose promises are not one undifferentiated similarity claim: each preserved role remains separately addressable through the transformation, and success of the relation does not collapse identity, authority, address and operational sufficiency into one object.
faces.removal: remove qI2L and non-identity/evidence typing disappears; remove yac0 and transformed-role continuity is ungrounded; remove 9gYl and independent obligation channels disappear.

faces.title: compositional warrant without identity inflation
faces.text: qI2L + DUwl + 9gYl jointly earn a renewable interface warrant in which evidence attaches to named roles and the whole composition, while stable correspondence never by itself promotes to mechanism/code identity. A role may keep its local warrant while the composite is withheld, or the composite may be revoked when its conjunction changes.
faces.removal: remove qI2L and the identity barrier disappears; remove DUwl and the warrant is not renewable/revocable; remove 9gYl and component versus composite assurance is not distinguished.

faces.title: selectively revocable semantic continuity
faces.text: yac0 + DUwl + 9gYl jointly earn continuity that can survive substantial carrier/context change without all-or-nothing preservation. Role semantics and consumed operations define what must survive; current tests determine whether they still do; failures can localize which role or conjunction lost warrant rather than forcing material sameness or indiscriminate reset.
faces.removal: remove yac0 and there is no role-preserving transition law; remove DUwl and no current-regime validation/revocation exists; remove 9gYl and failures cannot be localized by independently addressable obligation.

volume.title: role-indexed revalidatable correspondence
volume.text:
All four parents together earn a continuity contract in which a cross-substrate relation can remain the same usable relation without requiring the participating systems to share an interior, a fixed carrier or one canonical representation. The relation is made explicit as a set of independently addressable obligations; every representation change must preserve the operations and role semantics consumed by those obligations; sufficiency is re-witnessed under the current task/evidence regime; and composite authority is granted only after the conjunction itself is tested rather than inherited from valid components.


The additional rank-4 consequence is selective renewal. Because the interface is role-indexed, a regime or carrier change can reveal exactly which obligation or conjunction has left its tested scope. The old warrant can then be retained for unaffected roles, revoked where coverage failed, and reissued only after the transformed relation and its composition are revalidated. Continuity therefore lives in a typed, renewable relation rather than in material sameness, global representational identity or assurance by association.
volume.invariant: A correspondence may count as continuous across changing substrates and representations when its public obligations are separately addressable, lawful transitions preserve the operations and role semantics each obligation consumes, current evidence revalidates both role-level and composite sufficiency, and the relation keeps shared-interior identity explicitly unearned. Regime change may selectively revoke and renew affected warrants without requiring fixed material realization.
removal: Remove 1H.qI2L: the closure loses the explicit correspondence-without-identity and evidence-boundary membrane; successful continuity can inflate into shared-interior identity.
Remove 1H.yac0: the closure loses the explicit transition law preserving task operations and role semantics through representation change.
Remove 1H.DUwl: the closure loses renewable validation, revocation and regime-sensitive reconstruction; a once-valid relation becomes implicitly permanent.
Remove 1H.9gYl: the closure loses independently addressable obligations and the component-versus-composite assurance boundary required for selective renewal.

metabolites.title: ROLE-INDEXED-CORRESPONDENCE
metabolites.text: cross-substrate continuity should expose the distinct obligations a correspondence claims to preserve, and stable use of one obligation must not imply identity or validity of the others.
metabolites.compression: make the bridge's promises separately addressable.

metabolites.title: REVALIDATABLE-TRANSITION-WARRANT
metabolites.text: a representation transition warrants continuity only while it preserves consumed operations/role semantics and the transformed relation passes the current validation regime.
metabolites.compression: preserve the obligation through the rewrite, then re-earn its authority.

metabolites.title: SELECTIVE-COMPOSITE-RENEWAL
metabolites.text: role-level validity and composite validity are distinct; a changed system may preserve some warranted obligations while others or their conjunction require revocation and renewed evidence.
metabolites.compression: renew the smallest warrant that actually changed; never let component certainty certify the whole.
