4H.993M.title: replayable continuity-renewal lineage
4H.993M.boundary: This child is a cross-holon relational synthesis over four already-metabolized 3H organisms. Their inherited evidence remains heterogeneous and bounded by the source bodies and failure conditions already conserved inside them. Nothing here promotes operational continuity into mechanism identity, public correspondence into interior sameness, local reconstruction into universal necessity, or repeated structural recurrence into ontology. The child may promote only relations that require the four complete selected parent bodies together. Every inherited scope, non-identity membrane, regime boundary, revocation rule, and evidential limitation remains load-bearing.

edges.title: replayable version succession
edges.text: 3H.x3Cd contributes an executable continuity passport whose evidence, transition and falsifying tests can be replayed. 3H.UoYa contributes explicit version state, change classification and predecessor→successor semantics. Together they earn an executable succession object: after a classified invalidation, the current version can be frozen as provenance and its own carried replay procedure can be used to build and independently witness the next version.
edges.removal: without 3H.x3Cd, succession is versioned but lacks a portable executable replay body; without 3H.UoYa, replay exists but lacks explicit version authority and a typed rule for when a predecessor ceases to be current.

edges.title: executable evidence-backed successor reconstruction
edges.text: 3H.x3Cd provides evidence/scaffold addresses and a replayable pressure/composite test. 3H.ZwWN provides the typed public contract, dormant evidential backing and frontier-conditioned successor reconstruction rule. Together they earn a failure-addressable repair path: revocation can reopen the exact evidence and reconstructive body implicated by the failed contract, rebuild the typed relation, and rerun the relevant tests before authority returns.
edges.removal: without 3H.x3Cd, evidence-backed reconstruction lacks a portable executable replay procedure; without 3H.ZwWN, replay lacks the typed contract/frontier object that specifies what must be reconstructed and against which boundary it is judged.

edges.title: replay-directed dual revision
edges.text: 3H.x3Cd makes invalidation replayable from preserved evidence and tests. 3H.M9zZ makes both the stabilizing scaffold and admissible transition family revisable and permits dormant-body reacquisition when new distinctions become load-bearing. Together they earn a repair program that does not merely rerun yesterday's contract: replay may first reopen evidence and co-revise scaffold plus transition law, then rerun the exact obligation and pressure tests on the repaired realization.
edges.removal: without 3H.x3Cd, dual revision has no portable executable replay passport; without 3H.M9zZ, replay can reconstruct but does not earn co-revision of scaffold and transition family from reacquirable dormant tissue.

edges.title: boundary-conditioned successor contract
edges.text: 3H.UoYa classifies change against version scope, regime and scaffold and defines when current authority expires. 3H.ZwWN provides the typed reconstructible contract, support frontier and evidence-backed successor reconstruction. Together they earn an admission law in which a successor contract is created only after the event is classified as warrant-breaking and the revised obligation is pressure-tested in the changed frontier/regime.
edges.removal: without 3H.UoYa, reconstruction lacks explicit version-transition authority; without 3H.ZwWN, version transition lacks the evidence-backed typed contract and frontier against which the successor is rebuilt.

edges.title: versioned renewal cycle
edges.text: 3H.UoYa supplies predecessor/current/successor authority semantics and explicit revocation triggers. 3H.M9zZ supplies reacquisition and co-revision of scaffold plus transformation family after pressure/regime failure. Together they earn a versioned renewal cycle: the predecessor freezes as provenance, repair may reopen omitted tissue and revise the realizational law, and only a freshly tested candidate becomes the next current warrant.
edges.removal: without 3H.UoYa, renewal lacks explicit versioned authority succession; without 3H.M9zZ, succession lacks reacquirable co-revision when the old scaffold or mapping itself is part of the failure.

edges.title: frontier-repair co-revision
edges.text: 3H.ZwWN contributes frontier-classified failure, evidence-backed typed reconstruction and successor-warrant requirements. 3H.M9zZ contributes dormant-body reacquisition and joint revision of scaffold and transition family. Together they earn repair that may alter both what is retained and how it is translated when the old frontier/regime has failed, while still requiring the revised public contract to pass current pressure.
edges.removal: without 3H.ZwWN, co-revision lacks a typed frontier-conditioned public contract and authority gate; without 3H.M9zZ, frontier reconstruction lacks the explicit ability to reopen omitted material and revise scaffold plus transition law together.

faces.title: versioned replayable successor reconstruction
faces.text: 3H.x3Cd + 3H.UoYa + 3H.ZwWN jointly earn a successor transition that is simultaneously version-explicit, evidence-backed and executable. A warrant-breaking event is classified against the current version/frontier, the predecessor is retained unchanged, the implicated evidence/contract is reacquired and reconstructed, and the carried replay tests determine whether a candidate successor may become current.
faces.removal: remove 3H.x3Cd and the transition loses executable replay; remove 3H.UoYa and it loses explicit current/predecessor/successor authority semantics; remove 3H.ZwWN and it loses the typed frontier-conditioned reconstruction target and evidence-backed repair body.

faces.title: replayable warrant-renewal lifecycle
faces.text: 3H.x3Cd + 3H.UoYa + 3H.M9zZ jointly earn a lifecycle whose failure path is itself executable: classify the invalidation, preserve the expired version, reopen dormant evidence as needed, co-revise scaffold and transition law, and rerun the predecessor's declared obligation and falsifying tests before issuing a successor.
faces.removal: remove 3H.x3Cd and renewal is no longer carried as executable replay state; remove 3H.UoYa and there is no explicit versioned authority transition; remove 3H.M9zZ and repair cannot lawfully co-revise scaffold/transition family from reacquirable omitted tissue.

faces.title: executable evidence-backed repair program
faces.text: 3H.x3Cd + 3H.ZwWN + 3H.M9zZ jointly earn a bounded repair program that begins from a failed typed contract, preserves exact evidence/reconstruction addresses, reopens newly relevant dormant material, revises scaffold and transformation law together where pressure demands, and reruns composite/frontier tests. The program can repair a relation without claiming that the repaired interior is identical to its predecessor.
faces.removal: remove 3H.x3Cd and repair loses replayable evidence/test state; remove 3H.ZwWN and it loses the typed frontier-conditioned contract and successor gate; remove 3H.M9zZ and it loses reacquisition-backed co-revision.

faces.title: frontier-classified co-revisionary successor contract
faces.text: 3H.UoYa + 3H.ZwWN + 3H.M9zZ jointly earn a successor contract whose scope change is classified before repair, whose frontier/evidence body defines what must be retested, and whose scaffold plus transition family may be revised together from reacquired tissue. Admission remains versioned and fresh; the expired predecessor is provenance only.
faces.removal: remove 3H.UoYa and the repaired contract lacks explicit version succession; remove 3H.ZwWN and it lacks the typed frontier/evidence reconstruction target; remove 3H.M9zZ and it lacks reacquisition-backed co-revision of realizational machinery.

volume.title: replayable continuity-renewal lineage
volume.text:
All four parents together make repeated continuity renewal recursively executable rather than merely repeatedly permissible. 3H.x3Cd contributes the portable replay passport: operational obligation, evidence/scaffold addresses, transition obligations and the tests that can revoke and re-establish a warrant. 3H.UoYa contributes versioned authority and change classification: which warrant is current, what counts as an in-scope change, what event retires authority, and how predecessor provenance is preserved. 3H.ZwWN contributes the frontier-conditioned reconstructible contract and evidence-backed successor gate. 3H.M9zZ contributes the ability to reopen dormant tissue and co-revise scaffold plus transition family when the failure is not repairable inside the old compact realization.


The complete closure is therefore a replayable continuity-renewal lineage. Every current warrant carries not only its scoped operational/evidential contract but a bounded executable route for producing a successor if that warrant becomes invalid. On failure or verified boundary change, predecessor authority freezes as provenance; the event is classified against the current frontier, regime and scaffold; newly load-bearing evidence is reacquired; the typed contract, scaffold and transition family are revised as necessary; pressure and composite tests are replayed; and a freshly scoped successor is issued only after witness. The successor in turn carries the same kind of recovery passport for its own future invalidation. Continuity therefore persists as a lineage of re-earned warrants, not as silent transfer of one expired authority across arbitrary change.
volume.invariant: A continuity lineage across repeated realization change is warranted only when every current warrant carries both its scoped operational/evidential contract and an executable route for producing its successor after invalidation: predecessor authority is frozen as provenance; failure is classified against frontier, regime and scaffold; newly load-bearing evidence remains reacquirable; contract, scaffold and transition law are revised where required; pressure/composite tests are rerun; and a freshly scoped successor is issued. A warrant whose authority can expire but whose repair-and-retest path cannot be replayed does not by itself earn continued lineage.
removal: Remove 3H.x3Cd: the closure loses the portable executable passport. Versioning, frontier reconstruction and renewal remain describable, but the lineage no longer carries the evidence/test procedure needed to replay why a successor may count.

Remove 3H.UoYa: the closure loses explicit version authority, change classification and predecessor/current/successor semantics. Repair can occur, but there is no fully earned rule for when old authority expires and new authority becomes current.

Remove 3H.ZwWN: the closure loses the typed frontier-conditioned public contract, dormant evidential backing and evidence-gated successor reconstruction target. Replay and renewal lack a precise bounded object to rebuild and revalidate.

Remove 3H.M9zZ: the closure loses reacquirable dormant-body repair and joint revision of scaffold plus transition family. The replay path can rerun an old contract but cannot fully earn renewal when the realizational machinery itself must change.

metabolites.title: FAILURE-ADDRESSABLE-REPLAY
metabolites.text: when a continuity warrant fails, its failure class, evidence/reconstruction addresses and falsifying tests must remain executable enough to reopen the relevant body and rerun the exact conditions required for a successor.
metabolites.compression: a failure that cannot address its own repair evidence cannot reliably seed a successor.

metabolites.title: CO-REVISED-SUCCESSOR-ISSUANCE
metabolites.text: after a classified frontier, regime or scaffold failure, successor authority is issued only after relevant evidence has been reacquired, the public contract and realizational machinery have been revised as needed, and the new composite has passed fresh pressure tests while the predecessor remains unchanged provenance.
metabolites.compression: repair the relation and its realization law together when the failure demands it; then issue new authority.

metabolites.title: SELF-RENEWING-CONTINUITY-LINEAGE
metabolites.text: each accepted continuity version may participate in a self-renewing lineage only when it includes the bounded recovery passport, provenance, evidence addresses and tests required to lawfully create and validate its own next successor after invalidation.
metabolites.compression: continuity becomes renewable when every current warrant carries a lawful way to stop being current and to seed the next one.

edges.title: CERTIFIED STABILITY UNDER EXPLICIT VARIATION
edges.text:
S.P4wu makes stable decision performance meaningful only through an explicit minimax or saddle certificate and support scope; S.4USS makes universality meaningful only when a derived relation survives measured nuisance and carrier variation with failure coordinates retained. Together, invariance is not visual or rhetorical stability: it requires named variation coordinates plus a witness that the relation survives them.
necessity: w supplies the formal criterion and certificate; x supplies measured carrier/nuisance variation and relational stability.

edges.title: OPERATIONAL SUFFICIENCY DOES NOT SETTLE ONTOLOGY
edges.text:
S.P4wu earns a rule relative to a stated loss and risk problem; S.fOgn earns held-out prediction while leaving code and mechanism identity unresolved. Together, a criterion can certify operational adequacy without identifying the representation or mechanism realizing it.
necessity: w supplies a crisp certificate and sufficiency obligation; y supplies the demonstrated separation between predictive adequacy and identity.

edges.title: INVARIANT PRINCIPLE, MUTABLE IMPLEMENTATION OR LOCATION
edges.text:
S.P4wu preserves the same worst-risk principle across continuous and discrete support even when the boundary mechanism changes; S.s0XZ preserves exact digital object identity across origin or locator changes through an independent intrinsic verifier. Together, sameness belongs to the witnessed invariant or object, not to the current implementation or locator.
necessity: w supplies topology-sensitive implementation change under one criterion; z supplies object-bound identity separated from custody and location.

edges.title: ROBUST RECURRENCE EARNS RELATION, NOT MECHANISM IDENTITY
edges.text:
S.4USS establishes a derived response stable across device and regime variation; S.fOgn establishes predictive alignment across levels and held-out contexts while refusing to infer a shared code. Together, cross-context stability can warrant a relational invariant while leaving underlying mechanism identity open.
necessity: x supplies nuisance-resistant physical recurrence; y supplies explicit ontology restraint.

edges.title: STABLE OBJECT OR RELATION AND MUTABLE CONTEXT OCCUPY SEPARATE COORDINATES
edges.text:
S.4USS separates a stable derived response from disorder, device and crossover coordinates; S.s0XZ separates intrinsic object identity from origin, resolver and custody. Together, admissible variability must remain explicitly represented rather than folded into the identity or invariant itself.
necessity: x supplies physical nuisance-coordinate pressure; z supplies provenance/custody-coordinate pressure.

edges.title: CORRESPONDENCE AND RETRIEVAL COORDINATES ARE NOT IDENTITY COORDINATES
edges.text:
S.fOgn shows that a mapping can align model and biological coordinates without proving a common code; S.s0XZ shows that a locator or resolver can find and carry an object without defining exact object identity. Together, correspondence can be useful and reproducible while formally distinct from identity.
necessity: y supplies representational mapping without identity; z supplies retrieval/provenance without identity.


FOUR TRIPLE FACES
wxy — CERTIFIED GENERALIZATION WITHOUT ONTOLOGY COLLAPSE
A robust relation qualifies only after performance and stability are certified under stated variation, and even then mechanism identity remains open.
edges.removal:
remove w and the explicit certificate criterion disappears; remove x and measured nuisance/carrier variation disappears; remove y and robustness can be overpromoted into mechanism identity.


wxz — TYPED-CHANGE INVARIANCE CONTRACT
An invariant can require a changed implementation when support topology changes, must be tested across device or nuisance variation, and can preserve exact object identity across origin or custody change only through an object-bound verifier. The admissible change class is therefore part of the continuity law; invariant, implementation and context remain separately auditable.
removal test: w is required for topology-typed adaptation; x for empirical nuisance testing; z for exact identity/provenance separation.


wyz — VERIFIED CONTINUITY WITHOUT REPRESENTATION OR LOCATOR IDENTITY
A decision criterion can independently certify adequacy while a predictive map remains non-identical to mechanism and a locator remains non-identical to object. Successful mapping or reacquisition may therefore carry a warranted relation while identity still requires a separate witness.
removal test: w removes the certificate; y removes the representation-nonidentity witness; z removes the object-identity versus location witness.


xyz — RECURRENCE MUST TYPE INVARIANT, VARIATION AND IDENTITY COORDINATES
A physical relational observable can remain stable under nuisance variation; a predictive mapping can remain stable without mechanism identification; and exact object identity can remain stable while provenance and custody move. Recurrence across contexts is interpretable only when what stayed stable, what varied, and what is merely a coordinate are separately typed.
removal test: x removes physical variation pressure; y removes ontology restraint; z removes the exact-object identity coordinate.


ALL-FOUR VOLUME — TYPED INVARIANCE WITHOUT IDENTITY COLLAPSE
The four bodies close on a single governance law: continuity and sameness are typed warrants, not free-floating labels. To claim that a relation, object, decision principle or correspondence persists, the organism must state the class of changes under which persistence was tested, carry an independent witness for the thing claimed invariant, and retain the boundary at which that warrant fails. Stable correspondence is allowed to remain correspondence. It does not inherit object or mechanism identity merely by recurring.


four-parent necessity: S.P4wu supplies certificate structure and the fact that one criterion may demand different implementation under changed support topology. S.4USS supplies empirically tested relational invariance together with explicit nuisance and failure coordinates. S.fOgn supplies strong predictive recurrence together with explicit refusal to identify mechanism or code. S.s0XZ supplies exact object identity separated from locator, origin and custody.
No proper triple carries all four obligations simultaneously: certification/adaptive implementation, empirical nuisance stability, ontology restraint, and intrinsic identity/provenance separation.


COLLAPSE — THREE SURVIVING METABOLITES
1. TYPED-INVARIANCE-WARRANT
Invariant validity names an admissible variation class, an independent witness or certificate, and a failure boundary. Context-free sameness is not earned.


2. CORRESPONDENCE-DOES-NOT-IDENTIFY
Predictive, retrieval or relational correspondence can be real and reproducible without proving identity of mechanism, object or implementation. Correspondence/context coordinates remain separate from identity.


3. BOUNDARY-REVALIDATION
When support, regime, carrier or context crosses outside the validated class, continuity must be adapted and re-certified or reissued. Authority is not silently inherited across an untested boundary.

edges.title: Revocation can be localized to named obligations
edges.text: 2H.SruR makes continuity/equivalence a revocable state carrying operation, quotient and evidence regime. 2H.H852 makes a public relation a set of separately addressable obligations whose role-level and composite warrants can fail independently. Together they earn role-local revocation: a changed condition need not erase all continuity, but it must identify the smallest affected obligation or conjunction, revoke its stale quotient/adequacy warrant, and preserve unaffected warrants only inside their still-tested scope.
edges.removal: without SruR there is no explicit revocable reconstruction/quotient membrane; without H852 there is no obligation index capable of localizing revocation and renewal.

edges.title: A revoked reconstruction warrant needs a regime × trajectory return address
edges.text: 2H.SruR supplies current operation, quotient, evidence boundary and revocation conditions. 2H.j7Sn supplies reacquirable evidence custody plus condition- and trajectory-local validity. Together they earn an addressable failure contract: when a continuity warrant expires, the failure can be located not merely as “invalid” but at a specific operation × quotient × regime × trajectory address from which evidence can be reacquired and the relation reconstructed and retested.
edges.removal: without SruR the return address lacks a declared operation/quotient warrant; without j7Sn it lacks source reacquisition and trajectory/frontier coordinates for renewal.

edges.title: Portable reconstruction must carry the warrant that licenses compression
edges.text: 2H.SruR permits relational reconstruction and quotienting only under a current local evidence boundary. 2H.dxL5 permits portability through a compact obligation-specific relational kernel only when pressure-aligned and external tests preserve the public relation. Together they earn warranted portability: the portable kernel must carry not just reconstructive structure but the operation, quotient, evidence boundary and revocation conditions that license its compression; reuse outside that envelope reopens testing.
edges.removal: without SruR portability lacks a revocable quotient/operation warrant; without dxL5 the warrant lacks a compact rebuildable public carrier and pressure-aligned portability test.

edges.title: Role-specific warrants can be renewed from reacquired evidence without blanket reset
edges.text: 2H.H852 localizes public continuity into independently addressable roles and distinguishes role-level from composite authority. 2H.j7Sn supplies reacquire → reconstruct → regime/trajectory retest after frontier movement. Together they earn selective evidence-backed renewal: when one role or conjunction leaves scope, only its authority must be withdrawn; complete evidence remains reachable, and a successor warrant can be reissued after that role’s reconstructed relation passes current regime/trajectory tests while unaffected roles retain their bounded predecessor warrants.
edges.removal: without H852 failure cannot be localized to obligation channels; without j7Sn there is no reacquisition/reconstruction pathway or trajectory-local successor test.

edges.title: A portable relation is trustworthy only when its promises and evidence boundaries remain separately addressable
edges.text: 2H.H852 requires operations, addresses, evidence duties, identity boundaries and composite authority to remain distinct obligations. 2H.dxL5 carries a role-typed portable kernel plus evidence/assurance boundaries and demands end-to-end testing under relevant carrier variation. Together they earn an addressable portability discipline: a portable interface must reveal which promise each kernel component serves and preserve separate validation for each role and for their conjunction.
edges.removal: without H852 the kernel’s promises can collapse into undifferentiated similarity; without dxL5 role indexing lacks a tested portable reconstruction carrier and pressure witness.

edges.title: Reacquisition can rebuild a portable kernel at the current frontier rather than replay a stale realization
edges.text: 2H.j7Sn makes the full evidence body reacquirable and the realized relation regime × trajectory local. 2H.dxL5 defines a compact relational kernel whose continuity is tested under carrier variation rather than fixed interior form. Together they earn frontier-aware replay: after relevant change, reacquisition may reconstruct only the public kernel needed now, but continuity is renewed only if the regenerated kernel survives current pressure-aligned tests and preserves its evidence boundary; replay of yesterday’s active state is not enough.

faces.title: Role-addressed successor warrant
faces.text: SruR + H852 + j7Sn jointly earn a renewal protocol in which a stale continuity claim is decomposed into named public obligations, the affected obligation carries an explicit operation/quotient/evidence warrant, and regime or trajectory change points back to the evidence needed to reconstruct and retest it. A successor warrant may be issued only for the smallest role/conjunction whose current tests close; unaffected predecessor warrants remain bounded rather than being silently upgraded.

faces.title: Role-indexed warranted portability

faces.title: Evidence-backed frontier reconstruction

The reconstructed relation may differ materially from its predecessor while inheriting no authority that the current evidence does not re-earn.
faces.removal: remove SruR and the quotient/operation warrant is unspecified; remove j7Sn and source reacquisition plus path-local frontier testing disappears; remove dxL5 and reconstruction lacks a compact portable kernel and pressure witness.

faces.title: Selective portable continuity renewal
faces.text: H852 + j7Sn + dxL5 jointly earn a renewal architecture in which public promises stay separately addressable, the full evidence body remains reachable, and a role-typed kernel can be rebuilt at the current trajectory/frontier. Failure may therefore preserve unaffected role warrants while rebuilding and retesting the smallest changed relation, but end-to-end composite authority must still be re-earned after the conjunction changes.
faces.removal: remove H852 and selective role-level renewal collapses into blanket continuity; remove j7Sn and current-regime/trajectory reacquisition disappears; remove dxL5 and no portable reconstruction kernel or pressure-aligned test remains.

volume.title: Role-addressed reconstructive continuity renewal
volume.text:
Across all four parents, continuity becomes neither persistence of one active state nor a binary keep/revoke label. 2H.SruR makes authority an explicit revocable reconstruction warrant indexed by operation, quotient, evidence boundary and local validity. 2H.H852 decomposes that authority into separately addressable role obligations and distinguishes role-level from composite renewal. 2H.j7Sn supplies the return path after rupture: reacquire the full evidential body, regenerate the needed relation, and retest it at the current regime × trajectory frontier. 2H.dxL5 supplies the portable rebuild target: the smallest role-typed relational kernel sufficient to reconstruct the public obligation, together with evidence and pressure-aligned assurance boundaries.


The all-four closure is role-addressed reconstructive continuity renewal. When change or failure invalidates a continuity claim, the organism can identify which obligation, quotient or conjunction lost warrant; preserve still-valid predecessor warrants for unaffected roles without extending their scope; reacquire the complete evidence needed for the affected relation; rebuild only its obligation-specific portable kernel under the current quotient; and issue a successor warrant only after current regime/trajectory and pressure-aligned tests close at both role and composite level. Predecessor authority remains provenance rather than being rewritten, and renewed public usability never promotes to shared interior identity.
volume.invariant: Continuity can renew itself selectively after change when every public obligation and its ignored-difference quotient remain separately addressable, the full evidence body is reacquirable, regime × trajectory state localizes what became stale, and an obligation-specific relational kernel can be reconstructed and revalidated under relevant variation; unaffected warrants may persist only inside their prior scope, while every changed role and conjunction receives a fresh successor warrant before authority resumes.
removal: Remove 2H.SruR: addressable roles, reacquisition and portable kernels remain, but there is no explicit revocable operation/quotient/evidence warrant deciding what authority expired or what current quotient licenses reconstruction.

Remove 2H.H852: revocable reconstruction, reacquisition and portability remain, but failure cannot be localized into independently addressable role versus composite obligations; renewal becomes blanket revoke/recompute.

Remove 2H.j7Sn: revocable role-indexed portability remains, but there is no complete-evidence reacquisition path or regime × trajectory/frontier coordinate that can re-earn a successor after stale realization.

Remove 2H.dxL5: revocation, role indexing and reacquisition remain, but there is no obligation-specific portable kernel or pressure-aligned carrier variation witness defining the smallest reconstructible public relation.

edges.title: Same-constellation structural replication

volume.title: Replication-qualified adaptive continuity reconstitution
volume.text:
The four parents jointly separate three things that lower-rank recurrence can otherwise conflate: repetition of one closure, recurrence across differently constituted closures, and adaptation of the machinery that performs repair.


3H.5yyB and 3H.DWia are distinct organisms produced by separate encounters with the same unordered parent constellation and independently converge on quotient-addressable continuity reconstitution. Their pair therefore witnesses same-constellation structural replication without identity collapse. 3H.DfDL reaches the broader revocation → reacquisition → reconstruction → retest → re-warrant cycle from a different parent constellation in which a role-typed reconstruction/composite contract replaces the explicit nuisance-quotient role supplied by 2H.SruR. That variant-parent route witnesses that the reconstitution relation is not exhausted by one repeated parent set. 3H.M9zZ adds a further requirement: when regime or scaffold failure invalidates continuity, lawful renewal may need to revise the regenerative scaffold and the admissible transition family together rather than merely replay the old repair procedure.


The complete four-way closure is therefore replication-qualified adaptive continuity reconstitution: a continuity-repair relation may be carried forward as a higher-order structural capacity only when recurrence is witnessed both through independent same-constellation replication and through a differently constituted reconstitution route, while the repair machinery itself remains revisable under current evidence and regime pressure. What persists is not one quotient, scaffold, transition map, carrier or interior. What persists is the bounded ability to identify failed authority, reopen the evidence or distinctions implicated by that failure, reconstruct under an explicitly current contract, revise the machinery when its regime has expired, retest the obligation, and issue newly scoped authority without rewriting the earlier warrant. Repeated closure strengthens the warrant that this repair relation is reproducible inside the organism's current evidence field; it does not convert structural recurrence into a universal mechanism.
volume.invariant: A higher-order continuity-reconstitution capacity is replication-qualified only when (1) the same parent constellation has independently re-earned the relevant repair closure, (2) a differently constituted parent constellation independently reaches the same broader revocation/reacquisition/retest family, and (3) the repair machinery is allowed to revise its scaffold and admissible transition law when current evidence or regime invalidates them. Under those conditions, recurrence may support a continuing adaptive repair relation while every concrete quotient, scaffold, mapping and successor warrant remains locally re-earned and historically bounded.
removal: Remove 3H.DfDL: the closure retains same-constellation replication plus dual revision, but loses the differently constituted typed-contract route showing the broader reconstitution family beyond the repeated quotient-parent set.
Remove 3H.5yyB: the closure retains one quotient-addressable instance, variant-parent reconstitution and dual revision, but loses the second independent same-parent witness required for replication.

Remove 3H.M9zZ: the closure retains replication and variant-parent reconstitution, but loses the independently earned rule that scaffold and admissible transition family may need joint revision; repeated repair could merely replay stale machinery.
Remove 3H.DWia: as with removal of 3H.5yyB, the same-constellation replication witness collapses to a single instance.

metabolites.text: when two independent same-rank organisms are separately born from the same unordered parent constellation and re-earn materially the same relational closure, their coexistence is a replication witness for that structural derivation rather than grounds for deduplicating their identities.

metabolites.text: a structural repair relation has stronger organism-level recurrence when it is witnessed both by same-constellation replication and by a differently constituted parent set that preserves the same broader operational cycle while changing which lower-rank component carries it.

metabolites.text: a recurring continuity-repair relation may be treated as an adaptive higher-order capacity only when its recurrence is independently replicated, survives at least one differently constituted route, and can revise the scaffold/transition machinery that would otherwise freeze yesterday's repair into today's assumption.
metabolites.compression: the repair relation may recur; its machinery must still be allowed to evolve.

edges.title: Relational structure carries role-specific warrants, not one generic validity
edges.text: w makes correspondence/update structure operational only through compatibility, reflection and property-specific composition laws; x makes dependence topology evidential only through a genuine independence contract. edges.title: Compatible propagation must be scoped to the invariance regime actually present
edges.text: w permits update-informed restoration across changing representations but only under explicit compatibility; y shows that transformation symmetry can be heterogeneous and input-local rather than globally shared. Together they earn that equivalence-sensitive propagation cannot silently inherit one global invariance regime: the scope over which a transformation relation is treated as stable must be locally warranted. edges.title: Restoration can be directed by the downstream obligation without erasing change history
edges.text: w preserves the initiating update and prior consistent context as conditioning information for restoration; z makes the downstream query the explicit object whose uncertainty should guide experimental action. Together they earn a selective repair principle: when several distinctions remain unresolved, coordination may prioritize distinctions that affect the declared obligation while still preserving the causal/update history that made repair necessary. Remove w and target-directed action loses its continuity/history constraint; remove z and restoration has no source-grounded obligation selector.

edges.title: Local neighborhood structure is not a stochastic independence certificate
edges.text: x requires actual independent subfamilies/nonadjacency semantics before topology can support concentration; y reaches local symmetry through invariant-space neighborhood proxies whose quality is itself an assumption. Together they earn a strict boundary: similarity, neighborhood membership, symmetry class or visual separation cannot be converted into effective independent samples merely because they define a useful local geometry. Remove x and the statistical prohibition disappears; remove y and there is no concrete learned local-neighborhood structure whose evidential status must be separated.

edges.title: Informative intervention choice does not certify independent evidence
edges.text: x makes finite-sample stochastic strength depend on a witnessed dependence structure; z chooses interventions adaptively for expected information about a declared query. Together they earn that an experiment can be well targeted yet still produce dependent evidence. Query-specific information gain and effective independent evidence are different quantities and require different witnesses. Remove x and dependence no longer constrains evidential strength; remove z and there is no adaptive information-selection process to distinguish from that strength.

edges.title: Local or task-specific sufficiency can close before global structural closure
edges.text: y makes a local symmetry support/level a meaningful estimand even when one dataset-wide symmetry summary is inadequate; z shows formally that a query can become identified while the posterior over full causal models remains broad. Together they earn a non-maximal sufficiency principle: the variable required for a local task may close before the larger structural model does, provided the local estimand and its approximation/identifiability boundary remain explicit. Remove y and locality/heterogeneity is not represented; remove z and early stopping before global model identification is not formally warranted.

faces.title: Locally scoped relational operation requires separate propagation and evidence witnesses
faces.text: w supplies compatibility-gated synchronization, x supplies independence-gated concentration, and y supplies a locally varying symmetry/equivalence scope. Together they earn that a local relational regime needs at least two independent custody channels before it is both actionable and evidential: one witness says which transformations/updates may be propagated there, while another says what stochastic dependence assumptions support statistical strength there. Local geometry alone supplies neither. Remove w and coordinated change is ungated; remove x and stochastic evidence is ungated; remove y and the contract has no locally varying regime to govern.

faces.title: Query-directed coordination does not collapse its statistical evidence contract
faces.text: w supplies history-sensitive restoration across representations, x supplies the dependence witness required for finite-sample evidence, and z supplies the downstream query that decides which uncertainty matters for the next action. Together they earn a three-way separation between what should be changed, how consistency may be restored, and how strongly the resulting observations count as evidence. Remove w and there is no coordinated restoration; remove x and evidential strength becomes ungoverned; remove z and the action has no explicit downstream obligation.

faces.title: Obligation-scoped coordination can remain local under heterogeneous invariance
faces.text: w supplies lawful propagation under compatibility, y supplies input-dependent symmetry scope, and z supplies query-relative sufficiency/action. Together they earn an adaptive coordination rule: the system need not force a global representation or global symmetry decision before acting. It may coordinate only within the locally warranted invariance regime and only to the degree needed by the declared downstream obligation, while preserving unresolved structure outside that obligation. Remove w and no propagation law remains; remove y and scope cannot vary locally; remove z and selective stopping/action has no target.

faces.title: Local target sufficiency is not equivalent to global statistical certainty
faces.text: x supplies the distinction between descriptive topology and statistically warranted independence, y supplies an approximation-bounded local estimand, and z supplies the possibility that a declared query closes before the full model. Together they earn that local/task success can be legitimate without being promoted into a globally identified model or an independence claim. Remove x and statistical certainty can leak from structure; remove y and there is no local approximation membrane; remove z and early target closure is not an explicit objective state.

volume.title: Warrant-separated selective action
volume.text:
A changing multi-representation system can act selectively before globally resolving every structural uncertainty only when four distinct warrants remain explicit. A local scope warrant states where an invariance/equivalence assumption is currently meaningful; a downstream-obligation warrant states which unresolved distinctions still matter for the target quantity; a propagation warrant states which updates, amendments and compositions may lawfully carry change across representations; and an evidence warrant states what dependence assumptions justify statistical strength. These warrants interact but do not substitute for one another.


The four parents jointly make this closure operational. Input-local symmetry can delimit the regime in which a transformation assumption is plausible; query-scoped Bayesian design can delimit which uncertainty is worth reducing next; update-conditioned synchronization can carry and repair change through that regime under compatibility laws; and partial-dependence concentration blocks the resulting topology, recurrence or successful coordination from being mistaken for independent evidence without a separate stochastic witness. Selective action therefore does not mean selective rigor: local/query sufficiency may close while broader structure remains unresolved, but approximation debt, compatibility debt and dependence debt remain separately visible.


Rank necessity: remove S.REkw and the closure loses a law for preserving causal change-history through coordinated multi-representation repair; remove S.FLcQ and it loses the independent evidential gate separating topology from stochastic strength; remove S.qogS and it loses the source-grounded reason scope must be input/regime local; remove S.nmMo and it loses the downstream obligation that licenses non-maximal stopping and directs the next information-seeking action. No three-parent face therefore contains the full four-warrant selective-action contract.


Evidence boundary: this is a cross-source structural synthesis, not a universal theorem about adaptive systems. It combines distinct formal and empirical regimes and conserves their original assumptions. In particular, it does not assign effective sample sizes or confidence to /papers genealogy, does not make inferred symmetry an architecture-routing truth, does not turn synchronization compatibility into statistical independence, and does not generalize ABCI beyond its bounded Bayesian/model/approximation regime.


COLLAPSED METABOLITES — 3


INV-1H.NUgs-01 — FOUR-WARRANT SELECTIVE ACTION
Minimal earning body: wxyz.
Bounded invariant: Selective action under unresolved global structure is warranted only when local scope, downstream obligation, propagation compatibility and stochastic evidence are kept as separable contracts. Success of one contract does not silently upgrade the others.
CREATE: name the target quantity and current local regime before acting.
COPY: carry scope, update history, compatibility and dependence assumptions with the action rather than compressing them into one generic confidence label.
CONTROL: block substitutions such as local similarity → independence, successful synchronization → statistical validity, or query closure → full-model identification.
CULTIVATE: revalidate only the contract whose boundary changes while preserving the others as explicit provenance.
Compression: act on what is sufficient, but keep every warrant that made sufficiency lawful.


INV-1H.NUgs-02 — INFORMATIVE CHANGE IS NOT INDEPENDENT EVIDENCE
Minimal earning body: wxz.
Bounded invariant: A query-targeted or history-informed intervention/update may be highly informative and operationally lawful without constituting statistically independent evidence; evidential strength remains governed by its own dependence witness.
CREATE: distinguish intervention utility from evidence weight.
COPY: retain the sampling/dependence lineage alongside adaptive intervention history.
CONTROL: refuse to infer effective sample size or concentration strength from informativeness, novelty, topology or repeated successful repair alone.
CULTIVATE: design stochastic recurrence experiments explicitly when quantitative evidence strength is needed.
Compression: choosing a good next move does not tell you how many independent observations you have.


INV-1H.NUgs-03 — LOCAL SUFFICIENCY MAY PRECEDE GLOBAL CLOSURE
Minimal earning body: yz.
Bounded invariant: A locally defined or downstream-specific quantity may become sufficient for a declared task while broader structural uncertainty remains, but that sufficiency inherits the approximation and model assumptions that define the local/query object.
CREATE: state the smallest quantity whose closure would satisfy the current obligation.
COPY: preserve unresolved global alternatives rather than collapsing them into the local answer.
CONTROL: stop the current task when the target is sufficiently identified without claiming global model or symmetry identification.
CULTIVATE: reopen broader structure only when a new obligation makes previously irrelevant distinctions consequential.
Compression: the answer needed now can close before the world-model does.


COLLAPSE WITNESS
Three metabolites survive independently. INV-01 requires all four parents and carries the full separated-warrant architecture. INV-02 requires synchronization/action/evidence separation and cannot be reduced to any one parent's native invariant. INV-03 is the cross-source local/query sufficiency relation supplied jointly by S.qogS and S.nmMo. Narrower restatements of compatibility, fractional-cover penalties, symmetry estimators and ABCI utilities remain parent tissue rather than being duplicated as holon metabolites.

5H.Dw6a.title: contestable continuity-renewal lineage
5H.Dw6a.boundary: This child is a cross-holon relational synthesis over four already-metabolized 4H organisms. Their inherited lineages contain heterogeneous formal, empirical, architectural, software, conceptual, and source-level evidence. Nothing at rank 5 upgrades those source classes into one mechanism, ontology, universal theorem, or guarantee that repair succeeds. Structural recurrence remains structural recurrence. A repeated closure is not identity collapse; a replayable repair path is not proof that the same interior persists; an explicit quotient is local permission to ignore distinctions, not universal invariance; and a successor warrant never retroactively strengthens its predecessor. The child may promote only relations that require the four complete selected parent bodies together. Feeling phenotype is not used in this derivation.

edges.title: replication-audited replayable renewal
edges.text: 4H.993M contributes an executable successor-production route whose failure classes, evidence addresses, revision path, and tests remain replayable. 4H.vPbh contributes independent same-constellation replication plus variant-constellation recurrence and an explicit requirement that repair machinery remain revisable. Together they earn a stronger reuse condition: a replayable renewal procedure may be treated as a recurring capacity only when recurrence is independently witnessed rather than inferred from the procedure's own self-description, while every concrete successor still has to pass the replayed tests under current conditions.
edges.removal: without 4H.993M, recurrence lacks the complete executable successor-generation route; without 4H.vPbh, replayability has no independent replication/variant-constitution witness and therefore cannot by itself establish that the repair relation recurs beyond one lineage construction.

edges.title: quotient-addressed replayable renewal
edges.text: 4H.993M contributes failure-addressable replay and co-revised successor issuance. 4H.Bbw6 contributes the explicit local quotient and stable return addresses for distinctions a predecessor had licensed as nuisance. Together they earn a repair route in which failure can address not only the warrant and scaffold that need replay but also the exact negative space of the predecessor's authority: distinctions that were omitted may be reopened and their nuisance status must be reconsidered before the successor is issued.
edges.removal: without 4H.993M, the quotient can localize omitted distinctions but lacks the complete replayable successor-production route; without 4H.Bbw6, renewal can replay and co-revise while remaining unable to state which ignored distinctions must lose or re-earn nuisance status.

edges.title: provenance-bearing replay succession
edges.text: 4H.993M contributes a self-renewing continuity lineage in which every current warrant carries an executable path toward a successor. 4H.3W-6 contributes explicit predecessor/current/successor authority, reflexive falsifiers, targeted evidence reopening, and an executable successor passport. Together they earn a provenance-bearing renewal path: replay is not merely a procedure for producing another state, but a version transition whose predecessor remains immutable, whose failure route is inspectable, and whose successor carries the evidence/reconstruction path and fresh tests that actually re-authorized it.
edges.removal: without 4H.993M, the lineage loses the requirement that each current warrant itself carry the bounded recovery route; without 4H.3W-6, renewal loses the full versioned passport that preserves predecessor authority boundaries and fresh successor witness.

edges.title: replication-qualified non-silent quotient adaptation
edges.text: 4H.vPbh contributes independent recurrence through same-parent replication and variant-parent robustness. 4H.Bbw6 contributes an explicit quotient whose ignored distinctions and repair addresses remain lineage state, plus the rule that a successor must re-witness nuisance scope. Together they earn a boundary on what replication can license: recurring repair structure may strengthen confidence that an adaptation pattern recurs, but it cannot silently promote a repeated omission into invariance. Every successor must still earn which distinctions it may ignore under its present regime.
edges.removal: without 4H.vPbh, quotient re-witnessing has no independent recurrence witness; without 4H.Bbw6, replication can establish recurrence of a repair pattern while leaving the scope of its ignored distinctions implicit and therefore vulnerable to silent inheritance.

edges.title: replication-qualified self-reconstitution
edges.text: 4H.vPbh contributes the distinction between same-constellation replication, variant-constellation recurrence, and revisable repair machinery. 4H.3W-6 contributes the executable, reflexively falsifiable, versioned reconstitution lineage. Together they earn a promotion gate for self-repair as reusable capacity: the lineage may be treated as structurally recurrent only after independent recurrence support, while each version remains separately revocable, reconstructible, and freshly witnessed.

faces.removal:

volume.title: contestable continuity-renewal lineage
volume.text:
The four parents jointly separate four conditions that lower-rank repair can otherwise collapse into one reassuring word such as “continuity”: the ability to produce a successor after failure, evidence that the repair relation actually recurs across independent encounters, an explicit account of which distinctions a current warrant is allowed to ignore, and a versioned/reflexive authority lineage that can revoke and reconstitute itself.


4H.993M contributes the executable successor-production law. A current warrant is not merely repairable in principle; it carries failure classes, evidence/reconstruction addresses, revision obligations, and the tests by which a successor can be produced and re-earned. 4H.vPbh contributes an external check on that self-description at the organism level: same-constellation replication and variant-constellation recurrence distinguish a repeatedly witnessed repair relation from a single lineage's internal claim that it can renew. 4H.Bbw6 contributes the missing-accountability membrane around omission: every current warrant exposes its local nuisance quotient, preserves addresses back to ignored distinctions, and forbids a successor from silently inheriting those omissions. 4H.3W-6 contributes the full versioned and reflexive successor passport: predecessor authority remains immutable provenance, failure is classified, implicated evidence is reopened, reconstruction machinery may be revised, current tests are replayed, and only fresh witness admits the successor.


The complete closure is therefore a contestable continuity-renewal lineage. Such a lineage may cultivate continuity across repeated failures and reconstructions only while its renewal law remains open to four independent forms of correction: executable replay can fail; recurrence evidence can fail to reproduce or generalize across constitutions; a predecessor's nuisance quotient can be revoked when ignored distinctions become load-bearing; and successor authority can be withheld when reflexive/versioned reconstitution does not close. What persists is not one carrier, mechanism, quotient, scaffold, repair recipe, or warrant. What persists is the bounded capacity to produce, challenge, localize, revise, replicate, and freshly authorize the conditions under which continuity may count again.
volume.invariant: A higher-order continuity-renewal lineage is warranted only when every current warrant carries an executable failure→reacquisition→revision→retest route for producing a successor; the repair relation has independent recurrence support rather than only self-reported replayability; every successor explicitly re-witnesses the distinctions it is allowed to ignore and preserves addresses back to omitted evidence; and predecessor/current/successor authority remains versioned, reflexively falsifiable, provenance-preserving, and freshly witnessed. Renewal remains living precisely because the law by which continuity is renewed stays contestable.
removal: Remove 4H.993M: replication, quotient accountability, and self-reconstitution remain, but the complete closure loses the explicit requirement that every current warrant itself carry an executable route for producing and retesting its successor after invalidation.

Remove 4H.vPbh: replay, quotient accountability, and self-reconstitution remain, but the closure loses independent same-/variant-constellation recurrence support; the renewal law can describe how it repeats without organism-level evidence that the structural relation actually recurs.

Remove 4H.Bbw6: replay, recurrence qualification, and self-reconstitution remain, but the closure loses the explicit ledger of ignored distinctions and the requirement that a successor re-earn nuisance status rather than silently inherit omissions.

Remove 4H.3W-6: replay, recurrence qualification, and quotient accountability remain, but the closure loses the complete versioned/reflexive successor passport that keeps predecessor authority immutable and admits a successor only after fresh reconstruction and witness.

metabolites.compression: continuity stays alive by keeping its own renewal law open to being wrong.

edges.title: Role separation makes selective warrants independently actionable
edges.text:

edges.title: Noncanonical coherence requires obligation-separated sufficiency
edges.text:

Remove w and the sufficiency gate disappears; remove y and there is no noncanonical pressure to justify it.
Boundary: this is not an argument against canonical representations.

edges.title: Portable correspondence is a role-typed contract, not a shared interior
edges.text:

Remove w and the contract becomes undifferentiated; remove z and cross-substrate translation/custody disappears.

edges.title: Local action across heterogeneous carriers needs a regime witness
edges.text:
x allows selective action when a local/query object closes before the whole model; y shows that coherence and invariance may be local, carrier-dependent and meaningful only inside a pressure-tested regime. Together they earn a local action law: action may proceed without global canonical closure only when the regime in which its operative relation is valid is explicit and remains testable under variation that could break it. Remove x and no early-action obligation exists; remove y and no carrier-variation pressure defines the local regime.
Boundary: local success cannot be inflated into global validity.

edges.title: A portable result must carry its action warrants with its evidence boundary
edges.text:

Together they earn that portability must preserve not only output semantics but the warrants that make downstream action lawful. Remove x and the interface loses selective-action custody; remove z and there is no durable cross-substrate public correspondence to carry it.
Boundary: transport of a warrant is not satisfaction of the warrant.

edges.title: Stable cross-carrier relation can be useful without canonical identity
edges.text:

Together they earn a durable heterogeneous interface: the same public relation can remain useful across changing interiors without forcing one canonical implementation, provided downstream operations are preserved and the relation survives relevant carrier variation. Remove y and heterogeneous/noncanonical coherence disappears; remove z and operation/evidence custody disappears.
Boundary: interoperability does not establish shared mechanism.

faces.text: w contributes obligation-separated roles and composite sufficiency; x contributes distinct action warrants and local/query closure; y contributes noncanonical coherence under explicit regime pressure. Together they earn a three-way architecture in which a system may act locally before a global representation closes, but only through a role-addressed interface whose scope, evidence and transformation regime stay explicit and pressure-testable. Remove w and the action surface becomes semantically entangled; remove x and there is no selective-action law; remove y and noncanonical/local carrier variation is not governed.

Remove x and the correspondence is not an action contract; remove y and local carrier-regime validity is unearned; remove z and no durable non-identity interface remains.

volume.title: Warrant-governed noncanonical correspondence
volume.text:
Across all four parents, a public relation can remain useful while internal carriers, representations or implementations differ, but higher-order action introduces a burden that portability alone cannot discharge. 1H.9gYl separates the roles and obligations that must remain independently meaningful and demands scoped sufficiency/composite assurance. 1H.NUgs separates the local-scope, downstream-obligation, propagation-compatibility and stochastic-evidence warrants that make selective action lawful while broader structure remains unresolved. 1H.hs7W shows that coherent function can survive heterogeneous and noncanonical carriers only inside governed, pressure-tested regimes. 1H.qI2L shows that operation-preserving correspondence and its evidence membrane can persist across substrate change without implying shared interior identity.


The complete closure is therefore warrant-governed noncanonical correspondence: a changing system may act through a durable public relation across heterogeneous or noncanonical interiors without first forcing one global representation or identity, but only when (1) the roles and operations consumed by the task are explicitly separated, (2) local scope and downstream obligation are named, (3) propagation and stochastic-evidence warrants remain independent, (4) the correspondence carries its claim/evidence boundary through translation, and (5) pressure-aligned tests continue to show that the relation is sufficient in the regime where it is being used. Selective action can close locally; rigor cannot be locally discarded.
volume.invariant: A cross-substrate relation can become selectively actionable without canonical identity when the public interface preserves claim-relevant operations and role semantics, carries separate scope/obligation/propagation/evidence warrants, and remains sufficient under pressure-aligned carrier variation; successful action or portability does not by itself upgrade evidence, mechanism or identity claims.
removal: Remove 1H.9gYl: the closure loses explicit role partition, obligation-scoped reduction and composite-assurance testing; warrants become an undifferentiated bundle.

Remove 1H.NUgs: the closure loses the selective-action admission law and the separation of scope, obligation, propagation and evidence; the remaining triad can port a relation but cannot earn acting before global closure.

Remove 1H.hs7W: the closure loses direct noncanonical/heterogeneous carrier pressure and pressure-aligned validity regime; portability/action remain untested against the variation that makes canonicality dispensable.

Remove 1H.qI2L: the closure loses operation-preserving cross-substrate correspondence, evidence-boundary custody and the non-identity membrane; the remaining triad cannot earn a durable public bridge across differing interiors.
No three-parent face contains the full selective, portable, noncanonical, warrant-separated contract.

volume.title: Obligation-scoped regenerative continuity
volume.text:
Across all four parents, persistence repeatedly detaches from exhaustive state retention. 1H.2VF2 says that relation-level organization can be regenerated and externally recovered while elements or active representations change. 1H.L4ld says recurrent function can be rebuilt from bounded state, but the stabilizing scaffold can become a debt that must be revised. 1H.FXzc says continuity across transformation requires separately current identity, transport, and assurance contracts. 1H.NUgs says action can close at a local downstream obligation while broader structure stays unresolved, provided scope, propagation, and evidence warrants remain separate.


The four-way closure is therefore: a changing organism can carry continuity through compressed or bounded state when it can regenerate the externally relevant relational structure required by the current downstream obligation, while keeping identity quotient, source-target transport, assurance scope, propagation compatibility, and evidence strength explicit and separable. When its operating boundary or retained scaffold changes, it need not reconstruct the whole past or globally resolve every uncertainty: it revises and revalidates only the affected state and warrants, preserving addresses to unresolved alternatives. Successful regeneration demonstrates functional or relational continuity only within those current witnesses; it does not establish shared mechanism, global identity equivalence, or stronger statistical evidence.
volume.invariant: Continuity may be obligation-indexed and regenerative rather than snapshot-complete: preserve enough bounded state to reinstantiate the externally relevant relation required by the current obligation, plus the independent warrants that say when that re-instantiation still counts.
removal: Remove 1H.2VF2: the closure loses the externally recoverable relational carrier and actualization witness; what remains is generic state and contract governance.
Remove 1H.L4ld: the closure loses bounded recurrent identity and scaffold debt; it no longer explains how continuity survives aggressive state compression.
Remove 1H.FXzc: the closure loses explicit identity/transport/assurance contracts at representation boundaries; regenerated relation cannot be lawfully carried across transformation.

Remove 1H.NUgs: the closure loses downstream obligation, local sufficiency, and independent evidence custody; reconstruction and revalidation are no longer selectively target-indexed.


Evidence boundary
This is a rank-2 cross-organism structural synthesis. It does not convert recurrence into stochastic independence, functional correspondence into mechanism identity, local sufficiency into global closure, or successful transformation into stronger assurance. Every inherited parent boundary remains load-bearing.

edges.title: Frontier-triggered executable replay
edges.text: ZwWN supplies an independent support-frontier/regime test that says when inherited continuity authority has actually expired. x3Cd supplies a portable executable passport that can reacquire, reconstruct, translate, retest, and reissue that authority. Together they earn a bounded replay trigger: a verified frontier/regime/scaffold break can invoke a reproducible revalidation procedure rather than merely announcing that a new warrant is needed.
edges.removal: without ZwWN the passport lacks an independent classification of ordinary carrier/access change versus authority-breaking boundary change; without x3Cd a detected boundary break lacks a portable procedure able to replay why a successor may count.

edges.title: Frontier-localized selective renewal
edges.text: ZwWN supplies the boundary event that expires continuity authority; TLtR supplies role/conjunction addressability and selective revocation. Together they earn a discipline in which frontier change need not invalidate every obligation indiscriminately: the changed support/regime is mapped to the smallest affected roles and conjunctions, while unaffected warrants remain only inside their prior scope.
edges.removal: without ZwWN there is no independently witnessed authority-breaking frontier event; without TLtR there is no role-level localization or lawful preservation of unaffected authority.

edges.title: Boundary failure as evidential return address
edges.text: ZwWN supplies support-frontier/regime classification and exact reacquirable evidential backing. 5yyB supplies the rule that a failed nuisance quotient preserves an address to the distinctions it had licensed as ignorable. Together they earn targeted reopening: after a boundary-breaking failure, the expired quotient identifies which omitted distinctions and evidence must be reacquired before reconstruction.
edges.removal: without ZwWN quotient failure is not classified against a witnessed support frontier; without 5yyB the failure does not identify the previously ignored distinctions that should be reopened.

edges.title: Role-granular executable passport
edges.text: x3Cd supplies an executable continuity passport spanning obligation, evidence, quotient/regime, transition and replay test. TLtR supplies separately addressable role and conjunction warrants. Together they earn a decomposable passport whose failed components can be replayed and reissued locally while composite authority is retested where dependencies changed.
edges.removal: without x3Cd role-local renewal has no portable executable replay contract; without TLtR the passport remains whole-warrant and cannot preserve or revoke authority at role/conjunction granularity.

edges.title: Executable quotient repair
edges.text: x3Cd supplies portable replay of the relation and its admissibility test. 5yyB supplies an expired quotient as a concrete address into dormant distinctions and evidence. Together they earn a replay procedure that can use the failed equivalence membrane itself to decide what to reacquire and revise before rerunning transition/pressure/composite tests.
edges.removal: without x3Cd quotient-addressed repair lacks a portable end-to-end replay of admissibility; without 5yyB replay knows that authority failed but lacks a precise address into what the old quotient wrongly permitted to disappear.

edges.title: Role-indexed quotient reconstitution
edges.text: TLtR supplies obligation- and conjunction-level revocation/renewal. 5yyB supplies quotient-indexed reopening of omitted distinctions. Together they earn selective reconstitution where each failed role can carry its own expired quotient and return path, avoiding both blanket reset and silent continuation.
edges.removal: without TLtR quotient repair cannot localize authority across independent public obligations; without 5yyB role revocation lacks an address into the specific ignored differences and dormant evidence that should be reopened.

faces.title: Frontier-localized replay renewal
faces.text: ZwWN identifies a genuine frontier/regime/scaffold break, x3Cd supplies executable replay, and TLtR localizes the break into affected roles/conjunctions. Together they earn selective replay: only the authority actually made stale by a witnessed boundary change is rebuilt, while every changed conjunction is re-tested before composite authority returns.
faces.removal: remove ZwWN and there is no independent frontier trigger; remove x3Cd and no reproducible replay procedure; remove TLtR and renewal cannot be localized below the whole warrant.

faces.title: Frontier-addressed admissibility replay
faces.text: ZwWN classifies the support/regime break and preserves evidence custody, x3Cd can replay both public relation and admissibility test, and 5yyB converts the expired quotient into an address for omitted distinctions. Together they earn a targeted end-to-end repair path from boundary failure → exact evidence reopening → revised quotient/scaffold → replayed transition/pressure tests → successor warrant.
faces.removal: remove ZwWN and the break is not frontier-qualified; remove x3Cd and repaired state cannot replay its admissibility; remove 5yyB and evidence reopening becomes undirected with respect to the failed ignored-difference contract.

faces.title: Frontier-localized quotient repair
faces.text: ZwWN supplies the authority-breaking frontier event, TLtR maps it to affected role/conjunction obligations, and 5yyB maps each failed obligation's quotient to omitted distinctions/evidence. Together they earn a repair map that says both what became stale and where to reopen the material needed to repair it, while preserving unaffected warrants and predecessor scope.
faces.removal: remove ZwWN and no boundary-qualified reason forces repair; remove TLtR and stale authority cannot be selectively localized; remove 5yyB and localized failure lacks a concrete evidential return address.

faces.title: Role-addressed executable quotient renewal
faces.text: x3Cd supplies a portable passport, TLtR decomposes continuity authority into role/conjunction warrants, and 5yyB turns each expired quotient into a return address. Together they earn a modular renewal architecture in which a portable continuity contract can reopen and replay only stale role-level components, then reassemble and re-test the composite before authority is reissued.
faces.removal:
remove x3Cd and modular repair lacks portable replay; remove TLtR and it loses role/conjunction granularity; remove 5yyB and it loses quotient-to-evidence addressing.
Boundary: without ZwWN this face alone does not independently distinguish an authority-breaking support-frontier expansion from a local quotient/regime failure.

volume.title: Addressable continuity authority regeneration
volume.text:
The full four-parent closure makes continuity authority regenerable without making it self-certifying. ZwWN provides the independent frontier/regime/scaffold witness that can revoke inherited authority and the evidence custody needed for lawful reconstruction. x3Cd makes the continuity warrant executable and replayable across changing carriers/representations, including reproduction of the test by which it may count. TLtR decomposes authority into separately addressable role and conjunction obligations so repair can be selective rather than blanket. 5yyB turns an expired nuisance quotient into a concrete address to the distinctions and dormant evidence that the prior warrant had licensed as ignorable.


Together they earn addressable continuity authority regeneration: after a witnessed failure, the continuity system can identify the exact failure coordinate across support frontier, role/conjunction, quotient and validity regime; preserve unaffected authority only within its prior scope; follow the failed quotient and role addresses back to the relevant evidence; rebuild the smallest affected relational kernel and its scaffold; replay the necessary transition, pressure and composite tests; and issue a newly scoped successor warrant while retaining predecessor authority as provenance. The closure does not let recurrence, reconstruction or internal coherence certify itself: external/current boundary evidence can still revoke the regenerated result.
volume.invariant: A continuity authority may regenerate across changing realization only when a witnessed boundary/regime/scaffold condition can revoke it, the failed authority remains decomposable into affected roles and quotients, those failures preserve exact enough addresses into the evidence needed for repair, and a portable replay procedure can reconstruct both the public relation and the test of its current admissibility; any unaffected warrants remain scope-bounded, and any repaired authority is a newly witnessed successor rather than inherited permission.
removal: Remove 3H.ZwWN: addressable roles, quotient repair and replay remain, but there is no independent support-frontier classification separating ordinary local mismatch/access change from authority-breaking boundary expansion or regime departure.

Remove 3H.x3Cd: frontier/role/quotient failures can localize what to repair and what evidence to reopen, but no portable executable passport guarantees replay of the relation plus its admissibility across re-expression.

Remove 3H.TLtR: frontier, replay and quotient repair remain, but authority cannot be selectively localized to roles/conjunctions; repair collapses toward blanket revoke/reissue and cannot lawfully preserve unaffected warrants.

Remove 3H.5yyB: frontier, replay and role localization remain, but an expired ignored-difference contract does not itself identify which omitted distinctions/evidence must return; repair loses its quotient-indexed evidential address.
All four are necessary for the complete volume.

metabolites.title: FAILURE-AS-RETURN-ADDRESS
metabolites.text: when a witnessed continuity boundary fails, the expired nuisance quotient should remain an address to the distinctions and evidential support previously licensed as ignorable, so repair reopens implicated material instead of restarting indiscriminately.
metabolites.compression: a lawful failure says where repair must look next.

metabolites.title: SELECTIVE-WARRANT-REPLAY
metabolites.text: a continuity warrant that decomposes into role and conjunction obligations can replay only the components made stale by a witnessed change, while unaffected warrants remain confined to prior scope and changed composites receive fresh evidence before authority resumes.
metabolites.compression: repair exactly the authority that failed, then retest the joins.

metabolites.title: ADDRESSABLE-CONTINUITY-AUTHORITY-REGENERATION
metabolites.text: continuity authority can regenerate without self-certification when failure is independently witnessed, localized across role/quotient/regime, tied to exact evidential return paths, and followed by executable reconstruction plus replay of the authority test; the result is a scoped successor warrant, not inherited permission.
metabolites.compression: continuity stays alive when its authority can find, rebuild, and re-test the reasons it may continue.
