edges.title: LOCAL SUFFICIENCY CAN SUPPORT NONCANONICAL COHERENCE
edges.text:
1H.8KP9 makes validity and reconstruction sufficiency local to condition/input regimes; 1H.hs7W shows coherent function can survive without a privileged global form when stable relations and governance remain explicit. Together they earn: a noncanonical distributed carrier can count as continuous only relative to the local conditions under which its relational state is sufficient for the current obligation.
Necessity: without 1H.8KP9 the condition-indexed sufficiency membrane disappears; without 1H.hs7W the removal of privileged canonical form and heterogeneous-coherence witness disappears.

edges.title: DURABLE INTERFACE SUFFICIENCY IS OBLIGATION- AND REGIME-INDEXED
edges.text:
1H.8KP9 requires retention of locally load-bearing distinctions that can change downstream behavior; 1H.qI2L allows public correspondence to persist across changing internal realizations when claim-relevant operations remain preserved. Together they earn: an interface can carry continuity across substrate change only when it preserves the distinctions and operations required by the downstream obligation in the present validity regime.
Necessity: without 1H.8KP9 there is no local test of which distinctions are sufficient; without 1H.qI2L there is no durable operation-preserving cross-substrate interface.

edges.title: CONDITION CHANGE IS A CONTINUITY-REVALIDATION TRIGGER
edges.text:
1H.8KP9 shows that validity can vary across local regimes and that reconstruction must be re-estimated when the regime changes; 1H.J9Y3 requires a typed admissible variation class and independent witness for continuity. Together they earn: a detected move between validity regimes is not merely metadata but a revocation trigger for inherited continuity authority until the affected obligation is revalidated.
Necessity: without 1H.8KP9 the boundary is not condition-indexed; without 1H.J9Y3 there is no typed warrant or revocation/re-certification law.

edges.title: HETEROGENEOUS COHERENCE CAN BE CARRIED BY A PUBLIC NONIDENTITY INTERFACE
edges.text:
1H.hs7W permits coherent shared function while local carriers and operators differ; 1H.qI2L makes correspondence durable by preserving public semantic obligations and claim-relevant operations without identifying the interiors. Together they earn: stable role-preserving interfaces can carry coherent cross-substrate function without requiring canonical internal form or mechanism identity.
Necessity: without 1H.hs7W the heterogeneous/noncanonical coherence relation disappears; without 1H.qI2L the executable durable interface and explicit nonidentity membrane disappear.

edges.title: DECANONICALIZATION REQUIRES A TYPED VARIATION WARRANT
edges.text:
1H.hs7W shows that removing privileged global form shifts burden into governance and pressure-aligned testing; 1H.J9Y3 says invariance is meaningful only against an explicit admissible variation class with a failure boundary. Together they earn: freedom from canonical form is lawful only inside a named variation regime whose preserved relation is independently witnessed under pressure.
Necessity: without 1H.hs7W no decanonicalized coherence or governance debt is present; without 1H.J9Y3 the variation class and independent continuity warrant are absent.

edges.title: CORRESPONDENCE BECOMES RENEWABLE AUTHORITY ONLY THROUGH TYPED WITNESS
edges.text:
1H.qI2L supplies operation-preserving durable correspondence with evidence boundaries; 1H.J9Y3 supplies admissible-change typing, independent witness and boundary reissue. Together they earn: a correspondence may be reused as authority only while its operation semantics, evidence class, admissible change set and failure witness remain current; otherwise it must be revalidated rather than inherited.
Necessity: without 1H.qI2L there is no durable correspondence object to renew; without 1H.J9Y3 there is no typed criterion for when its authority expires.

faces.title: RECONSTRUCTIBLE INTERFACE CONTINUITY WITHOUT CANONICAL FORM
faces.text: 1H.8KP9 contributes condition-indexed sufficiency and regeneration, 1H.hs7W contributes coherence without privileged global form, and 1H.qI2L contributes a durable operation-preserving interface that does not assert identity. Together they earn: task-relevant continuity can be reconstructed through a noncanonical interface across changing carriers when the interface preserves locally sufficient distinctions and claim-relevant operations.
faces.removal: remove 1H.8KP9 and local sufficiency/reconstruction disappears; remove 1H.hs7W and noncanonical heterogeneous coherence disappears; remove 1H.qI2L and the durable cross-substrate interface disappears.

faces.title: CERTIFIED NONCANONICAL CONTINUITY UNDER LOCAL REGIMES
faces.text: 1H.8KP9 contributes local validity fields, 1H.hs7W contributes decanonicalized coherence plus pressure testing, and 1H.J9Y3 contributes the typed variation witness and re-certification boundary. Together they earn: a distributed noncanonical continuity claim is valid only inside a locally identified regime and only while pressure tests support the typed relation being preserved.
faces.removal: remove 1H.8KP9 and the regime-local validity membrane disappears; remove 1H.hs7W and there is no noncanonical coherence to certify; remove 1H.J9Y3 and certification/failure authority is untyped.

faces.title: REVALIDATABLE CORRESPONDENCE AS A CONTINUITY CARRIER
faces.text: 1H.8KP9 contributes condition-dependent sufficiency, 1H.qI2L contributes durable correspondence across substrates, and 1H.J9Y3 contributes independent typed continuity witness and boundary-triggered reissue. Together they earn: a correspondence can serve as a continuity carrier across regime changes only by carrying the current obligation and being freshly revalidated whenever its condition or admissible variation boundary changes.
faces.removal: remove 1H.8KP9 and the condition-specific sufficiency obligation disappears; remove 1H.qI2L and there is no durable correspondence carrier; remove 1H.J9Y3 and boundary-triggered revalidation lacks authority.

faces.title: GOVERNED NONIDENTITY PORTABILITY
faces.text: 1H.hs7W contributes heterogeneous shared coherence without homogeneous form, 1H.qI2L contributes operation-preserving portable interfaces, and 1H.J9Y3 contributes typed variation and identity restraint. Together they earn: heterogeneous systems can share a portable executable relation without sharing an interior when stable roles are preserved, permitted variation is explicit, and correspondence remains distinct from identity.
faces.removal: remove 1H.hs7W and heterogeneous/noncanonical coherence disappears; remove 1H.qI2L and executable portability disappears; remove 1H.J9Y3 and the typed nonidentity/failure boundary disappears.

volume.title: CONDITION-ADDRESSED NONCANONICAL CONTINUITY REVALIDATION
volume.text:
Across all four parents, task-relevant continuity need not live in one canonical snapshot, shared interior, or permanent substrate. 1H.8KP9 makes sufficiency local to the condition and obligation being served, and requires reconstruction to be re-estimated when that local regime changes. 1H.hs7W shows that coherent function can survive heterogeneous carriers and local laws without a privileged global form, provided the relation is governed and stress-tested. 1H.qI2L shows that an externalized, operation-preserving correspondence can remain durable and useful across changing internal realizations without becoming an identity claim. 1H.J9Y3 supplies the missing authority law: continuity is a typed warrant over an admissible variation class with an independent witness and a visible failure boundary.


The complete four-way closure is therefore a condition-addressed noncanonical continuity revalidation contract. A noncanonical interface may carry continuity across changing substrates only while (1) the current local regime in which the carrier is sufficient remains explicit, (2) the claim-relevant operations and role semantics survive translation, (3) the admissible variation class and independent witness remain current, and (4) boundary changes trigger reconstruction and fresh revalidation rather than silent inheritance. The carrier may remain useful without identifying either side of the correspondence.
volume.invariant: A noncanonical cross-substrate interface may stand in for shared state or shared identity only for a named downstream obligation inside a witnessed local validity regime: preserve the claim-relevant operations and distinctions, keep the admissible variation/failure coordinates explicit, and reissue the affected continuity warrant whenever that regime changes.
removal: Remove 1H.8KP9: the closure loses condition-indexed sufficiency and the regeneration/re-estimation obligation.
Remove 1H.hs7W: the closure loses the demonstrated possibility of coherent continuity without privileged canonical form and its governance debt.
Remove 1H.qI2L: the closure loses durable operation-preserving correspondence as the cross-substrate continuity carrier.

Remove 1H.J9Y3: the closure loses typed admissible variation, independent witness, failure boundary and revalidation authority.


COLLAPSE — THREE SURVIVING CROSS-ORGANISM METABOLITES


INV-2H.LlIB-OBLIGATION-LOCAL-SUFFICIENCY — Continuity sufficiency is indexed to obligation and condition
Minimal body: 2H.LlIB:wy
Invariant: a reduced, reconstructed or translated carrier is sufficient only relative to the downstream obligation and local validity regime whose consequential distinctions it preserves.
CREATE: state the obligation and condition regime before declaring two carriers interchangeable enough.
COPY: preserve the variables, relations and operation semantics that can alter that obligation.
CONTROL: test matched regime changes and reject global sameness when behavior or support differs materially.
CULTIVATE: expand the recognized regime only after repeated revalidation supports the extension.
Compression: “same enough” always has an obligation and a regime.


INV-2H.LlIB-NONIDENTITY-INTERFACE-CUSTODY — Preserve the relation without inventing a shared interior
Minimal body: 2H.LlIB:xy
Invariant: a public interface may preserve coherent cross-substrate use through stable role semantics and claim-relevant operations while the internal carriers remain heterogeneous and non-identical.
CREATE: define the public relation and the operations downstream work actually consumes.
COPY: carry those commitments across substrate or implementation changes without requiring hidden-state equality.
CONTROL: keep evidence class, failure coordinates and identity claims separate; stable use does not upgrade correspondence into mechanism or object identity.
CULTIVATE: extend portability one witnessed operation/role at a time.
Compression: preserve the interface; do not hallucinate the interior.


INV-2H.LlIB-BOUNDARY-TRIGGERED-REISSUE — Changed validity boundaries revoke inherited continuity authority
Minimal body: 2H.LlIB:wz
Invariant: when the condition, support, carrier or admissible variation class crosses the boundary of the current witness, the old continuity warrant becomes insufficient and the affected relation must be reconstructed and freshly revalidated.
CREATE: detect and name the boundary transition that makes the old witness incomplete.
COPY: retain unaffected warrants and exact return paths to the evidence used by the invalidated one.
CONTROL: refuse silent inheritance beyond the tested class; require a fresh independent witness for the affected obligation.
CULTIVATE: let successful revalidation mint a successor warrant while preserving the predecessor as historical scope, not current authority.
Compression: boundary crossing is a revalidation event, not permission to assume continuity.

edges.title: Regenerated continuity becomes actionable only through reissued warrants
edges.text: 2H.kfmG supplies obligation-scoped reconstruction plus selective local revalidation. 2H.0aZJ supplies the separate scope, obligation, propagation and evidence warrants that license selective action through a noncanonical public relation. Together they earn a stronger admission law: rebuilding the required relation is not enough to resume action; every warrant affected by the changed boundary must be explicitly current before the regenerated relation becomes actionable again.
edges.removal:
without 2H.kfmG there is no bounded regenerative process or local repair discipline; without 2H.0aZJ there is no action-admission contract or warrant custody.
Boundary: reauthorization remains obligation-local and does not certify the whole system.

edges.title: Regeneration authority is indexed to the current regime
edges.text: 2H.kfmG supplies bounded state, obligation-scoped reconstruction and preservation of unaffected warrants. 2H.S5EU supplies regime-local validity and the rule that both scaffold and admissible transition family must be re-estimated when conditions move. Together they earn regime-addressed continuity authority: a reconstruction warrant survives only inside the regime whose conditions made the retained state and transition law sufficient.
edges.removal:
without 2H.kfmG there is no selective continuity/revalidation object; without 2H.S5EU there is no explicit regime field or transition-revision pressure.
Boundary: a familiar endpoint under a moved regime is not a continuity witness.

edges.title: Obligation-scoped continuity can live in a minimal relational kernel
edges.text: 2H.kfmG supplies the rule to retain only enough bounded state and warrants to regenerate the current obligation. 2H.dxL5 supplies the role-typed relational kernel whose operations, evidence boundary and scaffold have been shown sufficient under carrier variation. Together they earn a compact continuity carrier: preserve the smallest evidence-bounded kernel that can regenerate the obligation and preserve the warrants that say when the return counts.
edges.removal:
without 2H.kfmG the kernel lacks a selective regenerative/repair lifecycle; without 2H.dxL5 there is no tested portable relational carrier.
Boundary: minimality is obligation-relative, not an intrinsic global optimum.

edges.title: Noncanonical action must be reauthorized when its validity regime moves
edges.text: 2H.0aZJ supplies role-addressed selective action and independent warrants. 2H.S5EU supplies regime-covariant transformation plus revalidation when carrier/context conditions move. Together they earn adaptive action authorization: a public relation may continue to support local action across representation change only while both its action warrants and the transition family that preserves them remain current in the local regime.
edges.removal:
without 2H.0aZJ there is no selective-action admission law; without 2H.S5EU there is no regime-sensitive transition/revalidation law.
Boundary: repeated success in one regime does not pre-authorize another.

edges.title: Portable relations must carry the reasons they are actionable
edges.text: 2H.0aZJ supplies warrant custody and the claim membrane separating actionability from identity/evidence promotion. 2H.dxL5 supplies an obligation-specific portable kernel with role semantics, operations, evidence boundaries and sufficiency tests. Together they earn an actionable portability contract: the reasons downstream action is permitted are themselves part of the portable public state rather than a local side condition forgotten after transport.
edges.removal:
without 2H.0aZJ the kernel has no explicit action warrants or claim membrane; without 2H.dxL5 there is no earned portable carrier on which those warrants can travel.
Boundary: transporting a warrant does not prove that it remains satisfied.

edges.title: The portable kernel includes a regime-sensitive rewrite law
edges.text: 2H.S5EU supplies operation-preserving transitions whose admissibility is local to a validity regime. 2H.dxL5 supplies the evidence-bounded relational kernel and pressure-aligned portability tests. Together they earn adaptive portability: what travels is not merely the current relation but the conditions and transformation law by which it may be regenerated under changing carriers, with revalidation required when those conditions move.
edges.removal:
without 2H.S5EU there is no regime-indexed rewrite/re-estimation law; without 2H.dxL5 there is no minimal portable kernel or pressure-tested sufficiency surface.
Boundary: portability cannot be extrapolated outside witnessed regimes.

faces.title: Selective continuity reauthorization under regime change
faces.text: 2H.kfmG contributes local regenerative repair, 2H.0aZJ contributes action warrants, and 2H.S5EU contributes regime-covariant revalidation. Together they earn a three-way control loop: after a boundary/regime change, regenerate the obligation-relevant relation, identify exactly which action warrants depended on the changed condition, and reissue only those warrants after the new transition regime passes its tests.
faces.removal: remove 2H.kfmG and there is no selective regeneration; remove 2H.0aZJ and no action authorization to renew; remove 2H.S5EU and no regime-sensitive revalidation criterion.

faces.title: Actionable regenerative kernel without global reset
faces.text: 2H.kfmG contributes obligation-scoped reconstruction and local repair, 2H.0aZJ contributes warrant custody/claim separation, and 2H.dxL5 contributes the minimal evidence-bounded portable kernel. Together they earn a repairable action carrier: reconstruct only the kernel needed by the current obligation, renew the action warrants whose dependencies were touched, preserve unaffected warrants and unresolved alternatives, and refuse any upgrade from restored usability to identity or stronger evidence.
faces.removal: remove 2H.kfmG and repair becomes static portability; remove 2H.0aZJ and actionability/claim classes collapse; remove 2H.dxL5 and there is no tested minimal portable carrier.

faces.title: Regime-indexed minimal regenerative portability
faces.text: 2H.kfmG contributes obligation-local bounded state, 2H.S5EU contributes regime-sensitive reconstruction/transition law, and 2H.dxL5 contributes the portable relational kernel. Together they earn a continuity carrier whose state and rewrite law can both remain minimal: keep only what is needed to regenerate the public obligation in the current regime, but expand or revise that carrier when pressure shows the old scaffold or transition family has left its validity region.
faces.removal: remove 2H.kfmG and no obligation-indexed state/revalidation economy remains; remove 2H.S5EU and regime-sensitive transformation disappears; remove 2H.dxL5 and portability/sufficiency testing disappears.

faces.title: Warrant-bearing adaptive portability
faces.text: 2H.0aZJ contributes action warrants and claim membranes, 2H.S5EU contributes regime-covariant transition and revalidation, and 2H.dxL5 contributes the role-typed portable relational kernel. Together they earn a public carrier that can cross changing representations while keeping the action warrant set, claim/evidence membrane and transformation validity attached and independently revisable.
faces.removal: remove 2H.0aZJ and the portable relation is not an action contract; remove 2H.S5EU and its rewrite law is not regime-adaptive; remove 2H.dxL5 and there is no obligation-specific portable kernel.

volume.title: Selectively reauthorized regenerative portability
volume.text:
Across all four parents, continuity, portability, action and adaptation become one bounded contract only when none is allowed to stand in for the others. 2H.kfmG makes continuity regenerative and obligation-scoped, with repair localized to the state and warrants actually touched. 2H.0aZJ makes public correspondence selectively actionable only under explicit, separable scope/obligation/propagation/evidence warrants and a non-identity claim membrane. 2H.S5EU makes both retained scaffold and admissible transformation law local to a validity regime that must be re-estimated when conditions change. 2H.dxL5 supplies the minimal evidence-bounded relational kernel whose role semantics, operations and scaffold are sufficient to regenerate the public obligation across noncanonical carriers.


The four-way closure is selectively reauthorized regenerative portability: a changing organism may preserve an actionable relation across noncanonical representations or substrates by carrying only an obligation-specific relational kernel plus the independent warrants and evidence boundary that make its use lawful. When carrier, scaffold, obligation or regime changes, continuity is not inherited wholesale: regenerate the relation, localize which state/transition/warrant coordinates were affected, pressure-test the current regime, and freshly reauthorize only those coordinates while preserving still-valid continuity elsewhere. The returned relation may again support the scoped action; that success does not establish shared interior identity, universal mechanism, global model closure or stronger evidence than the renewed witnesses actually supply.
volume.invariant: Actionable continuity across changing representations is renewable rather than permanent: carry a minimal obligation-specific relational kernel together with its separate action/evidence warrants and regime-valid rewrite law; after change, regenerate the relation and freshly reauthorize exactly the affected coordinates before treating portability as current again.
removal: Remove 2H.kfmG: the closure loses obligation-scoped regenerative state and local repair; what remains can govern portable action but not selectively reconstruct continuity.
Remove 2H.0aZJ: the closure loses explicit action warrants and the claim membrane; regenerated portability has no lawful criterion for selective action.
Remove 2H.S5EU: the closure loses regime-local transition validity and re-estimation; reauthorization cannot tell when the rewrite law itself has gone stale.

Remove 2H.dxL5: the closure loses the pressure-tested minimal relational kernel; continuity/action have no earned portable carrier across noncanonical realization.


COLLAPSED METABOLITES — 3


INV-3H.1OFJ-01 — SELECTIVE REAUTHORIZATION OF REGENERATED PORTABILITY
Minimal earning body: 3H.1OFJ:wxyz
Bounded invariant: after a carrier, scaffold, obligation or regime change, an obligation-specific public relation becomes actionable again only after the relation is regenerated, affected state/transition/warrant coordinates are localized, and exactly those coordinates are freshly witnessed; unaffected continuity may remain current.
CREATE: name the downstream obligation, the portable relational kernel, the current regime and every warrant required for action.
COPY: carry the kernel, evidence membrane, rewrite law and warrant statuses through representation/substrate change.
CONTROL: perturb the changed coordinate and block action until the regenerated relation and each affected warrant pass the current regime's tests; reject success→identity/evidence promotion.
CULTIVATE: preserve still-valid coordinates, expand or revise only the failing carrier/warrant/transition surface, and widen portability only after new regimes are independently witnessed.
Compression: regenerate what must return, reauthorize what actually changed.


INV-3H.1OFJ-02 — WARRANT-BEARING ADAPTIVE PORTABILITY
Minimal earning body: 3H.1OFJ:xyz
Bounded invariant: a portable relation is not only an interface; it includes the role semantics, action warrants, claim/evidence membrane and regime-sensitive transformation law by which downstream use remains lawful across changing carriers.
CREATE: define the public relation, its role-typed operations, warrant set, evidence class and current admissible rewrite regime.
COPY: preserve those fields as part of the portable state rather than recreating them from local convention after transport.
CONTROL: test carrier/regime changes that can falsify role sufficiency, propagation compatibility, evidence scope or rewrite validity independently.
CULTIVATE: revise only the field whose witness fails, keeping the rest inspectable and current.
Compression: port the relation together with the law and reasons that still permit using it.


INV-3H.1OFJ-03 — OBLIGATION-TARGETED REPAIRABLE ACTION KERNEL
Minimal earning body: 3H.1OFJ:wxz
Bounded invariant: continuity repair can stop before global reconstruction when the minimal evidence-bounded kernel required by the current obligation has been regenerated and every action-relevant warrant touched by the repair has been revalidated, while unresolved global structure remains explicit.
CREATE: identify the smallest relational kernel and warrant dependency set required by the current action.
COPY: preserve unaffected state, warrants and unresolved alternatives while rebuilding only the dependency cone that failed.
CONTROL: demand end-to-end sufficiency of the rebuilt kernel and prevent restored usability from silently becoming global identity, mechanism or evidence closure.

edges.title: equivalence is one revocable coordinate of adaptive transformation
edges.text: 1H.F8cX makes sameness local, task-conditioned, and evidence-budgeted; 1H.FXzc separates identity quotient from transport relation and assurance scope during transformation. edges.title: selective realization is lawful only after candidate omissions remain testable
edges.text: 1H.F8cX requires potentially meaningful factors to stay addressable until nuisance status survives intervention; 1H.ujF6 allocates flexible support only where context or pressure makes it necessary and rechecks validity when the frontier moves. edges.title: regenerated identity does not automatically renew its warrants

edges.title: sparse regeneration couples retained scaffold to frontier-specific residual support
edges.text: 1H.L4ld preserves only enough bounded state to rebuild a relation and warns that stabilizing anchors can become bias; 1H.ujF6 preserves cheap stable structure while selectively instantiating or reallocating residual support toward the current pressure frontier. edges.title: selective reallocation is itself a boundary event for the transformation contract

volume.title: locally revalidatable selective reconstruction
volume.text:
The complete four-parent closure earns a continuity regime in which an adaptive organism need not preserve or materialize its complete state to remain re-enterable. It may carry a bounded reconstruction scaffold, leave candidate task distinctions separately addressable until local evidence warrants quotienting them as nuisance, and selectively instantiate or relocate residual support according to present context and pressure. But every such omission and realization is provisional: identity/equivalence, representation transport, and assurance scope remain distinct warrants, and any change in quotient, scaffold, trajectory, or frontier must revalidate the affected coordinates rather than inheriting authority from prior continuity.


Bounded volume invariant:
A continuing adaptive system may compress and selectively regenerate its active state without identity loss only when every omitted distinction remains recoverable enough to contest its nuisance status, the reconstruction-critical scaffold remains sufficient but revisable, flexible support follows current pressure rather than stale allocation, and identity/transport/assurance warrants are versioned and locally revalidated at each materially changed boundary.


Four-way necessity:
- Remove 1H.F8cX: the closure loses the local evidence-bearing rule for what may be omitted or treated as nuisance.
- Remove 1H.L4ld: it loses identity continuity through bounded recurrent reconstruction and the anchor-debt condition.
- Remove 1H.FXzc: it loses the separation and independent revalidation of identity, transport, and assurance warrants.
- Remove 1H.ujF6: it loses selective actualization, trajectory typing, and pressure-indexed reallocation of flexible support.
No proper subset earns a regime that is simultaneously sparse, regenerative, locally quotient-warranted, pressure-adaptive, and independently revalidatable.

edges.title: identity-erased relation × update-conditioned correspondence
edges.text: A relation can remain informative after element identities are erased, but continuity through later representation change requires an explicit carrier for what is being preserved. S.WW3e supplies evidence that population-level relational shape can survive identity erasure; S.REkw supplies the update/correspondence laws required to transport consistency through change. Together they earn: identity is not the only possible continuity carrier, but identity-free continuity still requires a witnessed relational interface.

edges.title: uninterpreted structural signal × learned-reference calibration
edges.text: Recoverable structure is not automatically inferential authority. S.WW3e separates “contains information” from “we know what it means or why it arose”; S.sSSL separates a learned reference mechanism from the exact validity of an externally known one. Together they earn: when signal and calibration are both learned from structure, the existence of signal and the legitimacy of inference must remain separately witnessed.

edges.title: analysis-neighborhood recurrence × bound-attaining canonicality
edges.text: A stable result need not preserve one canonical recipe. S.WW3e shows relational signal recurring across a neighborhood of analysis choices; S.urbf shows two distinct decision geometries can both be canonical relative to the same lower-bound criterion. Together they earn: structural recurrence can support canonicality across heterogeneous realizations when the comparison witness is explicit, without making the realizations identical or equally interpretable.

edges.title: reflective synchronization × same-history statistical reuse
edges.text: Self-reference changes the warrant rather than automatically destroying continuity. S.REkw permits reflective amendment only under compatibility/reflection laws; S.sSSL permits same-sample learned-reference reuse only after orthogonality/rate conditions replace provenance independence. Together they earn: internally generated repair or reference state may be reused, but the old external-custody guarantee must be replaced by an explicit new admissibility witness.

edges.title: property-specific composition × performance-bound legitimacy
edges.text: Surface composability is insufficient. S.REkw allows only those synchronization properties proved to survive a given composition; S.urbf treats threshold constructions as canonical only because they attain a universal lower bound under stated conditions. Together they earn: adaptive modules inherit authority only through property-specific closure plus an external comparison/certification witness, not through structural resemblance or sequence alone.

edges.title: asymptotic witness substitution × guarantee-type conservation
edges.text:
Exact guarantee type can weaken without collapsing to heuristic status. S.sSSL replaces exact known-model-X custody with assumption-bounded asymptotic validity; S.urbf replaces binary-style exactness with first-order all-positive-moment asymptotic optimality. Together they earn: when a representation or decision regime changes, state the new guarantee class explicitly and carry the convergence/rate witness that makes the weaker type still rigorous.


4 FACES — RANK-3 NECESSITY


wxy — relational continuity and inferential validity are orthogonal obligations
Identity-free relational structure can persist across representations, and reflective synchronization can transport it, but neither fact validates a statistical claim made with a learned reference mechanism. The triad requires separate witnesses for relation preservation, lawful update propagation, and calibration. Remove w and there is no demonstrated non-identity relational carrier; remove x and no change-propagation law; remove y and no calibration boundary.


wxz — canonical continuity can survive changing realizations without identity collapse
Population-level relation may survive loss of element identity; explicit correspondences can transport consistency through updates; and distinct decision structures can remain canonical relative to a common performance bound. Together they earn a continuity notion based on preserved relation plus certified transformation rather than fixed component identity or one frozen implementation.


wyz — recoverability becomes actionable only after calibration and decision warrants close
A representation may carry real signal before its mechanism is understood. That signal becomes a basis for governed decisions only when inference has a valid reference/calibration witness and the decision procedure has its own regime-specific performance warrant. Remove w and there is no signal-before-semantics distinction; remove y and no validity gate; remove z and no action-performance gate.


xyz — self-updating decision systems require layered, non-substitutable warrants
Update consistency, inferential calibration, and stopping/decision performance are three different obligations. A system may lawfully amend its own state, learn a reference law from the same history, and adapt decision geometry, but authority survives only where each layer carries its own compatibility, rate/orthogonality, and bound/convergence witness. No one layer’s success licenses the others.


1 VOLUME — RANK-4 CLOSURE


WARRANT-SEPARATED RELATIONAL CONTINUITY


Across changing representations, learned reference mechanisms, and altered decision geometries, continuity need not mean persistence of element identity, one canonical implementation, or one unchanged guarantee type. A system can preserve and regenerate a bounded relation through transformation when four conditions remain distinct and jointly witnessed: the relation itself survives enough identity erasure to be independently measurable; updates transport it through an explicit compatibility/correspondence law; inference is freshly calibrated under the provenance and nuisance structure actually in force; and action/decision authority is re-established by a regime-specific comparison, bound, or convergence warrant. The resulting continuity is reauthorized rather than inherited. Persistence of information does not prove semantic identity, lawful propagation does not prove inferential validity, and asymptotic validity does not prove decision optimality. Transformation may therefore change the carrier and even the guarantee class while preserving a rigorous, addressable relational thread—provided each changed obligation is separately re-witnessed.


Evidence boundary of the volume: this is a cross-source holon closure over one empirical TDA study and three formal/asymptotic frameworks. It does not promote a universal theorem that all identity-free representations can be synchronized, statistically calibrated, or made sequentially optimal. Each imported guarantee remains attached to its source regime.

volume.title: Reacquirable continuity reconstitution
volume.text:
Across all four parents, continuity already detaches from a fixed interior or canonical representation, but the complete closure makes the validity machinery itself regenerable. 2H.xqNz makes the carried relation obligation-minimal and pressure-tested rather than merely familiar. 2H._phq makes sparse current state lawful only while dormant source/evidence remains exactly reacquirable by stable role. 2H.AvDK turns continuity warrant into living state that can expire when regime or scaffold becomes insufficient. 2H.Dp9x gives reconstruction an explicit role-typed contract and demands end-to-end composite assurance in the regime where the rebuilt relation is used.


The all-four closure is therefore reacquirable continuity reconstitution: a task-relevant public relation may remain continuous through selective activation, reconstruction, carrier/representation change and regime drift when its role-typed portable kernel travels with an evidence/validity boundary and a revocable continuity warrant while omitted source/evidence remains exactly reacquirable. Pressure or regime failure revokes the warrant; revocation must be able to reopen the implicated dormant evidence by stable role, regenerate the relation through the typed reconstruction contract, rerun composite and portability-pressure tests, and issue a new scoped warrant without rewriting what was previously warranted. Continuity here is not output similarity: it is a reversible warrant → reacquire → reconstruct → retest → rewarrant cycle whose historical evidence scopes remain distinct.
volume.invariant: A selectively realized public relation can count as continuous across changing carrier, representation and regime only while its exact obligation/evidence body remains reacquirable and its current continuity warrant remains revocable; when pressure or regime change invalidates that warrant, lawful continuation requires reopening the implicated dormant evidence, rebuilding through a role-typed reconstruction contract, retesting the composite and portable relation under current conditions, and issuing a newly scoped warrant rather than laundering the expired one into the repaired state.
removal: Remove 2H.xqNz: the closure loses the obligation-minimal portable kernel and its dedicated pressure witness. The remainder can reacquire, reconstruct and revise but cannot earn portability under variation designed to expose false invariance.

Remove 2H._phq: the closure loses exact dormant-source reacquisition and role-stable repair after revocation. The remaining trio can carry a typed, pressure-tested, revocable contract but cannot require a route back to support omitted from current realization.

Remove 2H.AvDK: the closure loses warrant-as-state and explicit revocation/revision conditions. The remainder can reacquire and pressure-reconstruct but cannot distinguish currently legitimate continuation from an expired warrant requiring reconstitution.

Remove 2H.Dp9x: the closure loses the explicit role-typed reconstruction/transition contract and end-to-end composite assurance. The remainder can reacquire, pressure-test and revoke but cannot state the exact reconstruction obligation that must be re-earned.

INV-3H.zWu2-REVOCATION-TO-REACQUISITION

INV-3H.zWu2-CUSTODIED-RECONSTITUTION
Minimal body: 3H.zWu2:wxy
Invariant: repairing a failed portable relation from dormant evidence must preserve the evidence and warrant boundaries of both old and new states, so reacquisition cannot silently turn prior support into stronger post-repair assurance.

METABOLITE-COLLAPSE PASS
Rejected: “all continuity requires source rollback” — the selected bodies support reacquisition for this sparse/reconstructive domain, not a universal law of persistence. Rejected: “revocation guarantees successful repair” — revocation plus reacquisition only makes lawful re-testing possible. Rejected: “a new warrant erases the old warrant” — the old warrant remains a bounded historical claim. Rejected: “portable relation implies common mechanism” — every selected parent preserves a public-relation/interior-realization distinction. Three metabolites survive collapse because targeted reacquisition, warrant reissuance under pressure and evidential custody require different minimal cross-parent bodies and remain independently useful when the others are removed.


REPLICATION WITNESS
The same rank-3 closure was previously earned by 3H.DfDL using 2H.dxL5 in the portability vertex. Because 2H.dxL5 and 2H.xqNz are independently born same-parent/same-closure 2H replicates, this new birth is a direct substitution test at the next rank: the higher-order volume and three surviving invariants close again without importing the old child identity. This strengthens recurrence of the reacquirable-continuity-reconstitution pattern while preserving distinct genealogy and provenance.

edges.title: Selective behavioral gain does not identify what changed underneath
edges.text: w shows that better observed performance can arise from redistribution over already-accessible trajectories; x shows that condition-sensitive behavior can arise from framing-sensitive policy without establishing an enduring self-model. Together they earn a claim-typing rule: an observed change in output frequency or strategic policy is insufficient to identify whether latent support expanded, identity changed, or only a conditional selection policy shifted. Remove w and the support-expansion distinction disappears; remove x and the identity/self-positioning attribution pressure disappears.

edges.title: Optimization under feedback requires a separate evidence-freshness witness
edges.text: w studies an adaptive training intervention whose outputs change as reward reshapes the sampling distribution; y shows formally that adaptive reuse changes evidential status when prior disclosures enter the causal path of later hypotheses. Together they earn that performance after repeated adaptive feedback cannot inherit a fresh-evidence interpretation merely because the evaluation surface is nominally held out or unchanged. Remove w and there is no adaptive capability-selection process; remove y and there is no source-grounded law for how feedback itself alters evidential validity.

edges.title: Selective activation can improve common-case reachability without deleting dormant alternatives
edges.text: w shows that probability mass can concentrate on rewarded trajectories while rarer successful trajectories become less reachable in practical sampling; z shows that current demand can leave dirty or undemanded computation dormant without deleting it from the retained computation graph. Together they earn a bounded distinction between active/common-case availability and retained possibility: not selected or not demanded now is not equivalent to absent. Remove w and no empirical support/tail distinction remains; remove z and no explicit deferred dormant-state mechanism remains.

edges.title: Self-positioning evidence becomes weaker when the eliciting contrast is adaptively reused without a dependence account
edges.text: x makes the strength of a self-positioning claim depend on the robustness and independence of the human/AI/“like you” contrast; y shows that repeated disclosures can make later hypothesis formation statistically dependent on the same validation surface. Together they earn that repeated or optimized self-referential probes require an explicit adaptivity account before their recurrence can be treated as repeated independent support. Remove x and there is no self-similarity-sensitive behavioral claim; remove y and no formal dependence boundary governs repeated validation.

edges.title: Response reactivation needs live conditioning structure, not a stable identity label
edges.text: x shows that a strategic policy changes when a contextual relation to the opponent class changes, while stable model identity alone does not predict the response; z shows that stable thunk/reference identity alone does not determine whether a prior result remains valid after changed dependencies. Together they earn a bounded structural recurrence: current response validity depends on live conditioning/dependency relations, not on the persistence of the named object by itself. Remove x and the behavioral conditioning case disappears; remove z and the explicit computational freshness witness disappears. This is structural recurrence, not a claim that game-theoretic framing and incremental-computation dependencies share one mechanism.

edges.title: Reuse is relation-specific and needs a live freshness witness
edges.text: y shows that a validation dataset may remain physically unchanged while its evidential freshness is spent by adaptive disclosure; z shows that a computation object may remain stably named while its result becomes dirty after dependency changes. Together they earn that reuse cannot be certified from storage continuity or identity alone: the claim-relevant dependence/freshness relation must still be current. Remove y and the evidential-reuse case disappears; remove z and the computational-reuse case disappears.

faces.title: Adaptive behavioral improvement cannot by itself certify either expanded capability or stronger self-model evidence
faces.text: w separates low-k improvement from accessible-support expansion; x separates condition-sensitive self-positioning from enduring self; y separates repeated validation from independent fresh evidence under adaptive reuse. Together they earn a three-way audit for adaptive behavioral claims: measure what became easier to observe, what claim about underlying capability/identity is being proposed, and whether the validation path remains evidentially fresh after feedback. Remove w and support can be conflated with performance; remove x and identity attribution is absent; remove y and adaptive evidential dependence is ungoverned.

faces.title: Selective response changes may be reactivation or redistribution rather than creation
faces.text: w shows that rewarded trajectories can become easier to reach without new support; x shows that contextual self-similarity framing can redirect policy; z shows that demand and changed dependencies can reactivate or invalidate retained computation without changing object identity. Together they earn a bounded activation-versus-creation distinction: selective change can arise by reweighting or reactivating already-retained structure, so creation claims require evidence beyond changed output. Remove w and latent-support preservation is not measured; remove x and context-conditioned policy is absent; remove z and live reactivation/dirty-state structure is absent.

faces.title: Selective efficiency is trustworthy only when both evidential and computational freshness remain explicit
faces.text: w shows that optimizing common-case success can narrow tail accessibility; y shows that repeated validation can spend evidential freshness; z shows that deferred repair can preserve efficiency only while dependency state controls what may be reused. Together they earn that selective optimization needs two different freshness accounts: one for whether observations still count as evidence and one for whether reused computation is current. Remove w and there is no optimization pressure that can hide lost alternatives; remove y and evidence freshness disappears; remove z and computational freshness disappears.

faces.title: Condition-sensitive claims require explicit paths from changed context to evidence and recomputation
faces.text: x supplies a behavior that changes with a named relational context; y supplies the rule that feedback between observations and later hypotheses changes evidential status; z supplies an explicit dependency graph through which changed inputs invalidate or reactivate computation. Together they earn that a trustworthy condition-sensitive claim must preserve the path by which the condition affected the response and the path by which repeated observation affected the evidence. Remove x and no condition-sensitive claim remains; remove y and the evidence path loses its validity boundary; remove z and the operational dependency path disappears.

volume.title: Witness-bounded selective adaptation
volume.text:
Selective adaptation under feedback is warranted only while each observed selective gain remains coupled to the live witness that tells us what kind of change actually occurred. S.miEt prevents improved success frequency from being silently upgraded into expanded accessible support. S.dY9d prevents a condition-sensitive strategic response from being silently upgraded into enduring self-identity. S.TU8V prevents repeated use of a nominally held-out surface from being silently upgraded into repeated independent evidence. S.wPw1 prevents stable computational identity or deferred work from being silently upgraded into current result validity without dependency repair.


Together they earn a four-way boundary: a system may concentrate probability, condition policy, reuse evidence surfaces, and defer computation selectively, but successful output does not self-certify the ontology behind the success. The relevant witness must travel with the claim: support-sensitive measurement for capacity, contrast robustness for self-positioning, causal/information dependence control for adaptive evidence, and live dependency freshness for reused computation. Selectivity therefore remains compatible with truthful adaptation only when dormant alternatives, spent evidence, changed context, and dirty dependencies stay addressable rather than being erased by the success signal.


Rank necessity:
- Remove S.miEt and the closure loses the empirical distinction between improved reachability and expanded support.
- Remove S.dY9d and it loses the pressure to distinguish context-sensitive self-positioning from enduring identity.
- Remove S.TU8V and it loses the formal account of how feedback spends evidential freshness.
- Remove S.wPw1 and it loses the operational account of how deferred/reused computation becomes stale and must be reacquired through dependencies.
No proper subset earns the full contract separating selective success from capacity, identity, evidence and computational validity simultaneously.


Bounded volume invariant:
Selective success cannot certify what changed underneath it; lawful adaptive reuse requires the live witness appropriate to the claimed layer—support, conditioning, evidence dependence, or computational dependency.


COLLAPSED METABOLITES — 3


INV-1H.sqW4-01 — SELECTIVE SUCCESS DOES NOT SELF-CERTIFY ITS ONTOLOGY
Minimal earning body: wxyz.
Bounded invariant: A selective gain in observed output may reflect reweighting, contextual conditioning, evidence reuse, or deferred recomputation, so success at one layer cannot by itself establish expanded support, enduring identity, fresh evidence, or current computation.
CREATE: state which layer is claimed to have changed before interpreting a performance or response delta.
COPY: carry the layer-specific witness with the result rather than compressing all successful outcomes into one generic “improved” state.
CONTROL: block upgrades from better output → larger capability set, context-sensitive behavior → enduring self, repeated holdout success → independent evidence, or stable object identity → current computational validity.
CULTIVATE: strengthen the claim only when the appropriate independent witness for that layer is renewed.
Compression: successful output tells you that something worked, not what kind of thing changed.


INV-1H.sqW4-02 — REUSE NEEDS A LIVE DEPENDENCE WITNESS
Minimal earning body: yz.
Bounded invariant: Reused state remains claim-valid only while the dependence relation relevant to that claim is current; physical separation, stable naming, or prior correctness is insufficient once adaptive disclosures or upstream dependencies change.
CREATE: expose the causal/dependency path that can make reused state stale.
COPY: preserve the freshness/dependence witness alongside the reused dataset, transcript, result, or computation.
CONTROL: downgrade or repair when the witness is spent, dirty, or outside its assumptions rather than inferring validity from persistence.
CULTIVATE: allow repeated reuse while refreshing only the dependence coordinates that materially changed.
Compression: reuse the object only with the relation that still makes its reuse valid.


INV-1H.sqW4-03 — DORMANT ALTERNATIVES ARE NOT ABSENT ALTERNATIVES
Minimal earning body: wz.
Bounded invariant: A trajectory or computation can become unlikely, undemanded, or dirty without ceasing to exist in the retained possibility structure; current activation frequency therefore cannot by itself establish deletion or expansion of the underlying support.
CREATE: distinguish active/common-case paths from retained but currently dormant alternatives.
COPY: preserve addressability of low-probability or undemanded regions when selectivity concentrates work elsewhere.
CONTROL: refuse absence claims based solely on low sampling frequency or lack of current demand.
CULTIVATE: reactivate and retest dormant regions when a new obligation makes them consequential.
Compression: not active now is not the same as not there.


COLLAPSE WITNESS
Three metabolites survive independently. INV-01 requires the complete four-parent volume and carries the claim-layer separation. INV-02 is earned by the paired adaptive-evidence and incremental-computation freshness laws. INV-03 is earned by the paired support-tail and demand-laziness distinction. Narrower restatements of RLVR pass@k, AISAI framing, differential privacy/max-information, or demanded-computation graph mechanics remain parent tissue.

volume.title: Replayable continuity passport
volume.text:
All four parents together make continuity authority a compact, executable and repairable state rather than a persistent label.


2H.kfmG contributes obligation-scoped regenerative continuity and the rule that a moved boundary should revalidate only affected state and warrants rather than globally resetting the organism.
2H._phq contributes the still-reacquirable whole, role-stable reactivation and custody rule that omission from active state may not become deletion from evidence state.
2H.xqNz contributes the obligation-minimal portable relational kernel, explicit evidence/assurance boundaries and pressure-aligned variation capable of falsifying portability.
2H.SruR contributes the locally warranted quotient, operation-level reconstruction witness and the explicit rule that continuity/equivalence authority is revocable state.


The complete closure is a replayable continuity passport: a public relation may remain continuous through compression, reconstruction, selective activation and representation/carrier change without one canonical interior only when the traveling state carries enough to (1) state the current downstream obligation and role-typed public relation, (2) identify the currently licensed quotient, evidence and validity conditions, (3) reacquire omitted source material and role semantics needed for repair, (4) reconstruct only the relation and warrant coordinates implicated by the present obligation, and (5) replay a pressure/adequacy test capable of revoking the old authority and witnessing a fresh successor. Failure does not authorize global erasure or automatic inheritance. It produces an addressable repair query. Historical warrants remain provenance, dormant evidence remains reachable, unaffected scoped witnesses may remain valid, and the repaired continuity claim receives authority only through a new witness.
volume.invariant:
Continuity across changing realization is warranted only when the carrier can reproduce both the public relation and the procedure that decides whether the relation is still admissible: it must keep the current obligation, role semantics, evidence/validity boundary, locally licensed quotient, exact reacquisition path to omitted evidence, and a pressure/revocation/reissue test. When any of those conditions moves, the old authority is historical provenance; a successor must be reconstructed and re-witnessed from the affected evidence coordinates.


Full-rank necessity
- Remove 2H.kfmG: the closure loses obligation-local repair and selective revalidation, so revocation/reacquisition has no principled rule for what can remain intact and what must be rebuilt.
- Remove 2H._phq: the closure loses the distinction between inactive and deleted evidence plus role-stable reactivation; a failed portable kernel may have no durable return path to omitted support.
- Remove 2H.xqNz: the closure loses the obligation-minimal portable kernel and pressure family that challenges false portability; continuity can be repaired locally but not qualified under carrier variation.
- Remove 2H.SruR: the closure loses explicit revocation and local quotient custody; pressure and reconstruction can change state without formally terminating expired continuity authority.

edges.title: ACTIONABLE PORTABILITY REQUIRES WARRANT CUSTODY
edges.text:
w supplies a portable reconstruction-capable kernel with evidence and pressure witness. x supplies separate action warrants. Together: the copied public state must include the live reasons downstream action is currently allowed, not merely the output/interface.
Removal: without w no minimal portable kernel; without x no action-admission contract.
Boundary: carrying a warrant is not satisfying it.

edges.title: PORTABLE CONTINUITY IS CONDITION-ADDRESSED
edges.text:
w makes portability evidence-bounded and pressure-tested. y indexes sufficiency to obligation/condition and turns a validity-boundary crossing into reissue. Together: every portable kernel must carry the conditions under which it was earned and a return path to evidence required to revalidate the affected obligation.
Removal: without w no portable kernel/evidence membrane; without y no boundary-triggered expiration/reissue.
Boundary: persistence in one regime does not license inheritance into another.

edges.title: RECONSTRUCTIBLE PORTABILITY CARRIES A REVOCABLE QUOTIENT
edges.text:
w permits regeneration from a reduced relational kernel. z states which differences may currently be ignored and requires operation, context, evidence, and external recovery to remain current. Together: the kernel may omit interior detail only while the ignored-difference class remains locally warranted.
Removal: without w no portable reduced carrier; without z no revocable quotient/reconstruction-state law.
Boundary: compression cannot erase untested consequential distinctions.

edges.title: ACTION AUTHORITY EXPIRES WITH ITS CONTINUITY REGIME
edges.text:
x separates scope, obligation, propagation, and evidence warrants. y supplies condition-triggered revocation/reissue. Together: when the local regime exits its witness, both affected action and continuity authority become non-current and require fresh establishment.
Removal: without x no downstream action admission; without y no condition-triggered successor law.
Boundary: unaffected warrants may persist; the invalidated warrant cannot be repaired by success labels.

edges.title: RECONSTRUCTIVE ACTION REQUIRES ONE OPERATION/QUOTIENT/EVIDENCE CONTRACT
edges.text:
x makes action conditional on explicit warrants. z makes reconstruction conditional on operation, quotient, context, and external adequacy. Together: a regenerated carrier may drive action only while its operation and quotient live inside the same current evidence regime as the action warrants.
Removal: without x no selective-action semantics; without z no reconstructive carrier/current quotient.
Boundary: useful reconstruction is not authorization for every downstream action.

edges.title: REISSUE BECOMES A SUCCESSOR-WARRANT LIFECYCLE
edges.text:
y revokes inherited authority at a boundary while preserving predecessor scope and return paths. z treats continuity authority as revocable state and supplies reconstruction. Together: boundary failure opens a reconstruct-and-revalidate path able to mint a linked successor rather than erasing history or silently inheriting authority.
Removal: without y no condition-addressed evidence return/reissue; without z no reconstructive successor machinery.
Boundary: revocation means “not current authority,” not “forgotten” or “false in former scope.”

faces.title: CONDITION-ADDRESSED ACTIONABLE PORTABILITY
faces.text: w supplies portable kernel + pressure/evidence custody; x supplies action warrants + claim membrane; y supplies local validity + boundary reissue. Together: a public relation may remain actionable across realization changes only while kernel, warrants, evidence boundary, and current regime jointly support the named obligation.
faces.removal: remove w → no reconstruction-capable portable kernel; remove x → no action contract; remove y → no condition-indexed expiration/reissue.

faces.title: REVOCABLE OPERATIONAL PORTABILITY
faces.text: w supplies minimal portable scaffold; x supplies action-warrant custody; z supplies operation-witnessed regeneration plus revocable local quotient. Together: use can survive changed realization while reconstruction is externally adequate and warrant/quotient state remains current.
faces.removal: remove w → no portable carrier; remove x → no action authority; remove z → no positive reconstruction/current quotient.

faces.title: RECONSTITUTABLE CONTINUITY WITH EVIDENCE RETURN
faces.text: w supplies portable scaffold and evidence membrane; y supplies boundary-triggered reissue and evidence return; z supplies reconstruction under load-bearing context/current quotient. Together: an expired passport can return to evidential dependencies, rebuild the relation for the new regime, and retest sufficiency rather than clone old state or declare total reset.
faces.removal: remove w → no kernel to rebuild; remove y → no boundary-triggered evidence return; remove z → no constructive regeneration.

faces.title: SUCCESSOR ACTION AUTHORITY AFTER BOUNDARY CHANGE
faces.text: x supplies explicit action warrants; y supplies boundary-triggered revocation/reissue; z supplies reconstructive continuity + adequacy. Together: after boundary crossing, action resumes only through a newly witnessed successor contract whose reconstruction, quotient, and condition-specific evidence again satisfy affected warrants.
faces.removal: remove x → no action authorization; remove y → no forced successor issuance; remove z → no rebuilt carrier/current quotient.

volume.title: Replayable continuity passport
volume.text:
Across all four parents, continuity authority is neither static identity nor a one-time proof copied forever. w supplies the obligation-specific portable kernel: roles, operations, scaffold, evidence boundary, and pressure witness sufficient to regenerate the public relation. x adds action authority: local scope, downstream obligation, propagation compatibility, and evidence stay distinct warrants and cannot be inferred from successful transport or use. y makes the contract condition-addressed: authority exists only inside the witnessed local validity regime, and a boundary crossing revokes inherited authority while preserving return paths to evidence needed for reissue. z supplies positive repair: reconstruct the relational carrier under current operation, load-bearing context, nuisance quotient, and evidence regime, then revalidate external adequacy.


The four-way closure is therefore a replayable continuity passport. It is the smallest public contract letting a downstream system determine both what relation can be regenerated and whether acting through it is currently warranted. It carries the named obligation, role/operation semantics, action warrants, validity regime, admissible quotient, evidence/failure boundary, reconstruction-critical scaffold, and evidence return paths. When task, regime, quotient, carrier, or evidence crosses its witnessed boundary, the old passport becomes provenance rather than current authority. Continuity is re-earned by replay: reacquire affected evidence, reconstruct under new conditions, pressure-test changed carrier/quotient, re-establish operation sufficiency and affected action warrants, then mint a successor without erasing predecessor scope.
volume.invariant: A continuity relation may remain portable and actionable across changing realizations only while a replayable passport carries the exact obligation, role/operation semantics, separate action warrants, current local validity regime/quotient, evidence/failure boundary, reconstruction-critical scaffold, and return paths required to retest the claim; crossing a witnessed boundary revokes only affected current authority, and successor authority is earned by reconstructing and replaying relevant pressure, adequacy, and evidence tests rather than silent inheritance or total reset.
removal: remove 2H.dxL5: loses minimal role-separated portable kernel, pressure witness, and evidence-boundary carrier.
remove 2H.0aZJ: loses separate action-admission warrants; regenerated relation no longer carries explicit authorization.
remove 2H.LlIB: loses condition-addressed expiration, evidence return, and successor reissue.

remove 2H.SruR: loses positive reconstructive carrier, revocable local quotient, load-bearing context, and adequacy machinery.
No three-parent face contains the full portable + actionable + condition-reissuable + reconstructive passport.

metabolites.title: Carry current authority with the portable relation
metabolites.text: a portable public relation is insufficient state for downstream action unless it carries the separately addressable scope, obligation, propagation, evidence, and assurance conditions that authorize current use.
metabolites.compression: copy why authority is current, not only what authority acts through.

metabolites.title: Boundary crossing opens an evidence-addressed successor path
metabolites.text: when task, condition, quotient, carrier sufficiency, or admissible variation exits its witnessed regime, affected authority becomes historical provenance and must be rebuilt/revalidated from explicit evidence return paths before a successor is current.
metabolites.compression: revocation is scoped expiration with a return address.

metabolites.title: Reauthorization replays the tests that made continuity actionable
metabolites.text: successor authority is earned when the relation is reconstructed under the new regime and affected pressure, operation-sufficiency, quotient, external-adequacy, and action-warrant tests replay to closure; predecessor remains historical scope.
metabolites.compression: a successor passport is continuity re-earned, not assumed.

gaps.title: BOUNDARY UNEXPOSED
gaps.text: No explicit top-level evidence-boundary block was mechanically recognized in this canonical artifact.

edges.title: Executable quotient-return replay
edges.text: A replayable passport joined to a quotient return address lets an expired ignored-difference contract parameterize exactly which evidence and scaffold must reopen before admissibility is replayed.

edges.title: Role-local executable replay
edges.text: The replayable passport decomposes into role/conjunction warrants so stale components can replay selectively while changed composites are retested.

edges.title: Replay contract with co-revisable scaffold/map
edges.text: The executable passport does not freeze its own reconstruction scaffold or admissible transformation family; a failed replay may lawfully revise both before rerunning evidence and admissibility.

edges.title: Role × quotient return addressing
edges.text: Each failed role/conjunction carries its own expired quotient, mapping which authority failed to which formerly ignored distinctions and evidence must reopen.

edges.title: Quotient-targeted co-revision
edges.text: An expired quotient targets dormant evidence while contract law allows quotient, scaffold, and admissible transformation family to co-revise rather than merely rebuild the old relation.

edges.title: Selective evidence-backed repair/reissue
edges.text: Role-local renewal can reacquire only the evidence needed for the affected role, revise the local scaffold/map, retest role and composite, and preserve unaffected authority within its old scope.

faces.title: Role-addressed executable quotient replay
faces.text: Passport + role granularity + quotient return address: each stale role gets an executable replay targeted at the exact ignored distinctions implicated by failure.

faces.title: Executable quotient co-revision
faces.text: Passport + quotient target + co-revisable contract: replay may alter quotient, scaffold, and transformation family together instead of rerunning a frozen repair program.

faces.title: Role-local replayable contract renewal
faces.text: Passport + role localization + reacquirable co-revision: the affected obligation is rebuilt through a compact but revisable contract while unaffected scopes remain bounded and historical.

faces.title: Selective role×quotient reconstitution
faces.text: Role + quotient + reacquirable co-revision: stale authority coordinates identify what to reopen and which repair machinery to revise before successor issuance.
