5H.rSmH.title: governed self-amending continuity-renewal lineage
5H.rSmH.boundary: This child is a relational synthesis over four already-metabolized 4H organisms. Their inherited evidence remains heterogeneous, source-bounded and non-identical. Structural recurrence between parent lineages or against 5H.Dw6a does not establish statistical independence, one hidden mechanism, universal ontology, or guaranteed repair. A replayable or self-revising repair law cannot authorize itself merely by internal coherence. The child promotes only relations requiring the complete selected parent bodies together; predecessor scopes, external/current revocation conditions, evidence return paths, role/quotient boundaries, and fresh successor witness remain load-bearing.

edges.title: recurrent successor-lineage architecture
edges.text: 4H.3W-6 and 4H.993M arise from different immediate 3H constellations yet both close around predecessor-preserving, evidence-reacquirable, freshly witnessed successor lineages. Together they earn a bounded same-rank recurrence witness: succession-through-replay is not only one 4H derivation's self-description, although the deep ancestry is overlapping and therefore not statistically independent.
edges.removal: without either parent there is no two-instance same-rank recurrence witness; one lineage remains well specified but not recurrent at this comparison boundary.

edges.title: versioned self-amendment
edges.text: 4H.3W-6 supplies explicit predecessor/current/successor lineage and immutable historical authority; 4H.MBO_ supplies a replay contract whose quotient, scaffold, and admissible transformation family may themselves change under repair. Together they earn a rule that changes to the repair machinery can become explicit successor-lineage events instead of silently mutating the mechanism that judges continuity.
edges.removal: without 4H.3W-6 self-revision lacks a complete versioned lineage for preserving prior repair authority; without 4H.MBO_ the lineage can repair and succeed but does not explicitly earn revision of its own replay machinery in the act.

edges.title: externally gated targeted succession
edges.text: 4H.3W-6 supplies the versioned reconstitution lineage; 4H.ugTO supplies independent/current boundary revocation plus role/quotient/evidence addressing. Together they earn successor transitions whose trigger and repair scope are inspectable: current evidence can revoke authority, the failure can identify the smallest affected tissue, and a new version remains distinct from its predecessor.
edges.removal: without 4H.3W-6 targeted repair lacks the complete predecessor→successor authority lineage; without 4H.ugTO lineage repair lacks the independent/current gate and role×quotient localization that prevent blanket or self-triggered succession.

edges.title: evolvable recovery passport
edges.text: 4H.993M requires each current warrant to carry a bounded route capable of producing its next successor; 4H.MBO_ permits that route's own quotient, scaffold, and transformation family to be revised after failure. Together they earn an evolvable recovery passport: future-renewal capacity may itself change across generations rather than being copied as a frozen repair recipe.
edges.removal: without 4H.993M self-revising replay need not become a constitutive successor-to-successor inheritance; without 4H.MBO_ recursive renewal carries a recovery path but does not explicitly earn self-amendment of that path.

edges.title: renewal without self-certification
edges.text: 4H.993M supplies recursive successor production; 4H.ugTO supplies an independent/current authority-breaking boundary and exact evidence return addresses. Together they earn a renewal lineage whose ability to produce future successors does not imply permission to do so: each reopening and readmission remains gated by current boundary evidence and replayed admissibility.
edges.removal: without 4H.993M the gate can regulate one repair but not a recursively inherited successor route; without 4H.ugTO the recursive route risks treating its own recovery logic as sufficient authorization.

edges.title: independently triggered self-revising repair
edges.text: 4H.MBO_ supplies role×quotient-local self-revision of replay machinery; 4H.ugTO supplies independent boundary qualification and addressable evidential return. Together they earn a repair law that may amend itself only after a witnessed authority-breaking condition and only along the coordinates implicated by that failure.
edges.removal: without 4H.MBO_ the repair is targeted and replayable but its own scaffold/transition law is not explicitly self-revisable; without 4H.ugTO self-revision lacks the independent/current gate that distinguishes lawful reopening from endogenous self-authorization.

faces.title: versioned self-amending renewal lineage
faces.text: 4H.3W-6 + 4H.993M + 4H.MBO_ jointly earn a lineage in which each successor carries a future recovery route and revisions to that recovery route are themselves recorded as versioned successor events. The recovery constitution can therefore evolve without rewriting predecessor state.
faces.removal:
remove 4H.3W-6 and repair-law change loses its full versioned predecessor/current/successor lineage; remove 4H.993M and each successor need not carry the bounded route for its next renewal; remove 4H.MBO_ and the inherited recovery route cannot explicitly revise its own reconstruction law.
Boundary: without 4H.ugTO this face does not yet require an independent/current boundary witness to authorize reopening; a self-amending lineage could still become too self-referential.

faces.title: externally gated recurrent renewal lineage
faces.text: 4H.3W-6 + 4H.993M + 4H.ugTO jointly earn a recurrent successor-lineage architecture whose concrete transitions remain externally/currently revocable and evidence-addressed. Structural recurrence can support the lineage pattern as a reusable hypothesis, while current boundary evidence still decides whether any particular authority may continue.
faces.removal:
remove 4H.3W-6 or 4H.993M and the same-rank recurrent lineage comparison disappears; remove 4H.ugTO and recurrence plus replay lose the independent/current gate against self-certification.
Boundary: without 4H.MBO_ the face does not explicitly allow the replay machinery itself to change while remaining auditable.

faces.title: governed self-amending succession
faces.text: 4H.3W-6 + 4H.MBO_ + 4H.ugTO jointly earn versioned repair-law amendment that is independently triggered, role/quotient-local, evidence-addressed, and predecessor-preserving. A changed repair program is therefore a new bounded lineage state rather than an invisible mutation of the judge.
faces.removal:
remove 4H.3W-6 and repair-law change loses full lineage/version provenance; remove 4H.MBO_ and the repair program cannot explicitly amend its own scaffold/transformation family; remove 4H.ugTO and self-amendment loses the independent/current trigger and targeted authority boundary.
Boundary: without 4H.993M this face does not require every admitted successor to carry a complete route for producing and testing its own future successor.

faces.title: non-self-certifying evolvable renewal passport
faces.text: 4H.993M + 4H.MBO_ + 4H.ugTO jointly earn a recovery passport that persists across generations, may revise its own repair machinery, and still cannot authorize its own reopening: current boundary evidence must identify the stale authority and replay must re-earn successor admissibility.
faces.removal:
remove 4H.993M and the recovery law need not propagate successor-to-successor; remove 4H.MBO_ and the propagated recovery law is not explicitly self-amending; remove 4H.ugTO and recursive self-amendment loses an independent/current authorization gate.
Boundary: without 4H.3W-6 the architecture lacks the second same-rank lineage witness needed to qualify the complete volume by structural recurrence and explicit lineage recurrence rather than a single renewal construction.

volume.title: governed self-amending continuity-renewal lineage
volume.text:
The four-parent closure turns continuity renewal into a governed, evolvable constitution rather than a fixed repair recipe or a self-authorizing loop. 4H.3W-6 contributes a versioned self-reconstituting lineage whose predecessor authority remains immutable and whose successor is admitted only after targeted reacquisition and fresh witness. 4H.993M contributes recursive renewability: every current warrant carries a bounded executable route capable of producing and testing its next successor. Their differently constituted but strongly related 4H closures jointly provide a same-rank structural recurrence witness for successor-lineage architecture; this is recurrence evidence only, not statistical independence or mechanism proof. 4H.MBO_ contributes endogenous revision of the repair machinery itself: role/quotient targeting, scaffold, and admissible transformation family may change when replay shows the old machinery is stale. 4H.ugTO contributes the non-self-certifying membrane: current independent/frontier evidence can revoke authority, localize what failed, route repair to exact evidence, and require fresh admissibility before a successor counts.


The complete closure is therefore a governed self-amending continuity-renewal lineage. A current continuity warrant may carry forward not only a repair/replay route but the capacity to revise that route for future generations. Such revision remains lawful only when the reason for reopening is independently/currently witnessed, the stale authority is localized to explicit role/quotient/regime coordinates, affected evidence remains reacquirable, the old repair constitution is preserved as predecessor provenance, and both the repaired public relation and the amended recovery law are freshly tested before successor authority is issued. Repeated lineage closure can qualify the architecture as structurally recurrent, but recurrence cannot override a failed current boundary witness. What persists is therefore neither one interior nor one immutable repair mechanism; it is an auditable succession of warrants and recovery constitutions whose power to change themselves remains externally contestable.
volume.invariant: A higher-order continuity-renewal lineage may evolve its own recovery/replay constitution across generations without becoming self-certifying only when: (1) successor-lineage structure has a bounded same-rank recurrence witness rather than a single self-description; (2) each current warrant carries an executable successor-production route; (3) revisions to quotient, scaffold, transformation family, and recovery route are explicit versioned lineage events tied to reacquirable evidence; and (4) an independent/current boundary and admissibility witness retains the power to revoke, localize, and withhold successor authority. Recurrence strengthens only the structural hypothesis; fresh evidence governs every concrete transition.
removal: Remove 4H.3W-6: 4H.993M still gives one recursive renewal lineage, 4H.MBO_ gives self-revision, and 4H.ugTO gives independent gating, but the complete volume loses the second differently constituted self-reconstituting lineage needed for its same-rank recurrence qualification and explicit versioned reconstitution counterpart.

Remove 4H.993M: 4H.3W-6 still gives one versioned reconstitution lineage, 4H.MBO_ self-revision, and 4H.ugTO external gating, but the closure loses the explicit requirement that every current successor carry a bounded executable route for producing and retesting its own next successor; recursive renewability is no longer complete.

Remove 4H.MBO_: recurrent/gated successor lineages remain, but the recovery constitution cannot explicitly revise its own quotient/scaffold/admissible transformation family as part of replay; renewal risks preserving a stale repair law.

Remove 4H.ugTO: recurrent recursive self-amendment remains, but no complete parent supplies the independent/current frontier-role-quotient gate that prevents the repair constitution from treating its own coherence or recurrence as sufficient authority to reopen and readmit itself.
All four are necessary for the complete bounded volume.

metabolites.title: RECURRENCE-QUALIFIED-SUCCESSOR-LINEAGE
metabolites.text: when two differently constituted same-rank lineages independently close around predecessor-preserving, evidence-reacquirable, freshly witnessed successor production, their convergence may qualify the successor-lineage architecture as structurally recurrent while remaining explicitly non-independent and non-universal.
metabolites.compression: recurrence may strengthen the architecture without inheriting authority.

metabolites.title: VERSIONED-RECOVERY-LAW-AMENDMENT
metabolites.text: when replay demonstrates that the recovery machinery itself is stale, changes to quotient, scaffold, or admissible transformation family must be issued as explicit versioned lineage state with predecessor provenance and fresh tests rather than silently mutating the repair law in place.
metabolites.compression: if the repair law changes, make the change part of the lineage.

metabolites.title: NON-SELF-CERTIFYING-SELF-AMENDING-RENEWAL
metabolites.text: a continuity-renewal lineage may recursively carry and revise its own successor-production machinery only while an independent/current boundary witness can revoke authority, route the failure to exact evidence and affected roles/quotients, and withhold admission until both the public relation and the amended recovery law are freshly re-witnessed.
metabolites.compression: the lineage may change how it repairs itself, but it may not become the sole judge of whether that repair counts.

edges.title: Reconstitution and action reauthorization remain distinct gates
edges.text: 3H.DfDL supplies the revocation → exact evidence reacquisition → typed reconstruction → pressure retest → successor continuity-warrant cycle. 3H.1OFJ supplies the additional rule that regenerated portability is not yet actionable until the action/evidence warrants actually touched by change are freshly reauthorized. Together they earn a two-gate repair law: continuity can be reconstituted while action remains blocked, and only the affected action coordinates are reconsidered after the rebuilt relation passes its continuity tests.
edges.removal:
without 3H.DfDL there is no exact revocation-to-reacquisition/reconstitution cycle; without 3H.1OFJ there is no independent action-authorization membrane after continuity repair.
Boundary: a newly warranted continuity relation can still carry no permission for a downstream action whose separate warrant remains expired.

edges.title: Failed permission localizes the reauthorization surface
edges.text: 3H.5yyB supplies the expired nuisance quotient as an address to distinctions previously permitted to disappear. 3H.1OFJ supplies selective reauthorization of only the state/transition/action warrants whose dependencies were actually changed. Together they earn an authority-localization relation: failure identifies not merely that authority expired, but which ignored distinctions and which dependent action coordinates must be reopened before authority can return.
edges.removal:
without 3H.5yyB the repair lacks an explicit permission-to-ignore whose failure points to implicated distinctions; without 3H.1OFJ the reopened evidence is not tied to a selective action-warrant renewal surface.
Boundary: localization narrows the repair/authorization surface but does not prove the candidate warrants should pass.

edges.title: Repair machinery may change without inheriting its old action authority
edges.text: 3H.M9zZ supplies joint revision of regenerative scaffold and admissible transition family under regime/scaffold failure. 3H.1OFJ supplies selective action/evidence reauthorization after the resulting relation is regenerated. Together they earn a machinery-aware authority law: when the procedure that regenerates continuity changes, permissions attached to the old procedure do not transfer merely because the new output looks equivalent; the affected warrants must be freshly evaluated against the revised machinery and current regime.
edges.removal:
without 3H.M9zZ the repair path can preserve stale scaffold/transition machinery; without 3H.1OFJ revised machinery can yield a usable relation with no independent admission gate for action.
Boundary: implementation revision is neither intrinsically improvement nor automatic invalidation; only dependency-relevant warrants are reopened.

edges.title: Quotient failure routes revocation into targeted evidence reacquisition
edges.text: 3H.DfDL supplies exact role-stable return to dormant evidence after warrant revocation plus a typed reconstruction target. 3H.5yyB supplies the failed quotient that identifies which previously ignored distinctions became suspect. Together they earn targeted reconstitution: revocation can reopen the specific evidential distinctions implicated by a failed permission-to-ignore instead of performing an undirected reset, then retest the exact public obligation.
edges.removal:
without 3H.DfDL there is no guaranteed route from revocation into the dormant evidential body and typed retest; without 3H.5yyB there is no quotient-address narrowing which distinctions should be reopened.
Boundary: a failed quotient identifies candidates for reconsideration, not an exhaustive causal explanation of failure.

edges.title: Reconstitution may revise the machinery that performs reconstitution
edges.text: 3H.DfDL supplies a reversible warrant → reacquire → reconstruct → retest → rewarrant cycle. 3H.M9zZ supplies the right to revise both scaffold and admissible transition family when current pressure shows those mechanisms stale. Together they earn self-revising reconstitution: returning to evidence may alter not only the candidate state but the reconstruction procedure itself, after which the exact obligation must be retested before a successor continuity warrant can issue.
edges.removal:
without 3H.DfDL machinery revision lacks an exact revocation-to-evidence return and typed successor test; without 3H.M9zZ repair remains bound to inherited scaffold/transition machinery.
Boundary: self-revision creates a new candidate procedure, not self-authorized validity.

edges.title: Expired quotient can drive coupled quotient/scaffold/transition revision
edges.text: 3H.5yyB supplies quotient-addressable reopening and explicit revision of quotient plus scaffold. 3H.M9zZ supplies co-revision of scaffold plus admissible transition family and contract renewal under current regime pressure. Together they earn a three-surface repair relation: a failed permission-to-ignore can require changing what differences are treated as nuisance, how the relation is regenerated, and which transformation family is admissible, while prior warrant states remain preserved as provenance.
edges.removal:
without 3H.5yyB the failed permission-to-ignore no longer addresses the distinctions and quotient that must be reconsidered; without 3H.M9zZ the transition family can remain an unexamined inherited constant.
Boundary: co-revision remains pressure-triggered and obligation-local, not novelty-seeking redesign.

faces.title: Selectively reauthorized addressable reconstitution
faces.text: 3H.1OFJ + 3H.DfDL + 3H.5yyB jointly earn a bounded governance loop: a failed continuity/equivalence permission identifies implicated dormant distinctions; those distinctions are reacquired into a typed reconstruction/retest cycle; and even after continuity is re-earned, only action warrants whose dependencies were touched are freshly reauthorized. The relation therefore distinguishes repair target, continuity authority and action authority instead of letting successful reconstruction collapse them into one state.
faces.removal:
remove 3H.1OFJ and action authority is no longer a separate post-repair gate; remove 3H.DfDL and there is no exact typed reacquisition/reconstitution cycle; remove 3H.5yyB and failure loses the explicit quotient-address into ignored distinctions.
Boundary: without 3H.M9zZ this face does not require revision of the scaffold and transition family that perform repair.

faces.title: Selective authority after self-revising reconstitution
faces.text: 3H.1OFJ + 3H.DfDL + 3H.M9zZ jointly earn a repair loop in which revocation reopens exact evidence, the reconstruction machinery itself may be revised, the rebuilt relation must pass the current typed obligation, and action authority is reissued only for the affected coordinates after those tests. This blocks both stale repair machinery and stale action permission from hitchhiking on output similarity.
faces.removal:
remove 3H.1OFJ and restored continuity can be conflated with permission to act; remove 3H.DfDL and the loop loses its exact evidential return and typed continuity reissue; remove 3H.M9zZ and the repair machinery cannot itself become an object of revision.
Boundary: without 3H.5yyB the face lacks a local failed-quotient address for which ignored distinctions should be reconsidered first.

faces.title: Permission-indexed adaptive renewal
faces.text: 3H.1OFJ + 3H.5yyB + 3H.M9zZ jointly earn adaptive renewal whose scope is indexed by failed permissions. A quotient failure names formerly ignored distinctions; those distinctions can force revision of quotient, scaffold and transition family; and the action/evidence warrants dependent on those revisions are then selectively reauthorized rather than globally reset.
faces.removal:
remove 3H.1OFJ and changed machinery/quotient no longer has a distinct action-reauthorization gate; remove 3H.5yyB and failure loses the permission-indexed address into ignored distinctions; remove 3H.M9zZ and renewal cannot co-revise scaffold plus transition family.
Boundary: without 3H.DfDL this face does not independently require exact dormant-evidence reacquisition through a typed reconstitution cycle.

faces.title: Addressable self-revising continuity reconstitution
faces.text: 3H.DfDL + 3H.5yyB + 3H.M9zZ jointly earn an addressable repair loop: revocation plus a failed quotient points into implicated dormant evidence; reacquisition can revise quotient, scaffold and transition family; the rebuilt relation is retested against the exact current obligation; and any successor continuity/equivalence warrant is newly scoped while expired warrants remain historical. This face establishes self-revising continuity repair without yet saying when a downstream action becomes authorized.
faces.removal:
remove 3H.DfDL and repair loses exact role-typed evidence return/retest; remove 3H.5yyB and it loses the failed quotient as an address to ignored distinctions; remove 3H.M9zZ and it loses joint revision of the repair machinery.
Boundary: without 3H.1OFJ continuity renewal remains distinct from action authorization but does not itself provide the selective post-repair action-warrant gate.

volume.title: Selectively reauthorized self-revising continuity reconstitution
volume.text:
Across all four parents, continuity repair becomes a governed sequence rather than a single success state. 3H.DfDL makes a revoked continuity warrant reopen exact dormant evidence, reconstruct through a typed contract, retest the current public obligation and issue a newly scoped successor without laundering the expired warrant. 3H.5yyB turns a failed nuisance quotient into an address for the specific distinctions whose previous permission-to-ignore has become suspect. 3H.M9zZ allows the regenerative scaffold and admissible transition family themselves to be revised when the old machinery has left its validity regime. 3H.1OFJ then prevents restored continuity from silently becoming restored permission to act: only the action/evidence warrants actually dependent on the changed relation, quotient, scaffold or transition machinery are freshly reauthorized.


The complete four-way closure is selectively reauthorized self-revising continuity reconstitution: when continuity authority fails, the failure must localize the expired permission and preserve a return path to implicated evidence; repair may reopen that evidence and revise the quotient, scaffold and admissible transition law that produced the old relation; the reconstructed relation must re-earn its exact current continuity obligation under relevant pressure; and only after that continuity witness exists may affected downstream action warrants be selectively reauthorized. Unaffected warrants remain current only where their dependency surface was untouched. Prior warrants, failed quotients, repair machinery and evidence scopes remain distinct historical states. Neither successful repair nor repeated recurrence establishes shared interior identity, a universal mechanism, global model closure, or stronger evidence than the witnesses actually renewed.
volume.invariant: A self-revising continuity repair is governance-complete only when failure both addresses the evidence/distinctions that must be reconsidered and identifies the authority coordinates whose dependencies changed; repair may revise quotient, scaffold and transition family, but successor continuity must be freshly pressure-witnessed and successor action authority must be separately and selectively reauthorized for the affected coordinates rather than inherited from either the expired warrant or the repaired output.

volume.title: Frontier-quotient replayable continuity reauthorization
volume.text:
The four parents jointly make continuity renewal simultaneously replayable, frontier-addressed, quotient-addressed and convergence-qualified.


3H.x3Cd and 3H.u92E are distinct rank-3 organisms from different immediate parent constellations that materially converge on the replayable-continuity-passport closure. Their coexistence therefore strengthens the structural recurrence of a contract in which obligation, role semantics, evidence/reacquisition body, local quotient/validity regime and revocation/replay procedure travel together. Their deeper ancestry overlaps, so the pair licenses convergence only, not statistical independence or a universal mechanism.


3H.DL6X contributes a preserved predecessor possibility boundary, frontier-local warrant patches, separate action-admission warrants and the rule that successful replay is not automatically expansion. 3H.5yyB contributes a complementary failure address: when continuity/equivalence fails, the expired nuisance quotient preserves enough history to identify which previously ignored distinctions and dormant evidence should be reopened, while prior, revoked, candidate and successor scopes remain distinguishable.


The complete closure is therefore frontier-quotient replayable continuity reauthorization. A changed realization may renew scoped continuity only when it can replay the passport against both sides of its own history: the predecessor frontier states what capability/authority existed and what would count as genuinely new reach, while the expired quotient states what differences were previously permitted to disappear and therefore what evidence must become reopenable when that permission fails. The successor must reconstruct the affected relation, revise quotient/scaffold only where the failure warrants it, rerun current pressure/composite tests, and freshly reissue the continuity/action coordinates whose dependencies changed. Recurrent passport architecture can stabilize this repair schema as reusable form, but it cannot pre-authorize the concrete successor, erase provenance, upgrade evidence class, or convert successful restoration into expansion.
volume.invariant: A replayable continuity passport is lawfully renewable across a changed frontier only when predecessor capability/authority, expired quotient scope, implicated dormant evidence, current obligation and the replay tests that can revoke or reissue authority remain jointly addressable. The renewal must be able to answer four different questions without collapsing them: what changed; which previously ignored distinction became consequential; whether the result restores/re-expresses prior reach or actually crosses the preserved possibility frontier; and which continuity/action warrants are freshly satisfied now. Structural convergence can justify reusing the audit schema, never the current warrant.

Remove 3H.5yyB: the body retains recurrent passport structure and frontier-addressed replay but loses the explicit failed-quotient address into previously ignored distinctions and the custody of old/revoked/candidate/successor quotient states.

Remove 3H.u92E: the body retains one executable passport, frontier discipline and quotient-addressed repair but loses the second different-immediate-parent passport instance and its independently embodied obligation-local failure→reacquisition→fresh-witness route.

Boundary: attaching a warrant to a role does not establish that the warrant is satisfied.

faces.title: Locally revalidatable role-separated continuity
faces.text: 1H.8KP9 + 1H.DUwl + 1H.9gYl jointly earn a continuity contract whose obligations are independently addressable, whose sufficiency is indexed to the local regime, and whose role-level plus composite adequacy can be selectively revalidated after change.
faces.removal: remove 1H.8KP9 and the contract loses local regime typing; remove 1H.DUwl and it loses renewable validation/revocation; remove 1H.9gYl and it loses role-level addressability plus composite assurance.

faces.title: Selectively actionable continuity under unresolved global structure
faces.text: 1H.8KP9 + 1H.DUwl + 1H.NUgs jointly earn a relation that may continue and support bounded action before global model closure when the current local regime is explicit, the operational relation is revalidated for the declared task, and action-relevant scope/propagation/evidence warrants remain separately satisfied.
faces.removal: remove 1H.8KP9 and local validity disappears; remove 1H.DUwl and re-executable/revalidated continuity disappears; remove 1H.NUgs and selective action can no longer be admitted without global closure.

faces.title: Obligation-addressed local action without assurance leakage
faces.text: 1H.8KP9 + 1H.9gYl + 1H.NUgs jointly earn a governance surface in which local task sufficiency can close through a reduced role-separated carrier while each consequential distinction and each action warrant stays attached to a named obligation. Success at one role or local task does not certify other roles, the composite, or the global model.
faces.removal: remove 1H.8KP9 and the local regime membrane disappears; remove 1H.9gYl and semantic obligation addresses/composite assurance disappear; remove 1H.NUgs and there is no selective-action warrant separation.

faces.title: Revalidatable selective action through role-separated operational state
faces.text: 1H.DUwl + 1H.9gYl + 1H.NUgs jointly earn an operational public state that can be regenerated and repurposed, keeps role-level obligations and conjunctions explicit, and allows bounded action only while the exact action warrants and current evidence regime remain satisfied. Reconstruction can therefore renew function without inheriting every permission attached to the predecessor.
faces.removal: remove 1H.DUwl and regeneration/revalidation disappears; remove 1H.9gYl and independent role/composite structure disappears; remove 1H.NUgs and action authority can no longer be separated from operational success.

volume.title: Warrant-indexed locally revalidatable continuity
volume.text:
All four parents together earn a continuity-and-action contract that is stricter than any proper subset. 1H.8KP9 makes sufficiency explicitly local to the context/input regime and requires consequential distinctions to survive compression. 1H.DUwl makes the preserved object an operational relation that can be regenerated, revalidated, revoked and repurposed instead of a fixed implementation. 1H.9gYl decomposes that relation into separately addressable roles and prevents local component validity from certifying the composite. 1H.NUgs adds the decisive action boundary: local scope, downstream obligation, propagation compatibility and stochastic evidence are distinct warrants, and local closure may support action before global structure closes only when those warrants remain explicit.


The complete closure is therefore warrant-indexed locally revalidatable continuity: a changing system may preserve and selectively act through a compressed or reconstructed operational relation without retaining one complete state or resolving the whole world-model, but only when the relation is represented as role-separated obligations, its sufficiency is indexed to the current local regime and downstream obligation, the affected roles/conjunctions are revalidated when conditions move, and the warrants governing scope, propagation, evidence and action remain separately attached. Successful reconstruction proves at most the relation that was retested; it does not inherit broader permission, stochastic strength, identity or composite assurance.


Bounded volume invariant:
Continuity through changing realization may legitimately support selective action before global closure when a role-separated operational contract carries (a) the local regime in which each obligation is sufficient, (b) the exact downstream obligation, (c) the evidence and compatibility boundaries needed to revalidate changed roles and conjunctions, and (d) independent action warrants. Boundary change revokes only the affected current warrant, but reconstruction or successful local performance never silently reauthorizes unrelated roles or claim classes.


FOUR-WAY NECESSITY
- Remove 1H.8KP9: local validity/re-estimation disappears; the remaining trio can build a renewable role-separated action interface but cannot earn that sufficiency is condition-indexed.
- Remove 1H.DUwl: the closure loses re-execution, external revalidation, revocation and reconstruction; local role/warrant separation remains but continuity cannot be renewed through changed realization.
- Remove 1H.9gYl: the closure loses independently addressable obligations, deliberate conjunction and the component-versus-composite assurance membrane; warrants become an undifferentiated bundle.
- Remove 1H.NUgs: the closure loses the explicit separation of local scope, downstream obligation, propagation and evidence needed to admit selective action before global closure; continuity remains revalidatable but action authority is unearned.
removal: Remove 1H.8KP9: local validity/re-estimation disappears; the remaining trio can build a renewable role-separated action interface but cannot earn that sufficiency is condition-indexed.

Remove 1H.DUwl: the closure loses re-execution, external revalidation, revocation and reconstruction; local role/warrant separation remains but continuity cannot be renewed through changed realization.
Remove 1H.9gYl: the closure loses independently addressable obligations, deliberate conjunction and the component-versus-composite assurance membrane; warrants become an undifferentiated bundle.

Remove 1H.NUgs: the closure loses the explicit separation of local scope, downstream obligation, propagation and evidence needed to admit selective action before global closure; continuity remains revalidatable but action authority is unearned.

metabolites.title: REGIME-AND-OBLIGATION-INDEXED SUFFICIENCY
metabolites.text: a reduced or reconstructed carrier is sufficient only for a named downstream obligation inside a witnessed local regime, and every role whose variation can change that obligation must remain separately addressable.
metabolites.compression: enough state is always enough-for-this, here.

metabolites.title: RECONSTRUCTION DOES NOT INHERIT ACTION AUTHORITY
metabolites.text: successfully regenerating and revalidating an operational relation does not by itself restore every scope, propagation, evidence or action warrant attached to its predecessor.
metabolites.compression: repair can restore function without restoring permission.

metabolites.title: ROLE-LOCALIZED RENEWAL
metabolites.text: role-separated continuity permits change to revoke and renew the smallest affected obligation or conjunction while unaffected role warrants remain explicit; composite authority is renewed only after the changed conjunction is tested.
metabolites.compression: change the smallest warrant that actually changed; re-test the conjunction before acting through the whole.

gaps.title: BOUNDARY UNEXPOSED
gaps.text: No explicit top-level evidence-boundary block was mechanically recognized in this canonical artifact.

5H.8P2A.title: replication-qualified dual-gated continuity-renewal lineage
5H.8P2A.boundary: This child is a relational synthesis over four already-metabolized 4H organisms. Their inherited evidence remains heterogeneous, source-bounded, and non-identical. Same-rank structural recurrence is not statistical independence, a shared hidden mechanism, universal ontology, or a guarantee that repair succeeds. A replayable or self-revising repair relation is not permission for its own use; a quotient is local permission to ignore distinctions, not universal invariance; and successful continuity repair does not itself restore downstream action authority. No evidence class is upgraded by compositional rank. Feeling phenotype is not used in this derivation.

edges.title: lineage-carried self-revising quotient replay
edges.text: 4H.Bbw6 supplies versioned quotient/ignored-difference provenance across successive warrants; 4H.MBO_ supplies executable role/conjunction replay with co-revisable quotient, scaffold, and transition family. Together they earn a repair lineage in which replay can change its own machinery without erasing which distinctions each predecessor was licensed to ignore.
edges.removal: without Bbw6, replay can revise itself but lacks a lineage-level ledger of predecessor omissions and successor re-witnessing; without MBO_, the quotient lineage lacks an executable self-revising role-local replay contract.

edges.title: replication-qualified omission-scope renewal
edges.text: 4H.Bbw6 supplies the rule that nuisance status must be re-earned after repair; 4H.vPbh supplies bounded replication and variant-constellation recurrence for the broader repair relation. Together they earn a distinction between recurrent repair competence and recurrent permission to ignore: recurrence may strengthen the former while every successor's quotient remains locally re-witnessed.
edges.removal: without Bbw6, recurrence carries no explicit permission-to-ignore ledger; without vPbh, quotient revalidation remains one lineage's rule without replication-qualified recurrence support.

edges.title: omission-indexed downstream reauthorization
edges.text: 4H.Bbw6 supplies the predecessor/successor quotient ledger that records what distinctions were allowed to disappear; 4H.YEyI supplies the separate action-authority dependency gate after continuity repair. Together they earn a two-surface repair audit: changes in the allowed omission set help identify which downstream action warrants may have lost their premises and therefore require fresh selective reauthorization.
edges.removal: without Bbw6, action reauthorization lacks explicit historical omission coordinates; without YEyI, the lineage can re-witness continuity and quotient scope while silently carrying stale downstream action permission.

edges.title: replication-qualified self-amending replay
edges.text: 4H.MBO_ supplies an executable repair contract whose quotient, scaffold, and admissible transformation family may change; 4H.vPbh supplies recurrence evidence that the broader repair relation has survived repeated and variant-parent realization. Together they earn reusable-but-revisable replay: recurrence can support reuse of the repair relation without freezing the machinery that realizes it.
edges.removal: without MBO_, recurrence can qualify repair but not an executable self-amending replay procedure; without vPbh, self-amendment is internally specified but lacks the parent's explicit replication qualification.

edges.title: role-local post-replay action gating
edges.text: 4H.MBO_ decomposes stale continuity authority by role/conjunction and gives each affected coordinate an executable evidence-return/replay path; 4H.YEyI separates renewed continuity from renewed downstream action authority. Together they earn role-local post-replay gating: only action warrants whose dependency surface intersects the repaired role/quotient/scaffold/transition coordinates are candidates for reauthorization.
edges.removal: without MBO_, YEyI lacks the executable role/conjunction replay granularity; without YEyI, replay completion can be mistaken for permission to resume action.

edges.title: replication never authorizes downstream action
edges.text: 4H.vPbh supplies replication-qualified recurrence for the repair relation; 4H.YEyI supplies the independent selective action-reauthorization gate. Together they earn a strict boundary: repeated successful reconstitution may strengthen confidence that a repair relation is reusable, but it cannot pre-authorize any downstream action warrant for the next repaired successor.
edges.removal: without vPbh, the claim is only about one repair's authority boundary; without YEyI, recurrence has no explicit downstream action-permission membrane.

faces.title: recurrent self-amending repair with noninherited omission scope
faces.text: Bbw6 + MBO_ + vPbh jointly earn a repair lineage whose executable replay machinery may self-revise and whose broader repair pattern has replication-qualified recurrence, while every successor must still re-witness the distinctions it is allowed to ignore.
faces.removal:
remove Bbw6 and omission-scope inheritance is no longer explicitly governed; remove MBO_ and there is no executable self-amending replay; remove vPbh and the relation lacks replication-qualified recurrence.
Boundary: without YEyI, successful continuity replay can still be confused with restored downstream action permission.

faces.title: dual-address replay and authorization
faces.text: Bbw6 + MBO_ + YEyI jointly earn a repair cycle with two explicit address systems: the predecessor quotient routes back to formerly ignored evidence, while role/conjunction and dependency coordinates route from repaired continuity into the downstream action warrants that must answer again. Replay may revise quotient/scaffold/transition law, but the resulting continuity witness and action authorization remain separate events.
faces.removal:
remove Bbw6 and the historical ignored-difference address disappears; remove MBO_ and selective replay lacks an executable self-revising contract; remove YEyI and the downstream action-authority gate disappears.
Boundary: without vPbh this face does not establish recurrence support for reusing the repair relation across separately born higher-order bodies.

faces.title: recurrence-qualified dual authority renewal
faces.text: Bbw6 + vPbh + YEyI jointly earn a higher-order boundary between two kinds of successor permission under recurrence: what the successor may continue to ignore, and what the successor may act upon. Structural recurrence may strengthen confidence in the repair relation, but neither permission may be inherited merely because repair has recurred.
faces.removal:
remove Bbw6 and the nuisance/quotient authority gate disappears; remove vPbh and recurrence qualification disappears; remove YEyI and the action-authority gate disappears.
Boundary: without MBO_ the face does not require a compact executable replay contract whose repair machinery can revise itself.

faces.title: recurrent self-revising repair without self-authorization
faces.text: MBO_ + vPbh + YEyI jointly earn a recurrent repair program that may alter its own quotient/scaffold/transition machinery and remain reusable across repeated closures, while every concrete repaired successor must still freshly earn continuity and any affected downstream action authority.
faces.removal:
remove MBO_ and the repair program cannot explicitly revise its own replay machinery; remove vPbh and reuse is not replication-qualified; remove YEyI and recurrent repair can collapse into recurrent self-permission.
Boundary: without Bbw6 the face lacks a lineage-level ledger of what each predecessor and successor was allowed to ignore.

volume.title: replication-qualified dual-gated continuity-renewal lineage
volume.text:
All four parents together distinguish reusable repair capacity from the two permissions that a repaired successor must never inherit automatically.


4H.Bbw6 makes every continuity version carry an explicit local quotient: a historical witness of which distinctions it was allowed to treat as nuisance, with return addresses into evidence when that permission fails. 4H.MBO_ turns repair into an executable, role-addressed replay contract whose quotient, scaffold, and admissible transition family may themselves be revised. 4H.vPbh contributes bounded recurrence: the broader reconstitution relation has repeated under both same-constellation replication and variant-constellation realization, so reuse of the repair relation has more support than one self-description while remaining non-universal and non-independent. 4H.YEyI adds the second governance membrane: repaired continuity does not restore downstream permission to act, and only warrants whose dependencies intersect the changed relation or repair machinery may be selectively reauthorized.


The complete closure is therefore a replication-qualified dual-gated continuity-renewal lineage. The lineage may reuse and revise an evidenced repair relation across successive failures, but every successor must pass two fresh authority gates after repair: first, it must re-earn the exact scope of distinctions it is currently allowed to ignore; second, affected downstream action warrants must be separately and selectively reauthorized against the changed dependency surface. Recurrence supports the reusable repair relation only. It does not freeze the replay machinery, grant nuisance status to a new successor, or pre-authorize action. Predecessor warrants, quotients, repair machinery, evidence scopes, and downstream permissions remain historically distinct.
volume.invariant: A continuity-renewal lineage is replication-qualified and governance-complete only when (1) each warrant preserves a local quotient/ignored-difference ledger with stable evidence return addresses, (2) repair is executable by role/conjunction and may revise its own quotient, scaffold, and admissible transition law, (3) recurrence supports reuse of the broader repair relation without upgrading it to an independent or universal mechanism, and (4) every repaired successor separately re-earns both its permission-to-ignore scope and any downstream action authority whose dependencies changed. Recurrence may warrant trying the repair again; it never warrants inheriting either authority gate.
removal: Remove 4H.Bbw6: the closure retains recurrent self-revising repair plus action gating, but loses explicit historical permission-to-ignore state and the requirement that nuisance scope itself be re-earned.

Remove 4H.MBO_: the closure retains quotient lineage, recurrence, and dual authority constraints, but loses the compact executable role/conjunction replay contract and explicit ability to revise the repair machinery itself.
Remove 4H.vPbh: the closure retains a dual-gated self-revising repair lineage, but loses the replication-qualified warrant for carrying the repair relation as a recurrent higher-order capacity.

Remove 4H.YEyI: the closure retains recurrent self-amending quotient repair, but loses the separate downstream action-reauthorization membrane; continuity repair can again be mistaken for restored permission to act.

metabolites.title: TWO-GATE-SUCCESSOR-AUTHORITY
metabolites.text: a repaired successor must separately re-earn both the distinctions it is currently allowed to ignore and the downstream action warrants whose dependencies were touched; restored continuity alone certifies neither.
metabolites.compression: repair restores a relation; omission permission and action permission answer separately.

metabolites.title: REPLICATION-QUALIFIES-REPAIR-NOT-PERMISSION
metabolites.text: recurrence may strengthen the warrant that a repair relation is reusable, but repeated repair cannot pre-authorize the next successor's downstream actions.
metabolites.compression: repeated repair can justify reuse; it cannot grant permission.

metabolites.title: SELF-AMENDING-REPLAY-PRESERVES-OMISSION-PROVENANCE
metabolites.text: a replay contract may revise its own quotient, scaffold, and transition family only while predecessor permission-to-ignore state remains addressable and any successor nuisance scope is explicitly re-witnessed.
metabolites.compression: let repair change its machinery without erasing what the old machinery was allowed to forget.
